raw.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

Neogen is seeking a strategic, results-drivenSenior Director, Food Safety Marketingto lead commercial marketing for our Food Safety business across the United States, Canada, and Australia/New Zealand. This senior leadership role will translate global portfolio and product strategies into regional go-to-market plans, differentiated customer value propositions, and integrated demand-generation programs that drive measurable growth.

You will lead a multidisciplinary marketing team and collaborate closely with Sales, Product Management, Finance, Regulatory, Operations, and Global Marketing to advance food safety solutions that support customers throughout the global supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute regional commercial marketing and go-to-market strategies for Neogen's food safety diagnostics portfolio across the United States, Canada, and Australia/New Zealand.
  • Translate global portfolio, product, and brand strategies into locally relevant plans informed by customer needs, market dynamics, competitive intelligence, and growth opportunities.
  • Lead market segmentation, customer research, competitive analysis, and TAM/SAM/SOM assessments to establish strategic priorities and guide investment decisions.
  • Define customer value propositions, positioning, and messaging, and oversee integrated campaigns that build awareness, generate qualified demand, strengthen pipeline, and support revenue growth.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to improve commercial effectiveness through customer-focused content, sales enablement tools, training, activation plans, and customer programs.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 13 professionals while managing marketing budgets, performance metrics, technology platforms, and resources to maximize business impact.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, life sciences, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Significant progressive marketing leadership experience in commercial marketing, portfolio marketing, demand generation, go-to-market strategy, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated success translating business, product, or portfolio strategy into measurable regional marketing plans and commercial outcomes.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams within a complex, matrixed, and cross-functional organization.
  • Strong expertise in market segmentation, customer insights, competitive analysis, opportunity sizing, integrated campaign development, and marketing performance measurement.
  • Experience using CRM, marketing automation, and sales enablement platforms; familiarity with Salesforce, Eloqua, Seismic, or comparable tools is preferred. Ability to travel as business needs require.

Preferred qualifications include an advanced degree and experience in food safety, food and beverage, diagnostics, life sciences, laboratory products, or another regulated business-to-business environment. Experience supporting multi-country commercial organizations, launching products, managing complex portfolios, and working with direct-sales and distributor channels is also valued.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to shape commercial marketing strategy for a business advancing food safety and quality across global supply chains.
  • A collaborative, cross-functional environment with meaningful partnership across regional and global teams.
  • The ability to lead, mentor, and develop a talented multidisciplinary marketing organization.
  • Meaningful work connecting innovative food safety solutions with customers' operational, quality, and compliance needs.
  • Opportunities for professional growth, leadership development, and strategic business impact.
  • A standard benefits package.

Neogen is committed to building an inclusive workplace where qualified individuals are considered for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. If you are a strategic marketing leader with the commercial insight, collaborative leadership style, and customer focus to help drive growth in food safety, we'd love to hear from you. Join our team and help deliver solutions that support safer food worldwide.

Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters!

From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

raw.description:
USFS is an ISO 9001 management consulting firm with headquarters in the National Capital Region and offices and staff in 12 US states. USFS staff average 10+ years of professional experience, over 80 percent of our staff have bachelor’s degrees, and over half have advanced degrees in business and technology. USFS was founded in 2010 and provides financial management, acquisition management, program management, and data analytic support services to federal and state governments.

Acquisition Liaison

Federal Transit Administration Support

Location: Washington, DC / Primarily Remote

Company: US Federal Solutions

Why Join US Federal Solutions

US Federal Solutions (USFS) is a management consulting firm supporting federal agencies with acquisition management, financial management, program management, and data analytics services. We are seeking an experienced Acquisition Liaison to support the Federal Transit Administration’s Office of Acquisition Management.

This role is well suited for a federal acquisition professional who can serve as a trusted bridge between program offices and contracting personnel. The successful candidate will help customers develop complete acquisition packages, strengthen requirements documentation, track procurement actions, support acquisition planning, and coordinate activities throughout the acquisition lifecycle.

What You Will Do

As an Acquisition Liaison, you will provide federal acquisition subject matter expertise to program and technical staff supporting service and commercial requirements. You will work closely with Contracting Officers, Contract Specialists, Contracting Officer’s Representatives, program offices, and technical subject matter experts to help move procurement actions from initial planning through award, administration, and closeout.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide federal acquisition support to program and technical offices throughout the full acquisition lifecycle.
  • Serve as a liaison between program personnel and acquisition professionals to help ensure procurement requirements are properly developed, documented, coordinated, and submitted.
  • Assist program offices with preparing purchase request packages for entry into contracting systems.
  • Review purchase request packages to verify that required supporting documentation is complete and appropriate for the intended procurement action.
  • Review acquisition packages prior to submission to the Acquisition Office for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable acquisition requirements.
  • Assist with reviewing existing contracts for compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, and contractual requirements.
  • Work closely with program professionals and technical subject matter experts to develop acquisition documentation and support acquisition planning activities.
  • Assist with development of acquisition plans, Statements of Work, Statements of Objectives, Performance Work Statements, functional requirements, specifications, market research reports, determinations and findings, exception to fair opportunity documentation, and justifications and approvals.
  • Assist with development of Independent Government Cost Estimates and market research used to support IGCEs or business case models.
  • Support cost and price analysis activities as required.
  • Apply knowledge of various contract types, including Firm-Fixed Price, Cost-Reimbursable, Labor Hour, and Time and Materials.
  • Support acquisition and contract administration activities involving IDIQ contracts, task orders, delivery orders, Blanket Purchase Agreements, call orders, purchase orders, and Inter/Intra-Agency Agreements.
  • Assist with recurring contract administration functions in support of both program and acquisition offices.
  • Participate in meetings involving program offices and acquisition personnel and document relevant discussions, decisions, action items, and acquisition requirements.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders at multiple organizational levels using written, verbal, and electronic communication methods.
  • Analyze complex acquisition issues and support their resolution through coordination with appropriate Government stakeholders.
  • Validate acquisition and contract data and assist with tasks necessary to support solicitation, award, administration, and modification of contractual actions.
  • Assist with preparing contract actions for closeout and coordinating information for submission to Government closeout teams.
  • Maintain current electronic tracking spreadsheets showing the status of supported contract and acquisition actions.
  • Track contract funding levels and coordinate with Contracting Officer’s Representatives and Contract Specialists to communicate funding status and related information.
  • Conduct or support market research and analysis relevant to planned acquisitions.
  • Assist with development of source selection evaluation criteria when required.
  • Coordinate with technical experts and contracting personnel to ensure project milestones are appropriately reflected in contractual documents and project plans.
  • Assist with acquisition-related reporting requirements and other assigned procurement support activities.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science degree, or higher degree.
  • At least 5 years of relevant federal acquisition or contracting experience.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and hands-on experience applying the Federal Acquisition Regulation to federal procurements.
  • Federal acquisition knowledge and experience comparable to FAC-C Level II competencies.
  • Experience supporting acquisition actions from planning through award, administration, and closeout.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing federal acquisition packages and purchase request documentation.
  • Experience developing or supporting Statements of Work, Statements of Objectives, Performance Work Statements, acquisition plans, market research documentation, and related procurement materials.
  • Experience with multiple contract types, including Firm-Fixed Price, Cost-Reimbursable, Labor Hour, and Time and Materials.
  • Experience supporting IDIQ contracts, BPAs, task orders, delivery orders, call orders, and purchase orders.
  • Experience applying acquisition procedures associated with FAR Parts 12, 13, 15, 37, and 43, as well as contract closeout requirements.
  • Experience conducting or supporting federal market research.
  • Understanding of cost and price analysis concepts.
  • Ability to independently analyze acquisition assignments and provide meaningful feedback and recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, and Teams.
  • Experience using Google Workspace applications such as Calendar, Sheets, Chat, Gmail, Docs, Slides, Drive, and Meet.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using PRISM or another federal contract writing system.
  • Experience using General Services Administration Market Research as a Service or other federal market research tools.
  • Experience with Federal Supply Schedule acquisitions.
  • Experience using SharePoint.
  • Experience working with Customer Relationship Management systems.
  • Experience supporting the Department of Transportation, Federal Transit Administration, or another federal civilian agency.

Benefits

  • Employer-provided paid Medical / Dental / Vision insurance.
  • Employer matching 401K plan.
  • PTO
  • 11 Federal Holidays
  • Additionally voluntary benefits to include Short / Long Term Disability, Term Life, and AD&D Insurance.

raw.excerpt: About AMZ Advisers:AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces.
raw.description:
About AMZ Advisers:

AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

  • Nordpass

  • Slack

  • Sellerboard

  • Data Dive

  • Zoom

To Apply Please Include the Following:

  • Your CV/ Resume in English (ONLY English Resumes will be considered)

  • Two references who can attest to your competency in this line of work

  • Answers to the following questions:

    • Describe your experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central.

    • Do you have any experience leading a team?

    • Why are you interested in a new job/ this position?

    • Describe a situation in your career in which you were faced with a challenging problem and how you overcame it.

raw.description:
Red Canyon Software is looking for an enthusiastic and creative Satellite Systems I&T Engineer - HWIL/SWIL (Contract) to develop solutions for satellite integration and test. We're looking for candidates who can bring exceptional engineering skills and strong experience in aerospace programs to the team.

Position Responsibilities:

The Satellite Systems I&T Engineer (SEIT) will contribute to the development and execution of satellite verification and validation activities, including Flatsats, HWIL/SWIL environments, and simulators. In this role, the engineer will map technical requirements to verification and validation strategies, develop test plans, procedures, and automated test scripts, and execute and report software, subsystem, and system-level test results. The engineer will also support requirements decomposition and the development of design documentation.

As a mid-level engineer, the SEIT Engineer will lead portions of the verification program, serve as Test Conductor for formal validation events, troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues, and execute moderate to complex assignments with increasing autonomy under the Systems Engineering Manager and senior Systems Engineers.

Satellite Functional Verification and Validation - 80%

  • Review the satellite functional specification and develop verification plans and test approaches to validate requirements.
  • Design and build automated testing systems, tooling, and/or ground support equipment (GSE) to optimize test and production workflows.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain test procedures and automated scripts for Flatsat, HWIL, and SWIL environments.
  • Serve as a test developer by writing automated TCL-based test scripts for the TERMA CCS5 command-and-control (C2) system.
  • Serve as Test Conductor for formal validation tests and lead dry runs or readiness activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues, perform detailed data analysis, and generate or review test reports, non-conformances, and closure documentation.
  • Participate in and help coordinate cross-functional planning, integration, and test execution across engineering disciplines.

Satellite System Architecture Development - 20%

  • Support system architecture trade studies and requirements development for mission objectives.
  • Update the satellite functional specification based on new mission or customer requirements.
  • Generate system architecture artifacts such as spacecraft CONOPS, algorithm descriptions, and interface documentation.

Qualified Experience / Skills / Training:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in STEM (Science, Technical, Engineering, Math) or related scientific areas.
  • Preferred: Masters in STEM (Science, Technical, Engineering, Math) or related scientific areas.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with a bachelor's degree, or 1 year with a master's degree.
  • Experience supporting aerospace hardware and/or software development in phases such as design, integration, verification, or test.
  • Experience with test automation or scripting (TCL, Python, or similar), preferably in a command-and-control (C2) environment such as TERMA CCS5.

Knowledge, Skills, Demonstrated Capabilities:

  • Proficiency with systems engineering and I&T processes including requirements traceability, verification planning, and test documentation.
  • Experience working with Flatsats, HWIL/SWIL systems, simulators, or similar integration environments.
  • Familiarity with testability concepts, environmental test planning, and integration-level troubleshooting.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively across engineering and program teams.
  • Ability to work in a multi-functional, fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative and deliver results with moderate oversight.

Preferred Technical Experience:

  • Experience leading portions of verification and validation activities for aerospace hardware or software systems, including Flatsat, HWIL/SWIL, or simulation-based testing.
  • Experience contributing to subsystem-level verification matrices, test plans, or readiness reviews.
  • Familiarity with digital twin or simulator-based test environments.

Preferred Test Engineering Capabilities:

  • Experience with system-level troubleshooting, anomaly investigation, and root cause analysis.
  • Understanding of testability concepts, integration workflows, and environmental test considerations.

Professional Skills:

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to interface effectively across engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with increasing autonomy in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment.
  • Strong initiative and consistent record of delivering high-quality results.

raw.description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $125M in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

Role Overview

Backblaze is seeking a Director, Enterprise Systems & Architecture to own the technical vision, architecture, and operations of the company’s enterprise systems and emerging AI use cases. This is a senior leadership role with organization-wide scope — spanning commercial and financial systems, GTM technology, data architecture, and the deployment and governance of AI agents across the business.

This leader will serve as the company’s architectural authority for enterprise platforms including Salesforce, NetSuite, Zendesk, Snowflake, and their surrounding integration ecosystem. Equally important, they will support the governed infrastructure layer that enables AI agents, automated workflows, and headless capabilities to operate safely at a public company. They will partner closely with the CRO, CISO, and CFO organizations to enable velocity while ensuring systems are compliant, auditable, and built to scale.

The ideal candidate combines deep enterprise architecture expertise with hands-on platform engineering instincts and practical experience deploying AI agents in production environments. This is a build-and-operate role, not a purely advisory one. The Director will directly manage the Salesforce administration team and the NetSuite techno-functional team, and will grow a broader platform capability over time.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture Strategy

  • Define and maintain the enterprise systems architecture roadmap across the commercial, financial, and GTM technology stack, including Salesforce, NetSuite, Zendesk, Snowflake, and related platforms.
  • Own and maintain formal architecture documentation including system topology maps, data flow diagrams, integration inventories, and architecture decision records (ADRs).
  • Establish and enforce architectural governance standards and review processes for all material system changes across the enterprise.
  • Define reference architectures and design patterns for integrations, data exchange, platform extensibility, and AI agent workloads.
  • Lead build vs. buy evaluations and establish platform selection criteria — including for AI tooling, agent orchestration frameworks, and LLMOps infrastructure — aligned with long-term architectural goals.
  • Ensure systems architecture supports scalability, data integrity, security, and operational efficiency in a public-company environment.

Systems Architecture & Integration Design

  • Serve as the lead architect for the design and implementation of integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Zendesk, Snowflake, Orb, and other enterprise platforms.
  • Establish and enforce design standards, data contracts, and integration governance across all enterprise systems.
  • Own the enterprise architecture review board, evaluating proposed system changes for scalability, compliance, security, and alignment with long-term design goals.
  • Define integration patterns (event-driven, API-first, middleware) and ensure consistent application across the technology ecosystem.
  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to ensure data pipelines, data models, and platform integrations reflect sound architectural principles and support reliable analytical and operational outcomes.
  • Lead evaluation and selection of new technologies, including iPaaS and middleware platforms, ensuring alignment with the broader architecture.

Architecture Governance & Advisory

  • Serve as the company's technical authority on enterprise systems design questions, providing architectural guidance to Revenue Operations, Finance, and Data Engineering leadership.
  • Lead architecture review sessions and provide formal design approval for major system initiatives and platform changes.
  • Produce and maintain architectural roadmaps, standards documentation, and technical decision frameworks that guide delivery teams and stakeholders.
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable, future-proof architectural solutions, ensuring alignment between business priorities and technical design decisions.
  • Establish strong feedback loops with business teams to ensure the architecture evolves alongside organizational needs.
  • Mature the infrastructure that governs AI agent workflows — ensuring all agents and automated systems operate through governed identity, API gateway, secrets management, logging, and reconciliation layers.
  • Maintain and enforce change management standards for workflow deployments, prompt changes, and policy updates — including GitHub-backed version control and CI/CD deployment gates.
  • Ensure AI agent operations comply with SOX IT General Controls, data privacy requirements (GDPR/CCPA), and internal data governance standards.
  • Build and maintain observability infrastructure in partnership with the security team for agent operations, including real-time dashboards, alerting on anomalous behavior, and audit trail evidence for SOX and compliance purposes.

Team Leadership & Vendor Governance

  • Lead and develop a team of Business Systems administrators, contractors, providing mentorship and clear career development direction.
  • Establish best practices for systems lifecycle management, change management, and project delivery.
  • Manage vendor and contractor relationships, ensuring external resources operate within defined architectural standards and governance frameworks.
  • Champion a culture of technical rigor, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement across the team.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Business Systems, or Platform Engineering roles, with demonstrated ownership of multi-system environments at a public or compliance-regulated company.
  • Proven experience deploying, monitoring, and governing AI agents or LLM-powered workflows in production, including prompt versioning, agent identity management, and audit logging.
  • Deep experience architecting and governing Salesforce CRM environments at scale, including data model design, integration patterns, and access controls.
  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite and Snowflake from both an architectural and operational perspective.
  • Experience building and operating API gateway, secrets management, and identity-based access control infrastructure in support of automated workflows or agent systems.
  • Solid understanding of SOX IT General Controls and application controls, with experience producing control evidence in a public company environment within the last 3 years.
  • Proven track record managing multi-functional business systems or platform teams, including direct management of admins and techno-functional resources.
  • Experience designing integration architectures using event-driven, API-first, or middleware patterns.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage credibly across technical teams, senior business leaders, and external auditors.
  • Experience with workflow versioning, GitOps patterns, and CI/CD pipelines for business systems deployments.

Preferred

  • Proficiency with architecture and security frameworks to enable the responsible usage of AI
  • Hands-on experience with iPaaS or middleware platforms (e.g., Fivetran, Polytomic, MuleSoft, Boomi, Celigo) at a design and governance level.
  • Experience developing master data management (MDM) strategy and data governance frameworks.
  • Experience managing analytics architecture and BI platforms such as Tableau.
  • Salesforce and NetSuite certifications.
  • Experience working in public or large enterprise technology environments with compliance and audit requirements.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

raw.description:
Job Description

International fast-growing IT company StellarTech is looking for a Backend Lead - Hands-on Tech Lead / Player-Coach. StellarTech is a fast-growing international product technology company looking for a Backend Lead to own the technical direction, engineering quality, and operational health of our backend ecosystem.

This is a hands-on player-coach role combining backend architecture, technical execution, engineering leadership, and people management. You will lead a small team of experienced backend engineers while remaining actively involved in technical design, critical implementation, code reviews, production troubleshooting, and technical research.

You will work in a cross-functional product environment and take responsibility not only for backend implementation, but also for product delivery, reliability, and long-term technical sustainability.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the backend technical direction and architecture across our product ecosystem.
  • Translate product initiatives into technical solutions: clarify requirements, assess feasibility, identify risks, prepare technical designs, and decompose work for the team.
  • Own the complete engineering lifecycle from refinement and solution design to implementation, release, monitoring, and production improvements.
  • Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable backend solutions aligned with product and business needs.
  • Build and evolve shared backend capabilities, reusable components, and platform solutions that allow the company to launch and scale multiple products efficiently.
  • Define service boundaries, data ownership, APIs, integration patterns, and communication between systems.

Make and defend pragmatic architectural decisions, including:

  • Monolith vs services.
  • Synchronous vs asynchronous communication.
  • SQL vs NoSQL.
  • Build vs buy.
  • Short-term delivery vs long-term technical sustainability.
  • Remain hands-on with Python and FastAPI through critical implementation, prototyping, debugging, code reviews, and technical research.
  • Lead the design of event-driven and asynchronous workflows, including retries, idempotency, ordering, failure handling, and message processing.
  • Own backend production readiness and operational health, including monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, SLIs/SLOs, runbooks, incident response, root-cause analysis, and post-incident improvements.
  • Establish clear ownership of backend services and ensure the team can support them without dependency on individual engineers.
  • Improve engineering practices covering refinement, technical design, Definition of Done, testing, code review, CI/CD, release safety, documentation, and technical debt management.
  • Introduce and scale AI-assisted and agentic development workflows across the backend team.
  • Evaluate how AI tools affect delivery speed, engineering quality, maintainability, and team productivity.
  • Lead and develop backend engineers through delegation, regular feedback, one-to-one meetings, mentoring, performance reviews, and career development.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Platform, DevOps, QA, Frontend, and other engineering leads.
    Take responsibility for product and business outcomes, not only technical implementation.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 7+ years of backend engineering experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or Backend Lead role.
  • Strong and recent hands-on production experience with Python, ideally 5+ years.
  • Strong knowledge of modern Python backend development practices.
  • Production experience with FastAPI or similar Python web frameworks.
  • Experience with asynchronous programming, testing, typing, profiling, debugging, and maintainable application design.
  • Proven experience owning backend architecture end to end, not only contributing to solutions designed by others.
  • Experience making and defending architectural decisions with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience building and operating scalable, high-load, or data-intensive production systems.
  • Strong understanding of service design, system boundaries, data flows, integrations, and distributed system trade-offs.
  • Strong experience with event-driven systems, asynchronous processing, and message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or similar.
  • Good understanding of retries, idempotency, message ordering, delivery guarantees, dead-letter handling, and failure recovery.

Strong database fundamentals, including:

  • Data modelling.
  • Transactions and isolation.
  • Indexing.
  • Locking and concurrency.
  • Query plans.
  • Performance diagnosis and optimisation.
  • Production experience with MongoDB and an understanding of its modelling, consistency, and scaling trade-offs.
  • Production experience with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
  • Experience designing APIs and integrating external platforms, third-party services, and payment or subscription systems.
  • Strong production ownership mindset, including monitoring, alerting, debugging, incident investigation, and reliability improvements.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containerised applications, deployment tooling, and CI/CD.
  • Ability to reason about deployment safety, rollbacks, scalability, resource limits, and system capacity.
  • Proven experience improving an engineering process, technical area, or system from an unclear or immature state to a measurable target state.
  • Ability to balance product delivery speed with architecture quality and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience leading experienced engineers without micromanagement.
  • Experience with delegation, performance feedback, team development, and technical ownership distribution.
  • Strong ownership, initiative, structured communication, and ability to make decisions under uncertainty.

AI-First Engineering Experience:

We are looking for more than occasional chatbot usage or basic code generation.

A strong candidate should be able to provide concrete examples of using AI in an end-to-end software delivery workflow, such as:

  • Spec-driven or context-driven development.
  • AI coding agents.
  • Automated code review.
  • Test and documentation generation.
  • Reusable repository or company-level AI context.
  • Agentic pipelines and workflow automation.
  • AI-assisted debugging and incident investigation.
  • Evaluations and quality gates.
  • Security and data privacy controls.
  • Measuring the impact of AI adoption on delivery speed and quality.
  • Introducing AI workflows across an engineering team.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience building multi-product, multi-tenant, or platform-based architectures.
  • Experience creating internal frameworks, service templates, or reusable backend components.
  • Experience scaling products without proportional growth of the engineering team.
  • Experience with AWS, including S3, Lambda, ECS, EKS, or related services.
  • Experience with Redis.
  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience.
  • Strong Docker experience.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tooling.
  • Experience with Temporal or another workflow orchestration platform.
  • Experience applying DDD, CQRS, event sourcing, or similar architectural patterns pragmatically.
  • Experience with B2C, EdTech, subscriptions, payments, analytics, or mobile-first products
  • Experience working in an early-stage or fast-changing product environment.

Good Fit for This Role:

This role is a good fit for someone who:

  • Remains a strong hands-on backend engineer.
  • Enjoys combining coding, architecture, and leadership.
  • Can independently assess the current technical state and define a better target state.
  • Creates engineering processes rather than only following existing ones.
  • Takes ownership of services after they are released to production.
  • Can make pragmatic architectural decisions without unnecessary complexity.
  • Thinks about product and business outcomes, not only implementation.
  • Can set a technical standard for experienced engineers.
  • Is comfortable challenging existing decisions and defending a well-reasoned position.
  • Sees AI as a way to redesign engineering workflows, not only generate code.
  • Is ready to lead both technology and people.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

  • Innovative environment: We are building and scaling EdTech products while actively experimenting with new technologies and development approaches.
  • Global remote work: Work with an international team from anywhere within a compatible time zone.
  • Health support: Company-provided medical expense compensation.
  • AI tools: Company-provided AI subscriptions and other engineering tools.
  • Flexible time off: 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays.
  • Collaborative culture: Work alongside experienced and motivated professionals who value ownership, speed, and measurable results.
  • Real influence: Help define the backend strategy, engineering standards, and AI-first development practices of a growing product ecosystem.

Interview Process:

  1. HR interview
  2. Technical Interview
  3. Leadership Interview
  4. Final interview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Idira, by Palo Alto Networks is seeking a proven enterprise seller that will continue to capture our rapid market share in the Global Fortune 1000 covering some of our most strategic customer partners in the Dallas and Austin area. The Enterprise Account Executive will sell our market leading solutions by gaining a thorough understanding of the client’s business needs.  A successful Enterprise Account Executive will be responsible for the formulation and execution of a hyper-growth business plan that targets existing enterprise customers. The Enterprise Account Executive will report directly to the District Sales Manager.

What you will do:

  • Driving new business with existing and net new enterprise accounts

  • Build and execute territory plans with Quarterly and Annual Business Reviews (QBRs)

  • Build and advance near-term and long-term qualified pipeline

  • Selling into various stakeholders: IT side and Business side C-level engagements, positioning and proposal

  • Quarterbacking the extended team on opportunities including pre-sales, partners, executive management, and customer success

  • Management of all contact activity, prospecting, pipeline development, forecasting, negotiating, pricing, and closing and executing contracts

  • Perform bi-weekly meetings with the territory Sales Engineers and Professional Services Engineers to assess the status of all existing accounts, and to expedite the roll-out and up-sale/cross-sale processes

  • Collaborate with and engage the right Palo Alto Networks technical experts to provide an accurate and compelling story on our products’ strengths and capabilities to win deals.

  • Cultivate and manage relationships with partners and alliances

Qualifications

  • 3+ years sales experience: SaaS B2B technology

  • (C-Level) B2B software sales experience 

  • Experience in closing 8+ figure deals

  • Bachelors degreeor equivalent work experience (3 years cybersecurity B2B enterprise sales)

  • Experience in cultivating and controlling complex sales cycles, selling across multiple stakeholders within enterprise organizations

  • Discovery skills, asking insightful questions

  • Adaptability to a changing environment

  • Privileged Access Management or Identity Access Management experience a plus

  • Ability to craft and articulate compelling business propositions

  • Outstanding presentation, written and verbal communication skills

  • Knowledge of and usage of MEDDPICC

  • Trained in sales methodologies such as The Challenger Sale, Miller Heiman, Sandler or Value-Selling Framework

  • Experience sellingSaaS/Subscription/Cloudsolutions preferred

  • Experience selling with Advisory, Channel Partners, and Ecosystem Partners preferred

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$212,800.00 - $292,600.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.Motor-Vehicle Requirement: This role may require travel to and from Palo Alto Networks, Inc. business meetings and events and requires reliable transportation to do so. If a hire chooses to drive in connection with company business, the hire for this role must maintain a valid driver’s license.

Responsibilities

This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within the United States.

Sargent & Lundy is one of the largest and most experienced power industry engineering and consulting firms. This position in Sargent & Lundy’s Consulting group will require you to work on our project teams that provide a wide variety of services, such as the following:

  • Technical consulting and advisory services to power project developers to support new utility-scale solar, wind, gas, battery energy storage, and other projects;
  • Independent engineering and due diligence services for lenders and investors to evaluate the financing of new power and infrastructure projects;
  • Technical, economic, and market studies for grid operators, utilities, and research agencies; and
  • Planning studies and business case development for utilities, independent power producers, and government agencies.

This position is being added to support the continued growth of the Sargent & Lundy Consulting group, particularly in the renewable energy, battery energy storage, and utility planning / advisory practice areas. Our Consulting Group works with clients across the United States and in numerous other countries.

This position will require a great deal of face-to-face interaction with power plant developers and owners, as well as lenders and investors, during the execution of consulting services work for the firm. The work environment in our Consulting group is fast-paced, dynamic, and interesting.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

This position requires someone who has a Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, or civil engineering (other engineering disciplines may be considered). A Master’s degree in an engineering discipline or business (e.g., MBA) is a plus.

In order to qualify, it is important that you have 12 or more years of experience in the power industry, including one or more of the following:

  • Design of utility-scale solar, wind, and/or battery energy storage projects;
  • Independent engineering and due diligence services for power projects;
  • Power project development;
  • Solar, wind, and/or battery energy storage construction management;
  • Experience in project finance or financial modeling of power projects is a plus;
  • Experience with owner’s engineering activities during power project execution is a plus.

Also, extremely important are:

  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills.
  • Experience writing technical reports and proposals.
  • Solid interpersonal skills and ability to work with and guide others.
  • Project planning and leadership skills.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

raw.excerpt: Be part of the Next Industrial Revolution - Behind every SaaS Product is a Team In Vimachem, we’re using technology to empower the people who manufacture medicines for our world.
raw.description:
Be part of the Next Industrial Revolution - Behind every SaaS Product is a Team

In Vimachem, we’re using technology to empower the people who manufacture medicines for our world. Since 2015, we have been developing the industry’s only AI-enabled MES platform purpose-built for Life Sciences - combining MES, IIoT, and Pharma 4.0 capabilities into a single, modern system that helps pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers scale faster, operate with greater flexibility, and deliver high-quality, life-saving medications.

Today, we are going through one of the most exciting periods in our company's history. We are growing rapidly globally and expanding our EU-based MES team, looking for an ambitious and experienced engineer ready to contribute and innovate, taking our customer experience services to the next level.

Our culture is fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and rewarding. We've been recognized as a "Great Place to Work" for multiple consecutive years by fostering an inclusive and mission-driven culture. If you are passionate about cutting-edge software and global MES engagements, the future is bright for you at Vimachem, and we want to hear from you!

This position is a fully remote position for EU-based candidates, with up to 15% travel for on-site customer visits.

About the role

As a SeniorMES Implementation & Support Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting and deploying Vimachem’s cutting-edge Pharma MES modules across global pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical manufacturing environments.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring exceptional customer experiences and assisting with continuous improvements to our support and implementation processes where applicable. Your work will significantly impact customer satisfaction and loyalty, directly influencing Vimachem’s global market reputation and success.

What will you do as a Senior MES Implementation & Support Engineer?

  • Act as the frontline technical contact for customers, providing timely, accurate, and complete responses to support inquiries.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex application issues using logs, diagnostics, database queries, and system analysis.
  • Educate customers on platform functionality, usage, and best practices, building strong and trusted relationships.
  • Work side by side with customers to support and implement theVimachem Pharma 4.0 EBR module, from configuration through go-live and hypercare.
  • Support user testing activities, troubleshooting issues and ensuring expected results are delivered in production environments.
  • Analyze and document customer manufacturing and IT processes to ensure optimal system alignment and compliance readiness.
  • Assist with the configuration of system settings, workflows, business rules, roles, and interfaces to meet customer requirements.
  • Investigate and diagnose system behavior using logs, database queries, and integration traces.
  • Support API/web-service–based integrations with ERP, equipment systems, historians, or other enterprise platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to continuously improve the platform, support processes, and implementation approach.
  • Contribute to internal and customer-facing documentation, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and implementation assets.
  • Support the pre-Sales and Sales teams by delivering technical product demonstrations, participating in solution discussions, and contributing to the technical validation of customer requirements.
  • Help create a proactive support environment by anticipating customer needs and identifying potential issues before they arise.
  • Act as an internal advocate for innovation by exploring and applying AI-powered tools to improve efficiency, scalability, and customer experience across Support services.

The main qualifications for the Senior MES Implementation & Support Engineer role are:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum5 years of experiencesupporting and/or implementing enterprise software systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems; Linux knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience working with ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk, Jira Service Management).
  • Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence).
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively and remain flexible in a customer-driven environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with high standards for documentation.
  • Highly motivated, self-directed individual with a “can-do” and “will-figure-it-out” mindset.

Nice-to-Have

  • Good networking knowledge.
  • Ability to read, parse, and manipulate various technical formats such as XML and CSV.
  • Knowledge of API and HTTP (post/get, auth, etc.).
  • Basic skills in SQL (PostgreSQL) and MongoDB, queries.
  • Exposure to ERP, historians, equipment integrations, or SCADA/automation systems.
  • Basic scripting skills (Shell, Python, JavaScript, or similar).
  • Experience withMES or EBR systemsin pharma/GxP environments.
  • Familiarity withGMP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and data integrity principles.
  • Background in supporting production systems or working in regulated manufacturing.

About You:

  • You are willing to work in a fast-paced, challenging, and quickly changing environment.
  • You are keen to stay up to date with the latest technologies and industry trends.
  • You are tech-savvy with years of experience in technical product implementations and support, working with customers through multiple forms of communication, including chat and web calls.
  • You are genuine, humble, curious, and willing to work in a fun, diverse culture.

At Vimachem, we know that even exceptional candidates sometimes hesitate to apply. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply - we’d love to explore your potential fit.

What’s in It for You

raw.description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in business operations, strategy, chief of staff roles, or technical program management, including direct support of senior leaders.

  • Proven experience managing operational tech stacks, vendor relationships, and tracking organizational budgets/OPEX or business cases.

  • Demonstrated ability to write and speak at a leadership altitude, holding the room and influencing cross-functional stakeholders without formal direct authority.

  • Exceptional ability to manage multiple complex threads, ensuring nothing is dropped, everything is documented, and decisions result in action.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in an Office-of-the-CxO or serving as a dedicated right-hand to a senior leader in a high-tech environment.

  • Familiarity with cloud concepts (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure), cybersecurity, technical lab environments, or developer platforms.

  • Experience working inside or directly partnering with technical enablement, customer engineering, sales engineering, or customer success organizations.

  • Thrives in high ambiguity, capable of inventing structure when priorities shift rapidly across a distributed, global organization.

About the Job:

As the Strategy & Operations Program Manager for Global Technical Enablement (GTE), you will serve as the operational right hand and proxy to the Head of GTE. This is not a general program-management role; your mandate is to build the operating system that runs the organization and keep the business inspection-ready at all times.

You will not have direct reports; instead, your influence and operational rigor will ensure that critical multi-team programs move smoothly from ideation to delivery. You will sit with the Head, be in the room for the decisions, carry their proxy, and govern the organization's technological, financial, and strategic resources. Ultimately, you will own the living story of the business, the cadence, the data narrative, and the cross-cutting initiatives that belong to no single team; ensuring leadership can speak to status, strategy, and risk at a moment's notice.

Wiz’s Global Technical Enablement (GTE) team is the end-to-end owner of technical product mastery. We build and execute role-based onboarding, interactive learning journeys, and hands-on lab environments that enable our technical field teams and customers to position, deploy, and optimize complex cloud solutions at scale. Operating across 8 time zones and 6 countries, we pride ourselves on dependability, radical collaboration, and continuous innovation.

To ensure the strategic value of this role is maintained, please note that it is explicitly:

  • Not a layer between the Head and the four team leaders, their direct line is unchanged.

  • Not the owner of team execution: Architecture, TLDD, Experiences, and TEDO run their own work.

  • Not an Executive Assistant: no calendar, travel, or expense ownership.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Operating Rhythm: Architect and facilitate leadership staff meetings, strategic quarterly planning, and retrospective sessions across the four GTE pillars to ensure tight cross-team alignment.

  • Drive the OKR Lifecycle: Partner with leadership to draft, cascade, and track OKRs, proactively mitigating schedule risks before they impact the business.

  • Govern the Decision Log: Ensure that nothing agreed upon leaves the room without an owner and a date, and follow through so that initiatives don't stall or quietly die after kickoff.

  • Build the Case (Tech Spend & Forecasting): Lead financial forecasting, budget tracking, and business case development specifically for the organization’s enablement infrastructure (lab environments, software licensing, tool subscriptions, and vendor platforms).

  • Vendor & Platform Lifecycle: Oversee the end-to-end renewals of GTE platforms, manage vendor relationships, and optimize the operational tech stack.

  • Access & Tech Governance: Manage the integration, provisioning, and access logistics for the org's internal and external enablement platforms, ensuring seamless workflows and security compliance.

  • Own the "Walking Deck": Maintain a continuously current narrative of the business (org, strategy, OKR status, metrics, risks, and wins) that is ready to present with zero prep.

  • Turn Data into Narrative: Partner with analysts to convert central dashboards, learner throughput, and course CSAT into the actionable story leadership needs.

  • Anticipate the Inspection: Prepare the Head of GTE for executive reviews, QBRs, skip-levels, and ad-hoc escalations by running dry-runs, producing briefing docs, and pre-empting leadership questions before they are asked.

  • Represent the Head: Act as a proxy in forums the Head cannot attend, carrying context in, bringing decisions back, and holding the room at a leadership altitude.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the primary strategic coordination bridge between GTE pillar leads and key external partners (Product Management, Product Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Support).

  • Drive Cross-Cutting Programs: Execute high-priority operational shifts, integrations, and strategic rollouts that span across multiple teams and manage complex global dependencies.

Compensation + Benefits

Compensation for this full-time position includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Learn more about benefits at Google.

With a culture rooted in customer focus, innovation, and teamwork, we lead the market in microscopy, imaging, and analysis, unveiling the invisible and empowering our customers to build a better, healthier world.

Joining Leica Microsystems means contributing to scientific discoveries and supporting surgeons in making critical decisions. The SSAI partners closely with Account Managers, Key Account Managers, and channel partners to identify, progress, and close opportunities while expanding Leica's presence within the life science research community.

Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in business operations, strategy, chief of staff roles, or technical program management, including direct support of senior leaders.

  • Proven experience managing operational tech stacks, vendor relationships, and tracking organizational budgets/OPEX or business cases.

  • Demonstrated ability to write and speak at a leadership altitude, holding the room and influencing cross-functional stakeholders without formal direct authority.

  • Exceptional ability to manage multiple complex threads, ensuring nothing is dropped, everything is documented, and decisions result in action.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in an Office-of-the-CxO or serving as a dedicated right-hand to a senior leader in a high-tech environment.

  • Familiarity with cloud concepts (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure), cybersecurity, technical lab environments, or developer platforms.

  • Experience working inside or directly partnering with technical enablement, customer engineering, sales engineering, or customer success organizations.

  • Thrives in high ambiguity, capable of inventing structure when priorities shift rapidly across a distributed, global organization.

About the Job:

As the Strategy & Operations Program Manager for Global Technical Enablement (GTE), you will serve as the operational right hand and proxy to the Head of GTE. This is not a general program-management role; your mandate is to build the operating system that runs the organization and keep the business inspection-ready at all times.

You will not have direct reports; instead, your influence and operational rigor will ensure that critical multi-team programs move smoothly from ideation to delivery. You will sit with the Head, be in the room for the decisions, carry their proxy, and govern the organization's technological, financial, and strategic resources. Ultimately, you will own the living story of the business, the cadence, the data narrative, and the cross-cutting initiatives that belong to no single team; ensuring leadership can speak to status, strategy, and risk at a moment's notice.

Wiz’s Global Technical Enablement (GTE) team is the end-to-end owner of technical product mastery. We build and execute role-based onboarding, interactive learning journeys, and hands-on lab environments that enable our technical field teams and customers to position, deploy, and optimize complex cloud solutions at scale. Operating across 8 time zones and 6 countries, we pride ourselves on dependability, radical collaboration, and continuous innovation.

To ensure the strategic value of this role is maintained, please note that it is explicitly:

  • Not a layer between the Head and the four team leaders, their direct line is unchanged.

  • Not the owner of team execution: Architecture, TLDD, Experiences, and TEDO run their own work.

  • Not an Executive Assistant: no calendar, travel, or expense ownership.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Operating Rhythm: Architect and facilitate leadership staff meetings, strategic quarterly planning, and retrospective sessions across the four GTE pillars to ensure tight cross-team alignment.

  • Drive the OKR Lifecycle: Partner with leadership to draft, cascade, and track OKRs, proactively mitigating schedule risks before they impact the business.

  • Govern the Decision Log: Ensure that nothing agreed upon leaves the room without an owner and a date, and follow through so that initiatives don't stall or quietly die after kickoff.

  • Build the Case (Tech Spend & Forecasting): Lead financial forecasting, budget tracking, and business case development specifically for the organization’s enablement infrastructure (lab environments, software licensing, tool subscriptions, and vendor platforms).

  • Vendor & Platform Lifecycle: Oversee the end-to-end renewals of GTE platforms, manage vendor relationships, and optimize the operational tech stack.

  • Access & Tech Governance: Manage the integration, provisioning, and access logistics for the org's internal and external enablement platforms, ensuring seamless workflows and security compliance.

  • Own the "Walking Deck": Maintain a continuously current narrative of the business (org, strategy, OKR status, metrics, risks, and wins) that is ready to present with zero prep.

  • Turn Data into Narrative: Partner with analysts to convert central dashboards, learner throughput, and course CSAT into the actionable story leadership needs.

  • Anticipate the Inspection: Prepare the Head of GTE for executive reviews, QBRs, skip-levels, and ad-hoc escalations by running dry-runs, producing briefing docs, and pre-empting leadership questions before they are asked.

  • Represent the Head: Act as a proxy in forums the Head cannot attend, carrying context in, bringing decisions back, and holding the room at a leadership altitude.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the primary strategic coordination bridge between GTE pillar leads and key external partners (Product Management, Product Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Support).

  • Drive Cross-Cutting Programs: Execute high-priority operational shifts, integrations, and strategic rollouts that span across multiple teams and manage complex global dependencies.

Compensation + Benefits

Compensation for this full-time position includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
