Marketing Automation Specialist (HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot & CRM) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Marketing Automation Specialist to build, manage, and optimize automated marketing campaigns, email workflows, lead nurturing programs, and CRM automation.

This is a hands-on marketing operations role focused on turning marketing systems into measurable pipeline and revenue growth.

You’ll work across:

  • HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, and other automation platforms
  • Email marketing and nurture campaigns
  • Lead scoring and lifecycle automation
  • CRM integration and lead routing
  • Audience segmentation and database management
  • Campaign analytics and optimization

If you enjoy building scalable automation systems, improving conversion rates, and connecting marketing activity to sales outcomes, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Marketing Automation & Workflows

  • Build, launch, and optimize automated marketing workflows
  • Create:
    • Lead nurture campaigns
    • Drip sequences
    • Trigger-based automations
    • Lifecycle workflows
    • Re-engagement campaigns
  • Develop and maintain lead scoring models
  • Troubleshoot workflow logic, triggers, and automation errors
  • Continuously improve automation performance and reliability

Email Marketing & Campaign Execution

  • Build and execute campaigns using:
    • HubSpot
    • Marketo
    • Pardot (Account Engagement)
    • ActiveCampaign
    • Klaviyo
  • Create and optimize email sequences for different audiences and lifecycle stages
  • Conduct A/B tests across:
    • Subject lines
    • Email copy
    • Calls-to-action (CTAs)
    • Send strategies
  • Ensure emails are mobile-responsive, brand-consistent, and conversion-focused
  • Monitor email deliverability and engagement performance

CRM, Lead Management & Sales Alignment

  • Integrate marketing automation platforms with CRMs including:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot CRM
    • Zoho CRM
  • Build and maintain accurate lead routing and handoff workflows
  • Ensure qualified leads reach sales teams quickly and correctly
  • Improve marketing-to-sales alignment across the funnel
  • Track campaign influence from initial engagement through opportunity and conversion

Lead Scoring & Audience Segmentation

  • Build and optimize lead scoring based on:
    • Engagement
    • Behavior
    • Demographics
    • Lifecycle stage
    • Buying intent
  • Create targeted audience segments based on:
    • Industry
    • Persona
    • Behavior
    • Engagement
    • Lifecycle stage
  • Maintain clean and organized marketing databases
  • Remove duplicate, inactive, and outdated records

Analytics & Reporting

  • Track key marketing metrics including:
    • Open rates
    • Click-through rates
    • Conversion rates
    • Lead-to-opportunity conversion
    • Pipeline contribution
    • Revenue impact
  • Build dashboards and reports using HubSpot, Marketo, Power BI, or Tableau
  • Analyze campaign and workflow performance
  • Provide actionable recommendations based on performance data

Marketing Operations & Optimization

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing processes
  • Test new workflows, messaging, and audience strategies
  • Improve campaign efficiency and scalability
  • Support attribution and revenue reporting
  • Maintain compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and CCPA
  • Stay current with marketing automation trends and platform updates

Requirements

Must-Have Experience

  • 2+ years of marketing automation or marketing operations experience
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major marketing automation platform:
    • HubSpot
    • Marketo
    • Pardot (Account Engagement)
    • ActiveCampaign
  • Experience building:
    • Automated workflows
    • Lead nurture campaigns
    • Email campaigns
    • Lead scoring models
    • Audience segments
  • Experience working with CRM systems and lead management workflows
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Email marketing
    • Marketing operations
    • CRM workflows
    • Email deliverability
    • Data management
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
  • High attention to detail and strong execution skills
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • HubSpot, Marketo, or Pardot certifications
  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot CRM, or Zoho CRM
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, e-commerce, or growth marketing
  • Familiarity with:
    • Multi-touch attribution
    • Revenue Operations (RevOps)
    • Marketing analytics
    • Funnel optimization
  • Experience using Zapier, APIs, or third-party integrations
  • Familiarity with Power BI or Tableau

Tools You May Use

  • HubSpot
  • Marketo
  • Pardot / Account Engagement
  • ActiveCampaign
  • Klaviyo
  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot CRM
  • Zoho CRM
  • Zapier
  • Excel / Google Sheets
  • Power BI / Tableau
  • API integrations

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think in systems, workflows, and automation
  • You enjoy building processes that scale
  • You understand how marketing automation impacts pipeline and revenue
  • You’re comfortable working across marketing and sales teams
  • You use data to identify what’s working and what needs improvement
  • You catch workflow and data issues quickly
  • You can manage multiple campaigns and automations simultaneously
  • You focus on measurable outcomes, not simply launching campaigns

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start by reviewing active campaigns, workflow performance, lead routing, and email engagement metrics.

From there, you’ll build or optimize nurture sequences, troubleshoot automation issues, update audience segments, review lead scoring, and ensure qualified leads are routed correctly to sales.

You’ll also analyze campaign performance, clean CRM data, run A/B tests, update reporting dashboards, and identify opportunities to automate manual processes.

In short: you build and optimize the automation infrastructure that turns marketing activity into qualified pipeline and revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate
  • Marketing-generated pipeline
  • Email engagement and conversion rates
  • Workflow accuracy and reliability
  • Lead routing accuracy
  • Database cleanliness and segmentation quality
  • Marketing attribution accuracy
  • Automation-driven efficiency improvements
  • Revenue contribution from marketing campaigns

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Own a function directly connected to pipeline and revenue
  • Hands-on exposure to leading marketing automation and CRM platforms
  • Build scalable systems rather than simply execute individual campaigns
  • Work across marketing, sales, CRM, and analytics
  • Fully remote environment with strong ownership
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Marketing Operations Manager
    • Revenue Operations (RevOps)
    • CRM & Automation Manager
    • Growth Marketing
    • Marketing Operations Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Marketing Automation / Workflow Assessment
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have hands-on experience with HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, or similar marketing automation platforms and enjoy building workflows that improve lead nurturing, conversions, and revenue, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build scalable marketing automation systems that drive measurable business growth.

Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of the application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire. This is an important part of our screening process and gives you an opportunity to introduce yourself, highlight your relevant experience, and share why you’re a strong fit for the role.

Please complete the Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation, as applications without a completed video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Population Health Specialist III to join our team! The Population Health Specialist III provides behavioral health clinical coordination for members with complex behavioral, social, and psychosocial needs across population health programs. The role applies behavioral health clinical judgment to assess needs, engage members in appropriate services, and coordinate care with multidisciplinary teams to improve outcomes.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Assess member needs, risks, and barriers related to behavioral health and psychosocial factors.
  • Coordinate services across providers, care teams, and community resources to support member needs.
  • Apply clinical judgment to support engagement in appropriate behavioral health and population health services.
  • Monitor member progress and adjust coordination efforts to support improved outcomes.
  • Facilitate communication among multidisciplinary teams to ensure coordinated care delivery.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules available for some positions with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Master's degree in health and human services or related field and one (1) year of experience in a clinical setting working with the population served.
  • Active North Carolina licensure as:
    • Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
    • Licensed Clinical Mental Health Counselor (LCMHC)
    • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
    • Licensed Psychological Associate (LPA)
    • Licensed Clinical Addictions Specialist (LCAS)
    • Registered Nurse (RN)
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within North Carolina.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Prefer five (5) years post-Master’s experience in a clinical setting with the BH/MH/SU/IDD population and a minimum of two (2) years Maternal health and Opioid experience.

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

raw.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Mexico

About the team

The Senior Solution Consultant as a fully proficient professional will be responsible for understanding Kinaxis customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and will be committed to helping our customers solve complex issues in their supply chain management practice. The incumbent will work with new and existing customers and will provide expert guidance in integrating our product offerings so that our customers can start to experience the immediate value of Kinaxis solutions.

The incumbent will act as a functional lead on projects by providing consulting services and leadership during deployment of Maestro supply chain software and leverage advanced knowledge of the product and supply chain industry trends and best practices to achieve desired outcomes.

What you will do

  • Independently lead business requirements discovery sessions for implementations of advanced complexity, multi-phase workstreams and broad scope.
  • Partner with Solution Architect in the process design and technical direction of complex configurations.
  • Execute product configurations of advanced complexity, according to customer needs and approved solution architecture.
  • Act as the first level of escalation and oversee the troubleshooting and resolution of complex configuration issues for the project team.
  • Apply advanced mathematical models, optimization techniques and artificial intelligence algorithms to complex supply chain planning scenarios to improve customer supply chain performance and achieve business objectives.
  • Execute the validation and testing of the solution, capture user feedback and develop recommendations for escalations, roadblocks, and documentation.
  • Independently lead complex deployment workshops with a focus on training and guiding customers on how the solution was configured and how to achieve immediate value from their investment.
  • Provide technical leadership and recommendations to the Associate, Entry and Intermediate Solution Consultants during project milestones and critical deployment escalations.
  • Guide and mentor more junior consultants throughout the project lifecycle.

Primary Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5 + years of in-depth experience in software implementation or deployment within the supply chain planning or supply chain execution space or business experience in supply planning, demand planning, inventory management, manufacturing.
  • 2 to 3 years’ experience in a functional leadership capacity for system configuration or system deployments.
  • 2 to 3 years’ experience in business process design for supply chain software implementations.
  • Passion for working in customer-facing roles and able to demonstrate strong interpersonal, communication facilitation and presentation skills.
  • Excellent problem solving and critical thinking skills, able to synthesize a high volume of complex information to determine best course of action.
  • Self-starter who shows initiative in their work and learning and can excel in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Proven leadership skills within a team as well as a successful track record with customers and executive sponsors.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative matrixed environment with multiple team members.
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing.

What we are looking for

  • Advanced level knowledge and hands-on application of supply chain best practices and concepts as it relates to forecasting, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), Constraint Management, and Production Scheduling.
  • Ability to lead complex business requirements gathering sessions with customers and system end users.
  • Experience working with supply chain processes and manufacturing planning solutions such as Maestro, SAP, Oracle or Blue Yonder applications to support supply chain activities.
  • Proficiency in SQL, R and/or Java Script.

You will play a key role in leading design thinking, supporting project teams, and contributing to the development and delivery of complex projects from concept through to construction.

Design, digital and innovation capability

We are particularly interested in candidates who are passionate about the evolving relationship between design and technology.

You should demonstrate interest and experience in:

  • Emerging digital design tools and AI-assisted workflows
    • Visualisation, data-informed design research and design optimisation
    • Integration of digital methods into concept generation and delivery processes

Freelance working considerations

This is a freelance / contract role. Candidates should therefore be able to confirm:

  • Professional Professional Indemnity (PI) insurance coverage appropriate to freelance design work

Essential

Portfolio and technical capability

Your portfolio should demonstrate a broad range of work, including:

Software and communication skills

Personal qualities

Partner Success Executive

Think you’ve got a “knack” for working on a team and want to be at the forefront of modernizing student success with one of the fastest-growing peer tutoring solutions in the country?

Knack is a leading student success platform transforming peer tutoring to help colleges and universities expand access to academic support and prepare students for success in the classroom and beyond. In partnership with colleges and universities across the country, Knack delivers affordable and impactful peer tutoring programs that help institutions build stronger student support ecosystems and improve student outcomes.

If you’re a curious, driven, and collaborative professional who wants to help modernize peer learning and make a meaningful impact on college students, look no further.

The role...

We are seeking a full-time Partner Success Executive (PSE) to join our growing Partner Success team, reporting directly to our Vice President of Partner Success. This role sits at the intersection of partner success, strategy, engagement, and growth and is ideal for someone who thrives in a cross-functional environment and enjoys building strong relationships with college and university partners.

As a PSE, you will serve as the primary relationship manager for a portfolio of partner institutions, helping partners successfully launch, engage, adopt, and grow their Knack programs. You will build trusted relationships with campus stakeholders, support retention and expansion efforts, use data to identify opportunities, and connect Knack’s work to partner goals and student success priorities.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Academic Relations to deliver a cohesive partner experience and drive successful outcomes.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who is ready to take ownership of partner relationships, contribute to growth, and develop their skills in strategic partnership management.

What you get...

  • Competitive salary & vested stock options (equity ownership)
  • Health care benefits (medical, dental, vision), 401K, and wellness stipend
  • Flexible time off
  • Work-from-home flexibility and monthly stipend
  • Company-sponsored technology and equipment
  • Company events and outings
  • Autonomy, ownership, and the opportunity to grow alongside a phenomenal and passionate team

What you get to do...

  • Manage a strategic portfolio of 10–20 college and university partners, building strong relationships and developing engagement strategies that support partner success.
  • Build trusted relationships with campus stakeholders through regular meetings, strategic touchpoints, and proactive communication.
  • Develop and execute partner engagement plans aligned to institutional priorities and Knack’s partnership goals.
  • Support successful partner launches, ongoing engagement, program adoption, and stakeholder communication.
  • Lead renewal activities and partner retention efforts, helping partners understand and realize the value of their Knack partnership.
  • Identify opportunities for growth, including expansions, upsells, referrals, and additional stakeholder adoption, and collaborate with Sales and Marketing to pursue them.
  • Conduct regular program reviews and strategic conversations to assess progress, identify challenges, and uncover opportunities for improvement and growth.
  • Leverage partner data and insights to provide clear, actionable recommendations that strengthen program performance, engagement, and impact.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Academic Relations to ensure a seamless partner experience and alignment across the partner lifecycle.
  • Partner with internal teams to increase program visibility, stakeholder engagement, and campus adoption.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing, process improvements, and strategic initiatives that strengthen the Partner Success organization.
  • Travel as needed to support partner engagement, relationship development, and growth opportunities.

This may be for you if...

  • You have 4-6+ years of experience in higher education, sales, account management, customer success, program management, or partnership management. EdTech experience is a plus.
  • You are passionate about education and student success and excited by the opportunity to make a tangible impact.
  • You excel at building relationships and are comfortable engaging with a range of campus stakeholders.
  • You are proactive, organized, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can take ownership and make an impact.
  • You have experience managing relationships, projects, accounts, or programs and are comfortable balancing multiple priorities.
  • You enjoy working with data and can translate insights into clear recommendations and next steps.
  • You are comfortable identifying opportunities for partner growth and collaborating with internal teams to pursue them.
  • You thrive in collaborative environments and are equally comfortable contributing to a team and taking the lead when needed.
  • You are willing to travel as needed to support partner engagement and growth opportunities.
  • You value teamwork, mission-driven work, accessibility, and supporting student success.

Extra Credit!

  • Experience with peer tutoring or peer programs in higher education
  • EdTech experience
  • Experience as a peer tutor or in student support roles
  • Experience working directly with colleges and universities
  • Experience connecting programs or services to student success outcomes

About Knack

Knack Technologies, Inc. launched in 2016 at the University of Florida by a founding team who came together to build peer communities that would be more enjoyable, relevant, and effective than traditional learning environments.

Today, we enable college students to connect with each other for in-person and online tutoring by offering an award-winning peer tutoring platform with web and mobile applications that are equal parts functional and aesthetic. We partner with some of the largest universities in the U.S., serving thousands of students, tutors, and college administrators every single day.

We’re proud to be backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors including Jeff Vinik (Owner, Tampa Bay Lightning), Precursor Ventures, Bellini Capital Partners, Bisk Education Ventures, Elysium Venture Capital, Arizona State University Enterprise Partners, TiE Tampa Bay Angel Fund, and Alex Sink (Former CFO, State of Florida).

We’ve been featured on Inc.com, Forbes, TechCrunch, EdSurge, ELearning Inside, Entrepreneur.com, USA Today, and many other well-known publications/media outlets. Our team has won numerous awards including the 2019 Lumina Foundation’s Education Innovation Prize, UF’s Big Idea Business Plan Competition, Village Capital’s 2018 Education Program, the 2015 Thiel Summit Pitch Competition, and the 2017 1776 Challenge Cup.

This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video
  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation
  • Complete a few clips per recording session

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed
  • Recording environment: A quiet room with no background music, TV, traffic, or other people talking
  • Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required
  • Note: Quiet, clean audio matters most - background noise or unclear speech can affect approval

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: earn up to $30/hour depending on your pace and approval rate
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Clinical Implementation Consultant serves as the clinical subject matter expert responsible for translating utilization management requirements into consistent operational workflows and technology solutions. This role provides clinical leadership for enterprise initiatives by interpreting clinical requirements and ensuring they are accurately implemented across clinical decision support tools, electronic prior authorization, claims operations, and supporting technology platforms.
Working collaboratively with Medical Directors, Referrals and Authorizations, Claims, Product, and Technology, this position ensures new clinical services, procedure codes, and utilization management requirements are implemented consistently throughout the organization while improving provider experience, operational efficiency, and clinical accuracy.
Our Government Contract Requires US Citizenship for this Position

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Responsible for governance of new clinical procedure codes and ensuring those decisions are accurately and consistently implemented across systems and teams.

Lead key clinical technology solutions by serving as the business owner for CareWebQI and the clinical lead for ePA, partnering with Product and Technology teams to improve workflows and drive automation opportunities.

Connect Medical Directors, Claims, Referrals and Authorizations, Technology, and Product to support aligned decision-making and effective cross-functional collaboration and continuous improvement initiatives


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license.
  • Bachelor's degree in nursing (Master's degree preferred).
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Utilization Management, Managed Care, Clinical Operations, or related healthcare operations.
  • Applicable State licensure in field of study
  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in nursing

  • Knowledge of NCQA, URAC, and other accreditation standards related to utilization management.
  • Experience in managed care, health plan operations, or Medicare Advantage programs (including various SNP products) or Managed Medicaid.

  • Project management experience or certification (e.g., PMP, Lean Six Sigma).

Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

RQ09201 - Solutions Designer (Esri-based geospatial solutions, ArcGIS, ﻿Microsoft Azure, Oracle Spatial, MS Fabric)

﻿Remote - Based out of Ontario

﻿Contract, 6 months (with possibly of extension)

Description

To respond to the priorities of the Government of Ontario through the passage of the Bill 5, Protect Ontario by Unleashing Our Economy Act 2025, the resource may be partially assigned to Bill 5 related projects or initiatives on an as needed basis.

A Senior Solution Designer is needed to support 6 projects within the Geospatial Ontario IT Program.

  1. GIS Delivery Platform Planned Maintenance FY24-25 (7.4% allocation or 10 days of effort)
    1. This is an annually reoccurring maintenance project for the GIS Delivery Platform (GDP). Work this fiscal will focus on software patching, Portal for ArcGIS implementation, Geocortex to VertiGIS migration, Cyber Security analysis/mitigations, and platform architecture review/documentation.
  2. GIS Delivery Platform Modernization FY24-25 (11% allocation or 15 days of effort)
    1. This is a GIS infrastructure modernization project focused on implementing modern platform monitoring, analytics, and reporting middleware.
  3. GIS Delivery Platform Planned Maintenance 25-27 (41.2% allocation or 56 days of effort)
    1. This is a bi-annually reoccurring maintenance project for the GIS Delivery Platform (GDP). Work this fiscal will focus on software patching, FME, ArcGIS Server, Oracle, etc. upgrades.
  4. LIO Modernize Data Maintenance (LIO Editor) (11% allocation or 15 days of effort)
    1. LIO Editor/Mapper/Reporter toolset is a legacy GIS data maintenance solution owned by Geospatial Ontario. This project aims to perform a modernization options analysis, then create / recommend a solution design.
  5. GEO Data Maintenance Modernization (16.2% allocation or 22 days of effort)
    1. This project aims to modernize the legacy LIO Editor GIS data maintenance solution. This is an implementation project for procuring new GIS infrastructure, configuring middleware, building editing tools, procedures, and following Ontario Government IT governance standards.
  6. ArcGIS Portal (13.2% allocation or 18 days of effort)
    1. This is a new high-priority project for multiple ministries. This project focuses on provisioning required ArcGIS Enterprise infrastructure and middleware resources, configuring, then deploying a Federated Portal for multi-ministry shared usage.

General Skills:

  • Knowledge of Esri-based geospatial solutions, ArcGIS Portal, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Image Server, GIS infrastructure, middleware, maintenance, services, applications, databases, monitoring, and tools.
  • Knowledge of integrated networking technologies, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Spatial, MS Fabric, midrange server, enterprise storage, and personal computer system technologies.
  • Knowledge of related best practices, standard infrastructure/architecture management, service delivery processes, infrastructures policies, procedures and direction, cost models, and procurement processes.
  • Ability to gather client business requirements; corporate I&IT information mandates, client information technology strategic plans, environment and standards.
  • Ability to participate in the development of solutions and provide advice on short/long term solution service development activities.
  • Knowledge of leading edge technologies design criteria, security and recovery procedures, preparation of technical specifications for installation, testing and performance of integrated, multi-services systems.
  • Ability to assess performance and capacity of existing systems making recommendations for improving performance and develop technical documentation.
  • Experience planning, migrating, implementing and sustaining large complex system development projects.
  • Knowledge of technology developments, trends and new products to support short and long term technology requirements.
  • Conceptual and analytical skills to assess and evaluate client needs and conduct cost/benefit analyses for new technology requirements in planning and designing solutions.
  • Experience designing and developing large, complex, highly available, mission critical server applications.

Must Haves:

  • Experience designing solutions based on Business Analysis, Business Systems Analysis, Solution Design, Solution Development, or similar role. ﻿
  • Knowledge of Esri-based geospatial solutions, ArcGIS Portal, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Image Server, GIS infrastructure, middleware, maintenance, services, applications, databases, monitoring, and tools.
  • Knowledge of integrated networking technologies, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Spatial, MS Fabric, midrange server, enterprise storage, and personal computer system technologies.

raw.description:
About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About the Role

The best partnership leaders don't collect partners. They build the mechanism that turns partnerships into revenue.

In 2026 our ecosystem and strategic alliance partners began to scale, and now they need an owner. You’ll own that portfolio as a business: the thesis for each ecosystem, the executive relationship, the co-sell motion with Sales, the commercial structure, and the number the book produces. You’ll lead two ecosystem owners and report to the VP, Partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the thesis, sequencing, and investment case for each ecosystem and alliance: the value exchange, the mechanism that produces revenue, the executive sponsor on both sides, and the evidence it is working.
  • Carry sourced pipeline, Closed-Won revenue, and influenced revenue for the book of strategic partners against a four-quarter plan.
  • Own 2-5 Strategic Alliances while supervising the owners of platform ecosystems.
  • Establish the per-ecosystem and alliance revenue baseline with Finance and RevOps before committing to a multiple, and close the attribution gap inside your book rather than working around it.
  • Design and run the seller-to-seller co-sell motion with Sales: account mapping, joint pursuit rules, partner logging that AEs actually use, and fixed-cadence pipeline reviews with each platform's partner team.
  • Own marketplace placement, listing quality, certification, and tier standing, working each platform's own scoring metric deliberately.
  • Own ISV economics, rev-share performance, and the commercial agreements in your ecosystems alongside Finance and Legal, inside the payout envelope set centrally.
  • Escalate structural blockers such as co-sell restrictions, data-sharing limits, and fee structures as named decisions with options and a recommendation.
  • Lead, coach, and develop two direct reports: clear book, clear number, and air cover to work relationships above their level.

At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. In partnerships that means using AI on account mapping, partner research, pipeline analysis, and co-sell content.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 8+ years in partnerships, alliances, channel, or ecosystem go-to-market, including at least 2 years leading a team.
  • Proven ownership of a strategic technology or payments alliance taken from early stage to material, measurable revenue, ideally with a large corporate partner such as Stripe, PayPal, VISA, Salesforce, HubSpot, or Microsoft.
  • Demonstrated ability to build a co-sell motion that sellers on both sides adopt, not just a signed agreement.
  • Commercial fluency with rev-share models, ISV economics, and marketplace terms, with the ability to hold your own with Finance and Legal.
  • Executive presence with platform leadership, and the judgment to know when to escalate and when to absorb.
  • Operating rigor in Salesforce, Crossbeam, and partner reporting, including building a forecast and defending it.
  • A track record of improving imperfect attribution rather than routing around it.

Nice to Have

  • Payments, fintech, CRM, or nonprofit technology background.
  • Experience operating payment-network incentive agreements with acceptance, prominence, and volume-reporting obligations.

You'll Thrive Here If You…

  • Treat a missing baseline as your first deliverable, not an excuse.
  • Would rather own five relationships properly than thirty superficially.
  • Can tell the difference between a partner who likes us and a partner who sends us deals.
  • Bring structural problems forward with options attached instead of absorbing them quietly.
  • Argue your sequencing to a VP, then change it when the evidence changes.
  • Make other people's sellers better at selling with you.
  • Want your two reports to be materially more capable twelve months from now.
  • Read partner headcount, integrations shipped, and meeting volume as activity, not outcomes.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is $220k - $247k OTE
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role's requirements and location.

Perks & Benefits

  • Health, Dental, and Vision insurance covered at 100% for employees, 80% for employee plus dependents, and 70% for employees plus family.
  • FSA and HSA Spending Account.
  • 20 days of vacation, 5 sick days, 11 company holidays plus an additional 1 floating holiday.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • 100% Company-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, basic life insurance and AD&D.
  • Paid parental leave (12 weeks for primary caregivers / 6 weeks for secondary caregivers).
  • Generous home office stipend to support your remote workspace.
  • Annual professional development stipend to support your growth (e.g., workshops, courses, and seminars).
  • Charitable giving program and paid volunteer time off with registered non-profits.

***Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.***

raw.description:
Traild: Who are we? 

Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role: Want to be a part of our exciting growth journey?

We are looking for a talented, passionate, and motivated individual to join our team as a Revenue Accountant, where you will play a critical role in making sure our subscription revenue is recognised accurately and on time, in our Finance team.

You will own subscription revenue recognition and the deferred revenue schedule in Xero, take on the fixed asset register, prepayments and intercompany reconciliations, and support month-end close alongside the wider team.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on revenue recognition experience in a subscription or SaaS business, strong Xero proficiency, and the judgement to spot a transaction that does not fit the policy.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue

  • Post subscription revenue in Xero each period, in the correct period and account, in line with our revenue recognition policy
  • Own the deferred revenue schedule and reconcile it to the general ledger every month
  • Prepare revenue schedules and supporting documentation for month-end reporting and external audit
  • Review customer contracts and billing arrangements to confirm how revenue should be recognised, and raise anything that does not fit the policy
  • Investigate revenue movements month on month and explain them to the Finance Manager

Month-end schedules

  • Maintain the fixed asset register in Xero, recording additions at cost, posting depreciation, processing disposals, and reconciling the register to the general ledger monthly
  • Own the prepayments schedule, amortising over the correct period in line with the underlying agreement and releasing expired balances
  • Prepare and post intercompany transactions, reconcile balances across Traild entities each month, and prepare settlement and foreign exchange revaluation journals

Close and compliance

  • Prepare and post assigned routine journals each period, with clear supporting documentation
  • Complete bank reconciliations and investigate differences before they reach close
  • Support the month-end close, completing assigned reconciliations and tasks within agreed timelines
  • Flag unusual or unexplained transactions before they surface in reconciliations or monthly reporting
  • Assist the Finance Manager with BAS preparation and lodgement, and provide supporting documentation for audit

Supporting the team

  • Provide accounts payable support, including invoice entry and payment processing, and assist with accounts receivable as the team's volume requires
  • Cover billing during leave and peak periods
  • Use Xero and all integrated finance systems confidently and independently, flagging system issues promptly
  • Document recurring processes clearly, so they can be followed by any team member

Who You Are:

  • 3 to 5 years in a hands-on accounting role, with genuine ownership of revenue recognition rather than invoicing alone
  • Experience recognising subscription or recurring revenue, including deferred revenue schedules, ideally in a SaaS or subscription business
  • Comfortable reading a customer contract and turning it into a revenue treatment, and confident raising a transaction that does not fit the policy
  • Hands-on Xero experience is essential, and you pick up connected finance systems quickly
  • Strong Excel or Sheets for reconciliations and supporting schedules
  • Experience with month-end schedules such as fixed assets, prepayments or intercompany reconciliations, or the appetite to take them on
  • Comfortable moving between technical accounting and transactional work, and happy to assist where the team needs it
  • Experience in a scale-up or another high-volume finance environment
  • A clear, calm written communicator who works well asynchronously across time zones and keeps a reliable daily overlap with Australian business hours
  • An accounting, commerce or finance qualification, or part-qualification. Equivalent practical experience is considered, and a CPA qualification is an advantage
  • Exposure to BAS preparation and lodgement, or other Australian compliance work, is an advantage
  • Hands-on use of AI tools to speed up accounting work, with a real example you can talk through, is an advantage

Strong collaborator with an attitude embracing growth, hands-on execution, adaptability, and the scale-up spirit.

The Perks of Working at Traild  

  • Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options. 

  • Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world. 

  • We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it 

  • Our team genuinely loves working at Traild: our eNPS score is 68, where anything above 50 is considered world-class.

Please note that the final applicants for this job will be asked to consent in writing to a police check / criminal background check to the extent permitted by law in your jurisdiction of employment. Please note that Traild is an E-Verify employer.

We’re unique. You should be, too.

We’re changing lives every day. For both our patients and our team members. Are you innovative and entrepreneurial minded? Is your work ethic and ambition off the charts? Do you inspire others with your kindness and joy?

We’re different than most primary care providers. We’re rapidly expanding and we need great people to join our team.

The Advanced Practice Provider (APP), CareLine, PRN is responsible for diagnostic patient care primarily through virtual, remote consultation via video conference or telephone. Providing on-call coverage, the incumbent in this role serves as the dispositional authority for after-hours and weekend clinical calls. He/She is accountable for assessing, diagnosing, treating and precisely documenting geriatric patients’ physical and psychosocial health status through the collection of health data.

To maintain a per diem position on our after hours telehealth urgent care line, the encumbent in this position will work a minimum of 72 hours per every three months on the weekend. Weekend shifts are typically 10-12 hours each.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • This is a PRN/Per Diem position, requiring a minimum of 160 hours per year, with scheduling flexibility based on the needs of the department.
  • Works on an as-needed basis, including nights, weekends and holidays.
  • Expected to pick up shifts to cover PTO, LOA and other unexpected absences, with some shifts being planned in advance and others requiring minimal notice.
  • Through virtual video conference or telephone, assesses acute and non-acute clinical problems. Performs and documents physical evaluations and patient histories, analyzes trends in patient conditions and develops, documents and implements a patient management plan based on interpretation of findings. Aids in the development of a plan of care that may include health education, physician referrals, case management referrals and patient/family counseling.
  • Evaluates need for immediate nursing intervention, consultation and/or referral and facilitates the necessary patient care.
  • Plans patient care based on knowledge of the patient population and/or protocol. Considers the patient’s cultural background, level of understanding, personality and support systems to anticipate and identify physiological and/or psychological problems. Serves as patient advocate.
  • Collects comprehensive and focused data relating to the health needs of patients and families. Analyzes data to determine appropriate health maintenance and/or improvement methods.
  • Confers with the patient’s PCP and other medical providers to report health data and ensure compliance with guidelines.
  • Consults with patients and/or family members on health outcomes and works with them to maintain positive health habits and/or improve opportunities.
  • Leads efforts to ensure achievement of optimal patient outcomes through use of Telemedicine. Collaborates with on-call PCP, as needed, to support expected clinical outcomes. Implements the appropriate protocol to attain expected outcomes. Evaluate progress toward expected outcomes.
  • Documents assessments, interventions and progress toward outcomes in an easy-to-understand and translate format.
  • Works with key contributors to enhance the quality of telehealth practices and systems through the utilization of data demonstrating program effectiveness and success.
  • Communicates using a variety of formats, tools and technologies to build professional relationships and deliver care across the continuum.
  • Utilizes appropriate resources to plan and provide services that are safe, effective and financially responsible.
  • Provides extraordinary customer service and professionalism to all internal and external customers.
  • May also participate in clinical rounds and conferences, risk and quality management programs, clinical and other relevant meetings.
  • Adheres to strict departmental goals/objectives, standards of performance, regulatory compliance, quality patient care compliance, policies, and procedures. Practices in accordance with a written or electronic practice agreement.
  • Participates with the physician in the formulation of telehealth/telemedicine policies, procedures and protocols.
  • Performs other duties as assigned and modified at manager’s discretion.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Expert-level business acuity
  • Expert knowledge and understanding of general/core job-related functions, practices, processes, procedures, techniques and methods
  • Knowledge and understanding of medical practices to function independently as a certified practitioner and in collaboration and consultation with licensed physicians, specialists and other medical providers
  • Demonstrated record of consistently achieving clinical performance metrics
  • Technical capability to conduct telemedicine visits in accordance with state and federal regulations
  • Ability to demonstrate excellent clinical judgement
  • Ability to problem solve
  • Ability to prioritize and work under pressure
  • Ability to provide constructive feedback
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with physicians, patients and other team members in a professional manner
  • Ability to operate effectively with a multidisciplinary team
  • Ability and willingness to travel locally, within south Florida to attend meetings and trainings up to 10% of the time. Depending on the assigned schedule required availability to work evenings/overnights and/or weekends.
  • Minimum requirement to work three holidays in the calendar year.
  • Proficient skill in Microsoft Office Suite products including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook; competent in keyboarding and other systems required for the position
  • Spoken and written fluency in English; bilingual (Spanish/Creole) a plus
  • This job requires use and exercise of independent judgment
  • Acquires knowledge and skills to maintain expertise in area of practice.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE CRITERIA:

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing (BSN) and graduate of a school of nursing for Advanced Practice Nursing with certification in area of specialty required; Master's degree in Nursing required.
  • Valid, active Registered Nurse license required
  • For NPs: Board certification by AANP or ANCC required
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross required w/in first 90 days of employment
  • Current DEA number from the DEA for schedule II-V controlled substances may be required based on State of practice
  • Multi state licensure to include FL, VA, and at least 2 licenses in the following states: GA, KS, MI, MO, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, IL, KY, LA.
  • A minimum of 3 years' acute/primary care clinical work experience required
  • A minimum of 2 years' telehealth work experience preferred

PAY RANGE:

$53.4 - $76.33 Hourly

Final compensation will depend on a variety of factors including but not limited to experience, education, geographic location, and other relevant factors. Job Summary

We seek an experienced Project Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Strategic Planning Division (SPD)/Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI). CCPI advances VHA as a center for the development of data-driven, value-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden, and leads legislatively directed pilot initiatives. This role will serve as the Task Order (TO) Project Manager, the primary Contractor point of contact with SPD/CCPI and the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), supporting a portfolio of up to six concurrent pilots and associated CCPI program management activities, working closely with the contract-aligned Program Director, workstream leads, and Government leadership to ensure task order requirements are executed consistently and in accordance with VA standards and enterprise objectives.

Primary Responsibilities

The Project Manager is responsible for maintaining the Government-approved Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Charter, integrated schedule, milestones, RAID Log, and Stakeholder Registry, and for developing and maintaining a Portfolio Management Dashboard that provides portfolio-wide visibility into status, milestones, risks, dependencies, decision points, and funding across all active pilots and workstreams. This includes leading a weekly status meeting with the COR and producing a Weekly Task Report; preparing a semi-monthly budget and schedule tracker and a Monthly Progress Report covering budget, schedule, staffing, and performance; and preparing scoping letters for emerging in-scope requirements, as requested by the Government. The role also facilitates working sessions, stakeholder meetings, and decision-making forums, and maintains centralized repositories, action trackers, and risk/issue logs necessary to support program continuity and portfolio oversight.

In this role, the Project Manager collaborates with the Program Director, Pilot Project Manager, Stakeholder Engagement & Communications Specialist, and Technical Writer/Editor to ensure coordinated execution across the SPD/CCPI portfolio and supports development of executive-ready briefing materials for SES leadership, governance bodies, and Congressional reporting. Responsibilities include tracking approved scope changes; maintaining organized project files using version control and records management practices; and providing Government customers with timely reporting on status, schedule, risks, issues, and performance metrics to support informed decision-making.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (BA/BS)
  • Minimum four (4) years of experience successfully managing a large-scale, complex program encompassing multiple projects
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, with a minimum of four (4) years' experience supporting a large corporation or government agency, preferably a large health care organization
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States (no visa sponsorship).

Desired Qualifications

  • Master’s degree
  • Eight (8) or more years of experience managing large-scale, complex programs or projects, preferably within a large health care organization
  • Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or Veterans Health Administration (VHA), particularly program/portfolio management, pilot or innovation programs, or value-based health care initiatives
  • Familiarity with federal health care environments and legislatively directed pilot programs, waiver processes, or enterprise transformation initiatives
  • Experience developing executive-level dashboards, status reporting, and portfolio-management tools for senior leadership, governance boards, or Congressional audiences
  • Additional relevant certification(s) (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, Change Management)

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Founded: 2012. Employees: 300+ nationwide.

Coder I
Location: Remote
Organization: Premier Orthopaedics, in partnership with Philadelphia Hand to Shoulder

Overview

Premier Orthopaedics, in partnership with Philadelphia Hand to Shoulder, is seeking a dedicated and skilled Coder to join our team remotely. As two of the region’s most respected providers of orthopedic and upper extremity care, we offer a collaborative, patient-focused environment that prioritizes clinical excellence, innovation, and ongoing professional development.

Position Summary

This role is responsible for accurately reviewing medical records and assigning ICD-10 and CPT codes in compliance with all applicable policies and regulations. It manages patient demographics, clinical documentation, and billing data across practice management systems and hospital records to ensure proper coding and reimbursement. The position also supports and educates clinical staff and providers on documentation and coding standards to promote compliance, accuracy, and effective communication. This is a full time remote Monday-Friday position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Abstracts data in compliance with national, regional, and local policies, and interprets and reviews medical record documentation to assign accurate ICD-10 diagnosis and CPT procedure codes.
  • Utilizes practice management system (PMS) to accurately account for demographics and services performed for all scheduled and unscheduled surgical cases according to standard procedures and coding guidelines.
  • Utilizes individual hospital medical record systems and coordinates with physicians and staff to obtain clinical documents and demographics required for appropriate coding and billing for all hospital procedures.
  • Provides education and support to clinical areas regarding appropriate documentation and coding of services to achieve accurate billing. Maintains effective communication with providers concerning coding issues.

Qualifications

Education:

  • High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge preferred.

Licenses & Certifications

  • Accredited by the American Health Information Management Association (CCS-P) or the American Academy of Professional Coders (CPC).

Experience:

  • Newly obtained coding certification to three years experience in provider coding and medical terminology with extensive knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPC Coding required.
  • Preferred specialty experience in areas of Orthopaedics, Neurology, Physical Medicine, and Rehabilitation of Pain Management.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision plans
  • 100% employer-paid life insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Benefits begin the first of the month following hire date (for full-time employees)
  • Generous paid sick and vacation time
  • 7 paid holidays annually
  • Opportunities for growth and advancement
  • Employee referral reward program

About Premier Orthopaedics & Philadelphia Hand to Shoulder

Premier Orthopaedics and Philadelphia Hand to Shoulder Center (PHSC) are leading providers of comprehensive musculoskeletal care throughout Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Delaware.

Premier Orthopaedics delivers expert treatment for orthopedic injuries, joint disease, interventional spine care, regenerative medicine, and comprehensive physical therapy services, supported by more than 150 providers across 50+ locations. Our facilities include state-of-the-art MRI centers, outpatient surgery centers, physical therapy clinics, and orthopedic urgent care centers to ensure timely access to high-quality, patient-focused care.

Philadelphia Hand to Shoulder Center (PHSC), a division of Premier Orthopaedics, has been nationally recognized for more than 50 years for its specialized care of the hand, wrist, elbow, arm, and shoulder. Our fellowship-trained surgeons and certified Hand and Occupational Therapists collaborate to provide seamless care—from diagnosis and treatment to post-operative and rehabilitative recovery. With 14 convenient locations across Pennsylvania and New Jersey, PHSC offers advanced, integrated care to restore function, mobility, and quality of life for patients with upper extremity conditions.

Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

Job Description

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Enter and maintain all prices in JDE system for assigned markets/products
  • Process all assigned resin and general price changes using the Resin Contract Analysis program
  • Maintain customer required excel price lists and Customer Price Portals
  • Troubleshoot price entry issues with Customer Service and Sales
  • Perform root cause analysis and define corrective action for price errors
  • Generate all JDE price lists for assigned products/markets
  • Maintain customer contact lists for price letter distribution
  • Analyze and improve processes for pricing/quoting long term
  • Special pricing related projects as needed

Required Qualifications:


  • Must be highly organized, detailed and proficient in Excel
  • Exceptional organizational, analytical and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and with teams
  • Previous administrative experience
  • JDE experience a plus
  • Ability to travel as required (minimal)
  • Ability to maintain absolute confidentiality

Our Expectations

We expect our people to be guided by The Amcor Way and demonstrate our Values every day to enable the business to win. We are winning when:

  • Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team
  • Our customers grow and prosper from Amcor’s quality, service, and innovation
  • Our investors benefit from Amcor’s consistent growth and superior returns
  • The environment is better off because of Amcor’s leadership and products

E-Verify

We verify the identity and employment authorization of individuals hired for employment in the United States.

Benefits

When you join Amcor, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits and compensation package that includes:

  • Medical, dental and vision plans

At LendingPoint, we believe that everyone deserves to feel the power of possibilities. As an online fintech company, we’ve created advanced consumer, small business, and merchant point-of-sale lending solutions to unlock access to affordable loans and empower those working to build their financial potential. By creating technology that sees your potential, we’re driving a better lending and borrowing experience by finding more reasons to say “yes.”

More than just a job, LendingPoint is an exciting career choice where you’ll bring your expertise and experience to a talented team focused on fostering positive new customer experiences that inspire loyalty.

Are we speaking about you? Then keep reading.

What’s In It For You?

  • Competitive Base Salary
  • Excellent Benefits Package That Includes: Medical/Dental/Vision, 401(k) match, Paid Holidays, and more!
  • Team Oriented Fast-Paced Fun Environment
  • Dedicated and experienced Management Team
  • On-going training and investment in our employees

What You’ll Do Day to Day:

LendingPoint is looking for a Lead Data Scientist who can efficiently lead and evolve our direct mail and email program. This person will build datasets and dashboards to drive analytical insights, develop and implement predictive models for direct mail and email targeting strategies, support planning and execution of this program to meet acquisition goals.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with B2C FinTech models and have the ability to contribute new thinking to position the LendingPoint brand and products to achieve both short and long-term goals. They will have the skill set to manage this channel alongside their counterparts to develop an integrated marketing plan that meets sales and profitability expectations.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Solve business problems by leveraging techniques such as segmentation, optimization, advanced analytics and machine learning
  • Create reports and dashboards to closely monitor performance metrics and provide insights
  • Automate datasets, production process and reporting to solve for analytical needs
  • Create test plans to drive growth in applicants and customers
  • Create campaign performance measurement framework
  • Execute plans to drive deeper engagement, loyalty and lifetime value
  • Collaborate with web and digital marketing peers to enable cross channel campaigns
  • Maintain ROI goals, CAC and other performance benchmarks

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative or related field (e.g., Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Finance, etc.); Master’s degree preferred
  • Minimum of two years’ experience, preferably in integrated marketing or analytics roles
  • Experience/knowledge of personal lending, banking or fintech
  • Ability to use data and best practices to think critically, problem-solve, and recommend solutions
  • Experience with statistical modeling, creative testing and advanced analytics
  • Proficient in SQL, Python, etc.

Job Title: Account Partner Commercial

Job Location: Berlin, Germany

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Commercial Account Partner, you will manage a broad spectrum of Pharmaceutical Customers and Prospects across the DACH region, with responsibility for all Veeva Commercial Cloud Solutions.

You will be responsible for winning new logos, maintaining and growing our existing business, and managing strategic relationships at an HQ/affiliate level within the region.

A strong understanding of the life science industry, B2B sales cycles and a passion forsolving business issues with innovative data and technology is ideal.

What You'll Do

    • Manage and grow relationships with key stakeholders across Business, IT, and C-level within our customers
    • Lead cross functional/regional teams to achieve targets and renewals
    • Meet/exceed pipeline generation and revenue targets including annual renewals
    • Manage complex sales cycles, utilizing internal and external resources as appropriate
    • Act with urgency, integrity, and a focus on the customer
    • Protect and expand Veeva's footprint in the region through robust daily account management, new customer acquisition, a strong focus on operational excellence, and a passion for understanding and supporting your customer’s business and IT goals
    • Oversee and coach the multi-functional global account team with robust internal governance to drive innovation and enable execution excellence
    • Navigate complex sales cycles, articulate contextual value propositions, and negotiate key contracts and annual renewals of licenses
    • Manage account administration and actively provide input for accurate forecasting
    • Keep current with industry trends and expand knowledge of legacy and novel Veeva offerings

Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience selling software (SaaS). Experience selling into Life Sciences is highly recommended but not mandatory
    • Proven hunter profile: demonstrated track record of new logo acquisition, outbound prospecting and opening doors in accounts with no prior relationship
    • Entrepreneurial mindset: treats the territory as their own business, builds their own territory plan, generates their own pipeline and takes full ownership of results
    • A self-starter able to work autonomously with minimal supervision, internally driven, does not wait for leads or instructions
    • Has run complex and consultative sales cycles with multiple internal and external stakeholders including Business, IT and Procurement
    • Ability to articulate business cases and value propositions to CxO level executives
    • Fluent written and verbal communication in German and English is required
    • Lives in Switzerland or Germany

Nice to Have

    • Strong network across Life Sciences companies in the DACH region
    • Understanding and familiarity with selling AI solutions

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Veeva Giving: 1% of your annual salary for donations to charitable causes
    • Fitness reimbursement
    • Health Insurance
    • Pension Contribution

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 140,000 - 250,000 EUR
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals.
