raw.excerpt: Do you crave a career that truly makes an impact in people’s lives?
raw.description:
Do you crave a career that truly makes an impact in people’s lives? Do you thrive on problem-solving and finding solutions? Join a dedicated, tight-knit team that creates an immediate and meaningful impact every day

Leidos QTC Health Services is seeking a Fleet Supervisor on our Mobile Clinic Operations Team. As the Fleet Supervisor you will plan, organize, and direct fleet functions, services, and activities to ensure safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-efficient transportation services in support of mobile clinical operations. This role supervises Class A and clinical drivers and fleet administration staff and oversees the proper maintenance and modification of mobile medical clinics and support vehicles to ensure DOT/FMCSA compliance and employee safety during travel and clinic operations. The Fleet Supervisor drives continuous improvement in fleet uptime, operating cost per mile, driver safety, and regulatory audit readiness.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supervise a team of Class A and clinical drivers and/or fleet administration staff to effectively deliver fleet functions, services, and activities; recommend improvements to fleet operations to meet current and future business needs; responsible for hiring, onboarding, performance appraisals, and recognition/disciplinary actions.
  • Ensure FMCSA/DOT compliance across fleet activities — Driver Qualification Files (DQF), hours-of-service (HOS), drug & alcohol testing, vehicle inspection and maintenance records, DVIRs, registration, IFTA, and permits — in collaboration with the Logistics Manager and Fleet Coordinators.
  • Maintain and periodically audit Driver Qualification Files per 49 CFR Part 391, including MVRs, medical certificates, applications, road tests, and pre-employment screenings.
  • Oversee HOS compliance and the ELD program per 49 CFR Part 395: monitor logs, address violations, run exception reports, and enforce corrective actions, partnering with Fleet Coordinators on day-to-day execution.
  • Review all vehicle maintenance and inspection records per 49 CFR Part 396; assist with vehicle inspections, preventive maintenance scheduling, repairs, and parts inventory to minimize downtime and extend asset life, in coordination with the Logistics Manager.
  • Oversee and maintain the electronic, cloud-based vehicle and staff reporting system, ensuring fleet availability for operational requests at all times and accurate recordkeeping for all vehicle-related services.
  • Oversee pre- and post-trip inspections; ensure DVIR corrective actions and timely closure of work orders in the maintenance system; support roadside inspection readiness and promptly correct out-of-service (OOS) conditions.
  • Monitor weather and other conditions that may impact routes and locations and advise on alternative routes for the safety of staff and vehicles; review routes and travel plans with Fleet Coordinators to optimize safety and efficiency.
  • Communicate with drivers, verbally and in writing, to understand needs and implement solutions; may authorize emergency repairs, vehicle replacement, and other associated costs.
  • Monitor and analyze fleet KPIs — uptime, MTTR, cost per mile, fuel economy, idle time, and accident rate — and collaborate with the Logistics Manager and Fleet Coordinators to develop and implement improvement plans.
  • Ensure driver medical certification and Drug & Alcohol Clearinghouse compliance; assist with coordination of DOT-mandated drug & alcohol testing (pre-employment, random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion) in collaboration with Human Resources.
  • Assist with incidents and accidents; coordinate with Claims, Legal, and Safety teams; collect evidence and prepare incident reports with corrective actions in accordance with company policy and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with and coordinate driver recruiting, onboarding, training, and retention in partnership with Human Resources; ensure licensing and training renewals, and coordinate re-certification as regulations change.
  • Provide oversight of driver travel cards, MHC payment cards, and fuel card usage and charges.
  • Ensure compliance with multi-state Highway Use Tax (HUT) and Weight-Mile Tax requirements (e.g., New York HUT, Oregon Weight-Mile Tax, and comparable Kentucky, New Mexico, and Connecticut programs) across applicable operating states.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in a related discipline (Logistics or Business Operations preferred), or equivalent combined education and experience.
  • Valid Class A Commercial Driver's License (CDL) required, with 5+ years of CDL driving experience.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in transportation, supervising drivers and coordinating activities for 5 or more vehicles, preferably in a healthcare environment.
  • 5+ years of experience with cloud-based fleet/personnel management systems highly desirable.
  • Valid U.S. driver's license and ability/willingness to drive between work locations.
  • Must be able to successfully pass National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI) background investigation

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Regulatory compliance and DOT/FMCSA audit readiness.
  • Safety-first mindset and incident response.
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to prioritize and delegate effectively; coaching, staffing, and performance management.
  • Experience with electronic logging devices (ELD) and cloud-based fleet/personnel management systems.
  • Ability to effectively manage competing priorities with a sense of urgency.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and cross-functional collaboration under pressure.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to effectively prioritize work.
  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite.
  • Strong sense of responsibility, creativity, self-motivation, and ability to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service.
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule (e.g., weekends, after-hours availability) and travel up to 40% of the time.

Additional Information: (only add applicable items)

  • Job Location: Remote
  • Travel requirements: up to 40% of the time or per business needs

About Leidos QTC Health Services

Leidos QTC Health Services collaborates closely with government and non-government customers to address current and future program needs within the health services domain. We specialize in disability-focused medical examinations, independent medical exams and review services, occupational health services, diagnostic testing, and case management solutions. As innovators, we focus on advancing technologies that improve service delivery, with a particular emphasis on enhancing accessibility for examinees in rural communities. With a proven track record of continuous improvement and steady growth, we now handle over 2 million appointments annually. Visit for more information.

Compensation and Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. As a result, we offer meaningful and engaging careers to support you and your career goals, all while nurturing a healthy work-life balance. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available here.

This role may fall under the Service Contract Act (SCA), a federal law which provides for a U.S. Department of Labor-prescribed minimum prevailing rate of pay and certain benefit levels. Where appropriate, Company-provided benefit plans such as comprehensive leave, holiday, medical, dental, life, accident, disability coverages, retirement plan contributions, and other health and welfare benefits and payments are utilized to meet these obligations.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos QTC Health Services will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

Organize and implement all aspects and technical portions of core and supplemental underage drinking and drunk driving prevention programs for targeted populations at the State and Local level. Responsible for all program administration including regular liaison and reporting, achievement of established performance objectives, development of programs to achieve objectives and adherence to all program and/or grant policies and guidelines.

This is a remote position, which requires the selected candidate to reside in Lee, Collier, or Charlotte County, FL. This position pays $47,500 annually.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure that goals and objectives as designated by MADD management and/or the grantor are achieved by developing and designing events targeted to accomplish specific objectives and providing marketing and outreach of the program to community agencies. Ensure that grant proposals include MADD’s program directives.
  • Manage the implementation and logistics of adult drunk driving prevention and underage drinking prevention programs through the design and facilitation of training programs at the State and Local level.
  • Organize and host orientation meetings, evaluation meetings, facilitator training and facilitation of parent workshops and student presentations.
  • Source and recruit volunteers, as needed, for applicable programs. Provide training, guidance, support and motivation to volunteers and staff by conducting training meetings, telephone coaching and on-site assistance.
  • Coordinate logistics for MADD events (e.g., LER, Move with MADD).
  • Oversee volunteer engagement and ensure brand consistency.
  • Participate in and support fundraising activities, including community engagement and donor outreach, to help supplement program support beyond grant funding as required.
  • Support sponsorship development and donor relations.
  • Assist in achieving fundraising goals with the manager and partners.
  • Maintain tracking and data collection of programs and/or grant results, financial reports, and the progress for evaluation and improvement. Identify areas that are not fully utilizing the resources available and ensure assistance is provided in a timely manner.
  • Participate in the implementation of National program evaluation measures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field such as Human Services or equivalent experience.
  • One to two years’ experience in work with the implementation of community awareness, education, partnership and youth programs specifically related to community health.
  • Previous experience working with programs or grant administration helpful.
  • Travel and flexible hours are required.
  • Requires experience or demonstrated ability in outreach, community engagement, and grassroots or donor-focused fundraising strongly preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills, be detail oriented with the ability to prioritize, manage multiple projects, and execute in a high-volume environment.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to develop and convey thoughts clearly, logically, and concisely both orally and in writing, using appropriate grammar and command of the English language.
  • Ability to work both independently and with others to resolve issues and maintain composure and professionalism in an environment of changing and/or multiple priorities.
  • Must be able to work on a timetable, meet deadlines, follow instructions, and accept direction on given assignments.
  • Strong work ethic with the ability to maintain a high activity level.
  • Must have exceptional internal and external customer service orientation.
  • Must have demonstrated computer skills including Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook and be familiar with entering data into on-line systems. Should also have basic record keeping and math skills.
  • Ability to maintain social, ethical, and organizational standards in job related activities, at work and in the community.
  • Ability to maintain workplace confidentiality and take ownership/accountability for own actions and aspects of the job.

Responsibilities

Position OverviewPeraton is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to support the CMS ClaimsCore modernization program. The successful candidate will combine strong technical program leadership with deep systems‑integration experience and practical knowledge of Medicare claims processing, shared services, beneficiary data, eligibility, interfaces, and data migration.

This individual will provide technical leadership across ClaimsCore integration, migration, interface planning, and claims‑processing activities as the program transitions from Proof of Concept (PoC) into production implementation. The role operates at the intersection of Medicare business operations, claims adjudication, systems engineering, data flows, interfaces, and program execution.

The candidate must be technically conversant and able to translate complex Medicare operational and technical requirements—including beneficiary/eligibility dependencies, provider data, historical claims information, and EDI/X12 transaction flows—into executable plans. The TPM will coordinate teams across Peraton, CMS, MACs, Cognizant/Facets, federal partners, and supporting vendors, ensuring alignment across integration, testing, cutover, and production‑readiness activities.

The TPM is expected to identify cross‑system dependencies, resolve technical issues and integration blockers, support interface discovery and specification development, and lead production workstream execution through implementation waves, cutover, onboarding, and stabilization.

Key Responsibilities• Lead complex technical initiatives involving systems integration, data migration, claims‑processing capabilities, and Medicare shared services.• Develop and manage integrated implementation plans covering interfaces, data flows, configuration, testing, operational readiness, and production transition.• Coordinate technical activities across application development, integration, infrastructure, security, data, testing, and business teams.• Lead interface discovery and planning activities, including current‑state analysis, requirements, ICD/spec development, testing, certification, cutover, and production readiness.• Work with CMS, MACs, and SMEs to understand beneficiary, eligibility, provider, claims history, claim‑status, adjudication, and pricing/editing dependencies.• Lead complex data‑migration activities including source‑system analysis, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, historical‑data use, data quality, and migration validation.• Ensure migration/integration designs incorporate historical claims information, accumulators, beneficiary/eligibility attributes, and provider data required to process future claims.• Coordinate implementation planning with ClaimsCore adjudication services and CMS shared services (e.g., CWF, PECOS, HIGLAS, pricing/editing services).• Drive resolution of cross‑team dependencies, technical issues, architectural decisions, risks, and implementation blockers.• Develop executive‑level status updates, recommendations, risk assessments, and implementation‑readiness materials.• Support production planning including MAC onboarding, phased implementation waves, cutover, operational readiness, and stabilization.• Define measurable entry/exit criteria and completion evidence for major implementation milestones.• Facilitate technical working sessions with CMS, MACs, vendors, and engineering teams, translating discussions into clear decisions and accountable actions.• Provide leadership to multidisciplinary teams and assume responsibility for a major ClaimsCore production workstream.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Healthcare
  • Administration, Business, or related field; equivalent relevant experience considered.
  • 12+ years of progressively responsible technical project/program management experience in enterprise systems implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large‑scale systems‑integration initiatives involving APIs, EDI, batch/file, database, or multi‑system connectivity.

Traild: Who are we? 

Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role: Want to be a part of our exciting growth journey?

We are looking for a talented, passionate, and motivated individual to join our team as a Revenue Accountant, where you will play a critical role in making sure our subscription revenue is recognised accurately and on time, in our Finance team.

You will own subscription revenue recognition and the deferred revenue schedule in Xero, take on the fixed asset register, prepayments and intercompany reconciliations, and support month-end close alongside the wider team.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on revenue recognition experience in a subscription or SaaS business, strong Xero proficiency, and the judgement to spot a transaction that does not fit the policy.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue

  • Post subscription revenue in Xero each period, in the correct period and account, in line with our revenue recognition policy
  • Own the deferred revenue schedule and reconcile it to the general ledger every month
  • Prepare revenue schedules and supporting documentation for month-end reporting and external audit
  • Review customer contracts and billing arrangements to confirm how revenue should be recognised, and raise anything that does not fit the policy
  • Investigate revenue movements month on month and explain them to the Finance Manager

Month-end schedules

  • Maintain the fixed asset register in Xero, recording additions at cost, posting depreciation, processing disposals, and reconciling the register to the general ledger monthly
  • Own the prepayments schedule, amortising over the correct period in line with the underlying agreement and releasing expired balances
  • Prepare and post intercompany transactions, reconcile balances across Traild entities each month, and prepare settlement and foreign exchange revaluation journals

Close and compliance

  • Prepare and post assigned routine journals each period, with clear supporting documentation
  • Complete bank reconciliations and investigate differences before they reach close
  • Support the month-end close, completing assigned reconciliations and tasks within agreed timelines
  • Flag unusual or unexplained transactions before they surface in reconciliations or monthly reporting
  • Assist the Finance Manager with BAS preparation and lodgement, and provide supporting documentation for audit

Supporting the team

  • Provide accounts payable support, including invoice entry and payment processing, and assist with accounts receivable as the team's volume requires
  • Cover billing during leave and peak periods
  • Use Xero and all integrated finance systems confidently and independently, flagging system issues promptly
  • Document recurring processes clearly, so they can be followed by any team member

Who You Are:

  • 3 to 5 years in a hands-on accounting role, with genuine ownership of revenue recognition rather than invoicing alone
  • Experience recognising subscription or recurring revenue, including deferred revenue schedules, ideally in a SaaS or subscription business
  • Comfortable reading a customer contract and turning it into a revenue treatment, and confident raising a transaction that does not fit the policy
  • Hands-on Xero experience is essential, and you pick up connected finance systems quickly
  • Strong Excel or Sheets for reconciliations and supporting schedules
  • Experience with month-end schedules such as fixed assets, prepayments or intercompany reconciliations, or the appetite to take them on
  • Comfortable moving between technical accounting and transactional work, and happy to assist where the team needs it
  • Experience in a scale-up or another high-volume finance environment
  • A clear, calm written communicator who works well asynchronously across time zones and keeps a reliable daily overlap with Australian business hours
  • An accounting, commerce or finance qualification, or part-qualification. Equivalent practical experience is considered, and a CPA qualification is an advantage
  • Exposure to BAS preparation and lodgement, or other Australian compliance work, is an advantage
  • Hands-on use of AI tools to speed up accounting work, with a real example you can talk through, is an advantage

Strong collaborator with an attitude embracing growth, hands-on execution, adaptability, and the scale-up spirit.

The Perks of Working at Traild  

  • Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options. 

  • Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world. 

  • We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it 

  • Our team genuinely loves working at Traild: our eNPS score is 68, where anything above 50 is considered world-class.

Please note that the final applicants for this job will be asked to consent in writing to a police check / criminal background check to the extent permitted by law in your jurisdiction of employment. Please note that Traild is an E-Verify employer.

The Advanced Practice Provider (APP), CareLine, PRN is responsible for diagnostic patient care primarily through virtual, remote consultation via video conference or telephone. Providing on-call coverage, the incumbent in this role serves as the dispositional authority for after-hours and weekend clinical calls. He/She is accountable for assessing, diagnosing, treating and precisely documenting geriatric patients’ physical and psychosocial health status through the collection of health data.

To maintain a per diem position on our after hours telehealth urgent care line, the encumbent in this position will work a minimum of 72 hours per every three months on the weekend. Weekend shifts are typically 10-12 hours each.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • This is a PRN/Per Diem position, requiring a minimum of 160 hours per year, with scheduling flexibility based on the needs of the department.
  • Works on an as-needed basis, including nights, weekends and holidays.
  • Expected to pick up shifts to cover PTO, LOA and other unexpected absences, with some shifts being planned in advance and others requiring minimal notice.

Performs and documents physical evaluations and patient histories, analyzes trends in patient conditions and develops, documents and implements a patient management plan based on interpretation of findings. Aids in the development of a plan of care that may include health education, physician referrals, case management referrals and patient/family counseling.

The role also facilitates working sessions, stakeholder meetings, and decision-making forums, and maintains centralized repositories, action trackers, and risk/issue logs necessary to support program continuity and portfolio oversight.

In this role, the Project Manager collaborates with the Program Director, Pilot Project Manager, Stakeholder Engagement & Communications Specialist, and Technical Writer/Editor to ensure coordinated execution across the SPD/CCPI portfolio and supports development of executive-ready briefing materials for SES leadership, governance bodies, and Congressional reporting. Responsibilities include tracking approved scope changes; maintaining organized project files using version control and records management practices; and providing Government customers with timely reporting on status, schedule, risks, issues, and performance metrics to support informed decision-making.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, with a minimum of four (4) years' experience supporting a large corporation or government agency, preferably a large health care organization
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States (no visa sponsorship).

Desired Qualifications

  • Eight (8) or more years of experience managing large-scale, complex programs or projects, preferably within a large health care organization
  • Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or Veterans Health Administration (VHA), particularly program/portfolio management, pilot or innovation programs, or value-based health care initiatives
  • Familiarity with federal health care environments and legislatively directed pilot programs, waiver processes, or enterprise transformation initiatives
  • Experience developing executive-level dashboards, status reporting, and portfolio-management tools for senior leadership, governance boards, or Congressional audiences

Premier Orthopaedics, in partnership with Philadelphia Hand to Shoulder, is seeking a dedicated and skilled Coder to join our team remotely. As two of the region’s most respected providers of orthopedic and upper extremity care, we offer a collaborative, patient-focused environment that prioritizes clinical excellence, innovation, and ongoing professional development.

Position Summary

This role is responsible for accurately reviewing medical records and assigning ICD-10 and CPT codes in compliance with all applicable policies and regulations. It manages patient demographics, clinical documentation, and billing data across practice management systems and hospital records to ensure proper coding and reimbursement. The position also supports and educates clinical staff and providers on documentation and coding standards to promote compliance, accuracy, and effective communication. This is a full time remote Monday-Friday position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Abstracts data in compliance with national, regional, and local policies, and interprets and reviews medical record documentation to assign accurate ICD-10 diagnosis and CPT procedure codes.
  • Utilizes practice management system (PMS) to accurately account for demographics and services performed for all scheduled and unscheduled surgical cases according to standard procedures and coding guidelines.
  • Utilizes individual hospital medical record systems and coordinates with physicians and staff to obtain clinical documents and demographics required for appropriate coding and billing for all hospital procedures.
  • Provides education and support to clinical areas regarding appropriate documentation and coding of services to achieve accurate billing. Maintains effective communication with providers concerning coding issues.

Qualifications

Education:

  • High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge preferred.

Licenses & Certifications

  • Accredited by the American Health Information Management Association (CCS-P) or the American Academy of Professional Coders (CPC).

Experience:

  • Newly obtained coding certification to three years experience in provider coding and medical terminology with extensive knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPC Coding required.
  • Preferred specialty experience in areas of Orthopaedics, Neurology, Physical Medicine, and Rehabilitation of Pain Management.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision plans
  • 100% employer-paid life insurance

  • 7 paid holidays annually

Premier Orthopaedics and Philadelphia Hand to Shoulder Center (PHSC) are leading providers of comprehensive musculoskeletal care throughout Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Delaware.

Premier Orthopaedics delivers expert treatment for orthopedic injuries, joint disease, interventional spine care, regenerative medicine, and comprehensive physical therapy services, supported by more than 150 providers across 50+ locations. Our facilities include state-of-the-art MRI centers, outpatient surgery centers, physical therapy clinics, and orthopedic urgent care centers to ensure timely access to high-quality, patient-focused care.

Philadelphia Hand to Shoulder Center (PHSC), a division of Premier Orthopaedics, has been nationally recognized for more than 50 years for its specialized care of the hand, wrist, elbow, arm, and shoulder. raw.description:
Do you crave a career that truly makes an impact in people’s lives? Do you thrive on problem-solving and finding solutions? Join a dedicated, tight-knit team that creates an immediate and meaningful impact every day

Leidos QTC Health Services is seeking a Fleet Supervisor on our Mobile Clinic Operations Team. As the Fleet Supervisor you will plan, organize, and direct fleet functions, services, and activities to ensure safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-efficient transportation services in support of mobile clinical operations. This role supervises Class A and clinical drivers and fleet administration staff and oversees the proper maintenance and modification of mobile medical clinics and support vehicles to ensure DOT/FMCSA compliance and employee safety during travel and clinic operations. The Fleet Supervisor drives continuous improvement in fleet uptime, operating cost per mile, driver safety, and regulatory audit readiness.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supervise a team of Class A and clinical drivers and/or fleet administration staff to effectively deliver fleet functions, services, and activities; recommend improvements to fleet operations to meet current and future business needs; responsible for hiring, onboarding, performance appraisals, and recognition/disciplinary actions.
  • Ensure FMCSA/DOT compliance across fleet activities — Driver Qualification Files (DQF), hours-of-service (HOS), drug & alcohol testing, vehicle inspection and maintenance records, DVIRs, registration, IFTA, and permits — in collaboration with the Logistics Manager and Fleet Coordinators.
  • Maintain and periodically audit Driver Qualification Files per 49 CFR Part 391, including MVRs, medical certificates, applications, road tests, and pre-employment screenings.
  • Oversee HOS compliance and the ELD program per 49 CFR Part 395: monitor logs, address violations, run exception reports, and enforce corrective actions, partnering with Fleet Coordinators on day-to-day execution.
  • Review all vehicle maintenance and inspection records per 49 CFR Part 396; assist with vehicle inspections, preventive maintenance scheduling, repairs, and parts inventory to minimize downtime and extend asset life, in coordination with the Logistics Manager.
  • Oversee and maintain the electronic, cloud-based vehicle and staff reporting system, ensuring fleet availability for operational requests at all times and accurate recordkeeping for all vehicle-related services.
  • Oversee pre- and post-trip inspections; ensure DVIR corrective actions and timely closure of work orders in the maintenance system; support roadside inspection readiness and promptly correct out-of-service (OOS) conditions.
  • Monitor weather and other conditions that may impact routes and locations and advise on alternative routes for the safety of staff and vehicles; review routes and travel plans with Fleet Coordinators to optimize safety and efficiency.
  • Communicate with drivers, verbally and in writing, to understand needs and implement solutions; may authorize emergency repairs, vehicle replacement, and other associated costs.
  • Monitor and analyze fleet KPIs — uptime, MTTR, cost per mile, fuel economy, idle time, and accident rate — and collaborate with the Logistics Manager and Fleet Coordinators to develop and implement improvement plans.
  • Ensure driver medical certification and Drug & Alcohol Clearinghouse compliance; assist with coordination of DOT-mandated drug & alcohol testing (pre-employment, random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion) in collaboration with Human Resources.
  • Assist with incidents and accidents; coordinate with Claims, Legal, and Safety teams; collect evidence and prepare incident reports with corrective actions in accordance with company policy and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with and coordinate driver recruiting, onboarding, training, and retention in partnership with Human Resources; ensure licensing and training renewals, and coordinate re-certification as regulations change.
  • Provide oversight of driver travel cards, MHC payment cards, and fuel card usage and charges.
  • Ensure compliance with multi-state Highway Use Tax (HUT) and Weight-Mile Tax requirements (e.g., New York HUT, Oregon Weight-Mile Tax, and comparable Kentucky, New Mexico, and Connecticut programs) across applicable operating states.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in a related discipline (Logistics or Business Operations preferred), or equivalent combined education and experience.
  • Valid Class A Commercial Driver's License (CDL) required, with 5+ years of CDL driving experience.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in transportation, supervising drivers and coordinating activities for 5 or more vehicles, preferably in a healthcare environment.
  • 5+ years of experience with cloud-based fleet/personnel management systems highly desirable.
  • Valid U.S. driver's license and ability/willingness to drive between work locations.
  • Must be able to successfully pass National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI) background investigation

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Regulatory compliance and DOT/FMCSA audit readiness.
  • Safety-first mindset and incident response.
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to prioritize and delegate effectively; coaching, staffing, and performance management.
  • Experience with electronic logging devices (ELD) and cloud-based fleet/personnel management systems.
  • Ability to effectively manage competing priorities with a sense of urgency.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and cross-functional collaboration under pressure.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to effectively prioritize work.

Responsibilities

Position OverviewPeraton is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to support the CMS ClaimsCore modernization program. This individual will provide technical leadership across ClaimsCore integration, migration, interface planning, and claims‑processing activities as the program transitions from Proof of Concept (PoC) into production implementation. The role operates at the intersection of Medicare business operations, claims adjudication, systems engineering, data flows, interfaces, and program execution.

The candidate must be technically conversant and able to translate complex Medicare operational and technical requirements—including beneficiary/eligibility dependencies, provider data, historical claims information, and EDI/X12 transaction flows—into executable plans. The TPM will coordinate teams across Peraton, CMS, MACs, Cognizant/Facets, federal partners, and supporting vendors, ensuring alignment across integration, testing, cutover, and production‑readiness activities.

The TPM is expected to identify cross‑system dependencies, resolve technical issues and integration blockers, support interface discovery and specification development, and lead production workstream execution through implementation waves, cutover, onboarding, and stabilization.

Key Responsibilities• Lead complex technical initiatives involving systems integration, data migration, claims‑processing capabilities, and Medicare shared services.• Develop and manage integrated implementation plans covering interfaces, data flows, configuration, testing, operational readiness, and production transition.• Coordinate technical activities across application development, integration, infrastructure, security, data, testing, and business teams.• Lead interface discovery and planning activities, including current‑state analysis, requirements, ICD/spec development, testing, certification, cutover, and production readiness.• Work with CMS, MACs, and SMEs to understand beneficiary, eligibility, provider, claims history, claim‑status, adjudication, and pricing/editing dependencies.• Lead complex data‑migration activities including source‑system analysis, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, historical‑data use, data quality, and migration validation.• Ensure migration/integration designs incorporate historical claims information, accumulators, beneficiary/eligibility attributes, and provider data required to process future claims.• Coordinate implementation planning with ClaimsCore adjudication services and CMS shared services (e.g., CWF, PECOS, HIGLAS, pricing/editing services).• Drive resolution of cross‑team dependencies, technical issues, architectural decisions, risks, and implementation blockers.• Develop executive‑level status updates, recommendations, risk assessments, and implementation‑readiness materials.• major implementation milestones.• Facilitate technical working sessions with CMS, MACs, vendors, and engineering teams, translating discussions into clear decisions and accountable actions.• Provide leadership to multidisciplinary teams and assume responsibility for a major ClaimsCore production workstream.

raw.description:
Job Description:

SAP Sales & Distribution Functional Analyst


About the role


We’re looking for an SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) Functional Analyst to join our team and play an important role in supporting and improving SAP solutions for our client.


This is a great opportunity for someone with hands-on experience in SAP SD who enjoys understanding how a business works, talking to users, solving problems and finding practical ways to make processes better.

You’ll work closely with both business users and technical teams, helping to understand what people need from SAP and turning those needs into effective solutions. You’ll be involved in everything from day-to-day support and troubleshooting through to configuration, testing, process improvements, and new developments.


You don’t need to know everything from day one. We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious, willing to learn and keen to broaden their SAP knowledge into other Logistics areas over time.


Due to the nature of the client environment, eligibility for security clearance is required for this role. To meet the current security requirements, candidates must be sole UK nationals and have lived and worked continuously in the UK for the past five years. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider dual nationals for this position.


What you'll be doing

  • Working with business users to understand their requirements, challenges and day-to-day processes.
  • Using your SAP SD knowledge to identify practical solutions that meet business needs.
  • Helping to map current processes and design improved AS-IS and TO-BE processes.
  • Configuring SAP and translating business requirements into clear functional specifications.
  • Supporting the resolution of SAP SD issues, working closely with both users and technical colleagues.
  • Helping to identify opportunities to improve existing processes and make better use of SAP.
  • Creating and carrying out test scenarios to make sure changes work as expected.
  • Supporting users through changes, including providing training and guidance where needed.
  • Working with colleagues and sharing your knowledge to help others develop their SAP skills.
  • Contributing to projects, enhancements and other SAP-related initiatives.
  • Being open to learning and supporting other areas of SAP and Logistics functionality as your experience develops.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Relevant hands-on experience working with SAP Sales & Distribution (SD).
  • Experience in business analysis, business solutions or a similar role.
  • A good understanding of business processes and how SAP can support and improve them.
  • Experience supporting users through business process changes or improvements.
  • Experience working with both business and technical teams to resolve issues.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to listen, ask the right questions and turn business requirements into practical solutions.
  • Experience creating and executing test scenarios.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • The confidence to explain technical concepts in a way that makes sense to non-technical audiences.
  • A willingness to learn, develop and broaden your SAP knowledge.

An SAP certification would be great, but it isn't essential. We're also happy to support someone who is keen to work towards certification.


A degree or equivalent experience is preferred.


The kind of person who will enjoy this role

You’ll enjoy this role if you like getting to the bottom of a problem rather than simply fixing the symptom.

You’ll be comfortable speaking with different people across a business, from end users to technical specialists, and enjoy understanding what they need and finding a way to make things work.


We’re looking for someone who is approachable, curious and solutions-focused, with the confidence to take ownership while knowing when to ask for help.


Things don't always go to plan in SAP, so being able to manage changing priorities, stay calm when there are competing demands and work through problems logically is important.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to develop their skills and grow with the role, rather than someone who already knows everything.


Where you'll work

This is primarily a work-from-home role, giving you the flexibility to work remotely while remaining closely connected with the wider team and client.

There may be occasional travel to client sites for meetings, workshops or other business requirements.

From time to time, there may also be a requirement to work outside standard hours, including occasional weekends, depending on client and project requirements.


Why join us?

This is more than a role focused purely on keeping SAP running. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with users, understand real business challenges and see the impact of the solutions you help deliver.


In addition, DXC offers a competitive salary and a flexible benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally — including pension, private medical cover, and wellbeing programmes.


You'll also have the opportunity to develop your SAP skills, gain exposure to wider Logistics functionality, and build your experience across both functional and business-facing areas.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

This role requires an active Life & Health Insurance License, strong organizational discipline, clear communication, and the ability to manage competing priorities across a large book of business.

raw.excerpt: At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the potential of AI to transform the world.
raw.description:
At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the potential of AI to transform the world. By combining advanced technology with a global network of talented people, we make unusable data usable, driving real-world impact at scale.

More than just a workplace, we’re a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.

Our Culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-Driven: We focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-Centric: We care deeply about our team’s growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: We embrace change and find better ways to do things together.
  • Globally Connected: We foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

If you’re passionate about innovation, collaboration, and making a real impact, we’d love to have you on board!

About the Role

Energy, Oil & Gas is one of the most operationally complex and asset-intensive industries, where AI is rapidly moving from experimentation to enterprise-scale deployment.
While the opportunity is significant, many organizations struggle to move from promising pilots to production-grade AI due to fragmented data, complex environments, and strict safety and regulatory requirements.

CloudFactory is built to solve exactly this.

As Client Principal, AI Consulting (Energy, Oil & Gas), you will be the senior commercial and strategic leader for our energy sector. You will operate as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders across operators, oilfield services companies, and energy enterprises, shaping AI transformation agendas and leading engagements from origination through delivery oversight.

This is a high-impact, externally facing role for someone who can open doors, lead complex conversations, and convert opportunity into long-term partnerships.

What You’ll Do

Executive Relationships & Strategic Advisory

  • Build and lead market growth strategy across energy operators, oilfield services companies, and energy enterprises.
  • Operate as a strategic advisor on AI adoption, from identifying high-value use cases to scaling solutions in production.
  • Engage C-suite and VP stakeholders as a trusted advisor, not a vendor.
  • Navigate complex stakeholder environments across operations, subsurface, engineering, HSE, IT, and data teams.
  • Develop a deep understanding of client priorities across upstream, midstream, and downstream operations.

Business Development & Growth

  • Own new client acquisition, account expansion and P/L management accounts within the energy sector.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans with clear pathways from pilot to enterprise-scale programs.
  • Lead consultative, executive-level sales conversations and build compelling business cases for AI investment.
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle: discovery, solution framing, proposal development, and executive presentations.
  • Navigate sector-specific buying cycles, procurement processes, and capital planning timelines.

Solution Shaping & Delivery Oversight

  • Identify and shape high-impact AI use cases, including:
    • Predictive maintenance and asset monitoring
    • Computer vision for inspection (drone, aerial, and field imagery)
    • Safety and compliance automation
    • Intelligent document processing from engineering documentation
    • Geospatial, LiDAR, and digital twin data pipelines
  • Translate operational challenges into scalable AI solutions leveraging CloudFactory’s capabilities.
  • Partner closely with technical and delivery teams to ensure high-quality execution and client satisfaction.
  • Oversee delivery to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, and outcomes.

Thought Leadership & Industry Impact

  • Stay at the forefront of AI trends across the energy value chain, including asset digitization, predictive operations, and computer vision at scale.
  • Contribute to CloudFactory’s external presence through industry events, client engagements, and thought leadership.
  • Bring sector insights into product, delivery, and go-to-market strategy.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and inspire cross-functional teams including consultants, data scientists, and engineers.
  • Foster strong collaboration between client stakeholders and internal teams.
  • Promote best practices in AI consulting, delivery excellence, and client engagement.

Requirements

  • Deep industry expertise in energy, oil & gas, or adjacent industrial sectors, with a strong understanding of operations and digital transformation.
  • Established executive network across energy operators or oilfield services companies that you can activate from day one.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to translate operational challenges into AI-driven opportunities; P/L management experience.
  • Technical fluency in AI/ML concepts, including predictive analytics and computer vision.
  • Proven consulting and commercial experience, managing enterprise clients and complex engagements.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders as a trusted peer.
  • Leadership experience, guiding cross-functional teams and delivering high-impact outcomes.
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in consulting, technology, or digital transformation within energy or industrial sectors.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, statistics, or related field. Advanced degrees in AI, data science, or business are a plus.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to operate at the intersection of AI, industry transformation, and executive leadership, helping some of the world’s largest energy companies unlock real value from AI. You’ll play a critical role in shaping both client outcomes and CloudFactory’s growth in a strategically important sector.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Highly competitive base salary and an aggressive, performance-aligned incentive compensation structure.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Robust health, dental, vision, and retirement plans.
  • Cutting-Edge Projects: Direct exposure to, and leadership of, advanced AI initiatives with the world's most influential energy corporations.
  • Collaborative Culture: A supportive, high-performance team environment focused on innovation and measurable client success.
  • Professional Growth: Structured access to continuous executive education, mentorship, and accelerated leadership development opportunities.
  • Executive Visibility: Regular interaction with, and direct accountability to, the company’s senior leadership team.

This role represents a unique, high-impact opportunity to define and shape the AI landscape for major global corporations in the energy sector. If you are a highly consultative professional with deep sector knowledge, a passion for AI, and a proven talent for originating and closing complex, strategic enterprise deals, we encourage your application.

raw.description:
Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Account ManagerAs an Account Manager you will be responsible for outside sales, new business development, and account management with assigned accounts / customers to support all business services for the organization in achieving its revenue and profitability goals. This role manages quality and consistency of product and service delivery, with travel up to 80% of the time.

  • Prioritizes health and safety by adhering to policies, processes, and maintaining safe practices at all times
  • Increases sales revenue and profit dollars by identifying potential new accounts and soliciting orders through personal sales calls to explain services and assess potential customer needs
  • Fosters sales relationships with target accounts
  • Increases sales revenue and profit dollars of existing accounts through regular contact with customers and continued communication regarding additional available services
  • Prepares, submits, and interprets periodic reports on activities, sales volume, and expenses
  • Attends and participates in sales meetings and training programs; represents company at trade shows, conventions, Chambers of Commerce, and professional associations
  • Stays abreast of major environmental regulatory changes and industry trends, as well as competitive conditions
  • Effectively adapts to CORE business and customer categorization
  • Manages Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) to <45 days
  • Coordinates with customers to profile, identify service timeframes, and ensure quality and customer satisfaction with the current offering(s); works to resolve any customer concerns
  • Negotiates pricing and contract requirements as needed
  • Completes annual sales revenue budget and identifies key customer initiatives
  • Manages and controls sales expenses and ensures the timely submission of business expenses
  • Maintains a comprehensive understanding of the company’s service offerings for business lines offered to customers
  • Maintains the ability to travel up to 80%, with some overnight stays required
  • Takes on additional duties as assigned to support the team and organization

Education

- Bachelor's degree (required); focus within sales, business, marketing or science (preferred)

Experience

  • 3+ years of proven industry related sales experience (required) -OR-
  • In lieu of degree, 7+ years of proven industry related sales experience (required)

Overview

Exciting Opportunity to Join Our Legacy of Environmental Leadership!

About Us: At Arcwood Environmental, we are more than just a company; we are pioneers in industrial waste management, committed to creating a cleaner, safer world. Since our inception during the environmental movement of the 1970s, we’ve been at the forefront of solving complex environmental challenges. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana with a dedicated team of 2,000+ employees spread across the United States, we provide innovative and compliant solutions to thousands of clients in diverse industries.

Why Arcwood?

  • Impactful Work: Be part of a team that makes a real difference. Our comprehensive services range from hazardous waste management and emergency response to onsite support and technical solutions, allow us to solve our customers’ waste challenges. We are part of the solution. We don’t generate any waste ourselves.
  • Growth Opportunities: At Arcwood, your contribution is valued beyond your job title. We believe in the power of continuous learning and growth, encouraging every employee to expand their skills and take on new challenges.
  • Safety First: Your health and safety are our top priorities. We foster a culture where every employee is empowered to act safely and ensure the well-being of their colleagues. Our mantra is Safe and Compliant, Always.
  • Collaborative Environment: Together we can achieve much more. Join a supportive and dynamic team where your ideas and efforts are recognized and rewarded.

Our Commitment: We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and innovative workplace where every employee can thrive. As part of our team, you will have the freedom to contribute your expertise wherever needed, ensuring the success of our mission to protect the environment.

Our Vision: Our vision is to be the most trusted partner in the environmental services industry. We put our customers first and deliver agile, sustainable, and innovative solutions. We commit to nurturing top talent and creating lasting value for our customers, shareholders, communities, and the planet.

Our Ownership: Arcwood Environmental is backed by the EQT Infrastructure VI fund, enhancing our capabilities, and expanding our reach. EQT is a dynamic global investment powerhouse managing EUR 232 billion in assets (EUR 128 billion fee-generating). With a focus on Private Capital and Real Assets, EQT owns and supports leading companies across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Americas, fostering sustainable growth, operational excellence, and market leadership. This exciting ownership positions us for continued impacts and growth in the future.

Benefits, Compensation & Workforce Diversity

Arcwood offers competitive pay and bonus incentives. Benefits include choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, flexible spending or health savings accounts, employee and dependent life insurance, short and long-term disability, 401(k) savings plan with 7% company match, and tuition reimbursement. Equal Opportunity Employer – Veterans & Disabilities A post-offer drug screen and background check will be required. Position Physical Demands

raw.title: Staff Software Build Engineer
raw.excerpt: Primary Function of Position: The Software Build team at Intuitive is seeking a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to design, build, and operate the next-generation unified build system across all robotic surgery platforms.
raw.description:
Primary Function of Position:

The Software Build team at Intuitive is seeking a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to design, build, and operate the next-generation unified build system across all robotic surgery platforms.

This role is for a senior engineer who writes code, debugs real build failures, prototypes infrastructure, and scales systems through direct technical contribution. You will own core build architecture while remaining deeply involved in implementation—driving measurable improvements in build speed, correctness, and developer productivity across large, safety-critical C/C++ codebases.

You will serve as a technical leader and mentor, but this is not an oversight-only role. Expect to spend significant time designing build rules, implementing tooling, debugging distributed builds, and evolving CI infrastructure in production.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain Bazel-based build systems for large-scale C/C++ embedded software, including custom toolchains and cross-compilation flows.
  • Directly implement and optimize Bazel Remote Caching and Remote Execution (RBE) to enable fast, deterministic builds across local, CI, and cloud environments.
  • Write production code in Rust, C/C++, and Python to support build tooling, infrastructure services, and developer workflows.
  • Own and evolve build performance: cache hit rates, execution parallelism, dependency hygiene, hermeticity, and reproducibility.
  • Build and maintain developer-facing tooling that improves local iteration speed and CI reliability.
  • Integrate and operate build infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments, balancing performance, security, and cost.
  • Work directly with firmware, platform, and application teams to debug real-world build issues and eliminate systemic bottlenecks.
  • Improve observability of build systems through metrics, logging, and analytics.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, architectural discussions, and hands-on problem solving.
  • Act as a technical advocate for modern build practices and scalable development workflows.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

  • Deep technical ownership with a bias toward implementation and measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to balance architectural rigor with pragmatic delivery.
  • Builds trust through technical credibility and consistent execution.
  • Drives alignment by connecting build system improvements to developer productivity and product velocity.
  • Acts as a hands-on technical leader shaping the long-term evolution of Intuitive’s development platforms.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of hands-on technical ownership.
  • Deep, practical expertise with Bazel in complex C/C++ and embedded environments.
  • Proven experience implementing and operating Bazel Remote Caching and Remote Execution at scale.
  • Strong programming experience in Rust, C/C++, and Python.
  • Experience debugging and optimizing distributed build systems, CI pipelines, and build infrastructure under real production constraints.
  • Solid understanding of compiler toolchains, linkers, and build graph behavior.
  • Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly and influence teams through technical leadership.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

  • Experience with Nix and Nix-based packaging for reproducible builds and developer environments.
  • Familiarity with BuildBuddy (or similar Bazel observability / remote execution platforms).
  • Experience with Yocto-based toolchains and embedded Linux build workflows.
  • Exposure to REAPI-compatible execution backends and remote build infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting safety-critical or regulated software systems (medical, automotive, aerospace).
  • Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science or related field.
  • 12–15 years of relevant industry experience.

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.

As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare’s hardest challenges and advance what is possible.

Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere—we strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.

Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture—our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real-world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.

Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let’s advance the world of minimally invasive care.

raw.title: 2D Moho Animator - Human Buddy
raw.excerpt: We’re looking for a 2D animator who knows Moho well and loves turning scripts and storyboards into entertaining, polished animation.
raw.description:
We’re looking for a 2D animator who knows Moho well and loves turning scripts and storyboards into entertaining, polished animation.

You’ll work on Human Buddy, one of Telos Media’s brands, an animated medicine show where the Doctor and a cast of sentient living organs explore the human body, medicine and health through comedy, storytelling and animation.

What you’ll be obsessed about

Making every scene work.

You care about timing, acting, expressions, movement and all the small details that make 2D animation feel alive.

You don’t just make characters move from A to B. You think about what the character is doing, why they’re doing it and how the animation supports the joke, explanation or story.

You should be the kind of person who watches a scene and thinks:

“This could land better. I know what I’d change.”

What you’ll do

  • Animate Human Buddy episodes in Moho, working from approved scripts and storyboards
  • Animate characters, props, backgrounds, transitions and other visual elements
  • Create and work with character rigs in Moho
  • Turn storyboards into polished animation while keeping the timing, acting and visual storytelling clear
  • Match the established Human Buddy visual style and keep your scenes consistent with the rest of the episode
  • Work closely with the Creative Director and other animators to maintain consistency across the episode
  • Take feedback and make revisions quickly
  • Flag problems early and figure out practical solutions rather than waiting for someone else to catch them
  • Keep your scenes organised and deliver them according to the agreed production schedule
  • Use motion graphics when needed to support explanations, transitions, jokes and other visual elements
  • Look for ways to make the animation more efficient without compromising the quality of the final video

What we’re looking for

  • Professional experience as a 2D animator
  • Strong Moho experience. You should be very comfortable working in Moho without needing step-by-step instructions
  • Hands-on experience with character rigging in Moho
  • Strong understanding of 2D animation principles, including timing, spacing, posing and character acting
  • Experience working from scripts and storyboards
  • Good visual storytelling instincts. You understand how animation can make a scene clearer, funnier or more engaging
  • Able to work within an established visual style rather than needing to define the entire style yourself
  • Very organised and able to manage your own scenes and deadlines
  • Comfortable collaborating with other animators and taking direction from a Creative Director
  • Good at taking feedback and turning it into concrete changes
  • Proactive. If you see something that could be better, you say so and ideally fix it
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving production environment

Bonus points

  • Strong motion graphics skills
  • Experience animating for YouTube or other digital-first content
  • Experience working on comedy, educational or explainer animation
  • Experience working with a distributed animation team
  • You’re a Human Buddy, SolarBalls, MrSpherical or Telos Media fan

Hours

Part-time, with flexible working hours and regular overlap with the South America-based team.

You’ll need enough overlap with the team to collaborate, receive feedback and keep production moving, but we’re flexible about your exact working hours.

raw.description:
We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.
Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.
  • Engage. Speak with decision-makers such as Marketing Directors, Marketing Managers, Chief Marketing Officers (CMOs), Digital Marketing Managers, Growth Marketing Managers, Brand Managers, and business owners.
  • Present. Introduce our services in a clear, professional, and conversational manner.
  • Qualify. Build rapport, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, and identify prospective clients who are a good fit for our services.
  • Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.
  • Maintain records. Keep accurate CRM records, including call outcomes, notes, and follow-up activities.
  • Improve continuously. Participate in call reviews, role-play sessions, and ongoing coaching to strengthen your sales skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Excellent communication. Clear spoken English that can be easily understood by customers in the United States.
  • Confidence. Comfortable speaking with senior business decision-makers over the phone.
  • Active listening. Able to ask insightful questions and understand customer needs.
  • Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.
  • Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.
  • Curiosity. Enjoys learning about businesses and uncovering opportunities through conversation.
  • Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.
  • Fast learner. Quickly understands new products, services, and sales techniques.
  • Professionalism. Represents the company with confidence and integrity in every interaction.
  • Natural communication. Able to follow a structured sales process while sounding authentic and conversational, rather than reading mechanically from a script.
Nice to Have
  • Experience. Previous experience in marketing, cold calling, telesales, appointment setting, customer service, or B2B sales is preferred but not required. We believe communication skills, coachability, and a willingness to learn are stronger predictors of success than experience alone.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.
  • Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.
  • Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.
  • Remote flexibility. Work remotely with a supportive team.
  • Competitive pay. Earn USD $4–$8 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated sales ability, and overall fit for the role. Bonuses are available for strong performance, including qualified meetings successfully booked.
  • Growth opportunities. This role has the potential to become an ongoing position for the right candidate, with opportunities for growth as you develop your skills and contribute to the team's success.
