Join us on a journey of endless possibilities


At Strada, possibility isn’t just a promise – it’s the foundation of everything we do. We believe in unlocking potential for every colleague, creating a journey of growth, discovery, and impact.

With the support, resources, and opportunities we provide, you’ll build a fulfilling future – working on meaningful projects that span industries and regions, contributing to outcomes that matter.

Strada is a people, payroll, and technology leader simplifying international workforce management. Operating in 180+ countries, we design and deliver people-first solutions powered by cloud-based technology – helping organizations grow and enabling workforces to perform at their best.


Learn more at

HRFS Analyst | Virtual - Canada


The HRFS Analyst provides payroll accounting, funding, and financial analysis support to Strada clients across Canada and the United States. Based in Canada, this position supports Canadian clients with both Canadian and U.S. payroll populations and is responsible for ensuring accurate payroll accounting, reconciliations, funding, and financial reporting across both countries. The role works closely with clients, payroll processing teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to resolve financial and operational issues, support audits, and maintain appropriate financial controls.


Key Responsibilities


  • Perform payroll-to-General Ledger (GL) reconciliations for both Canadian and U.S. payroll populations, including payroll activity, GL postings, balance sheet accounts, and interface error reports.
  • Prepare bank and funding reconciliations by comparing payroll, banking, and third-party payment data and taking appropriate action to clear reconciling items.
  • Analyze payroll variances, accounting discrepancies, and compliance issues; perform root cause analysis and recommend appropriate resolutions.
  • Prepare or support journal vouchers, reclassifications, and other accounting adjustments and understand their impact on the General Ledger.
  • Analyze financial, operational, and compliance risks associated with escalated issues and provide recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Provide functional support for payroll accounting and funding issues, including researching system defects, documenting issues and evidence, and coordinating resolution with appropriate internal teams.
  • Support implementations, go-lives, year-end activities, and the accurate and timely delivery of payroll accounting and GL files and documents.
  • Respond to client, vendor, and internal inquiries related to payroll accounting, funding, treasury, and financial processes across Canadian and U.S. operations.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing accurate and timely information and helping ensure appropriate controls are established and followed.
  • Maintain Defined Work Instructions (DWIs), process documentation, and other procedures and controls to support consistent service delivery.
  • Partner with payroll processing teams, Operations, Product, and other internal groups to resolve issues, share lessons learned, and improve service delivery.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and enhanced controls and support implementation of approved solutions.
  • Participate in team knowledge sharing, training, and coaching related to payroll accounting, funding, and delivery processes.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of sensitive payroll and financial information while building effective relationships with clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Professional Experience & Skills


  • Accounting experience is required, with hands-on payroll accounting experience supporting both Canadian and U.S. payroll.
  • Demonstrated understanding of payroll accounting processes and financial requirements in both Canada and the United States.
  • Payroll financial reporting, payroll funding, or payroll reconciliation experience preferred.
  • 1-3 years of experience using Workday or a similar payroll, ERP, or accounting system.
  • Strong understanding of General Ledger accounting, reconciliations, journal entries, financial reporting, and payroll accounting processes.
  • Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office and related financial systems.
  • Ability to analyze financial issues, identify root causes, assess risk, and make sound recommendations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain SLA and client commitments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with clients and internal teams.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively while following established processes, procedures, and controls.
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, adaptability, and willingness to learn in a global environment.

At Strada, our values guide everything we do:

  • Anticipate Customer Needs – We stay ahead of trends so our customers can grow and succeed.
  • Own the Outcome – We take responsibility for delivering excellence and ensuring things get done right.
  • Challenge Ourselves to Work Smarter – We move faster than the world around us to drive change and accomplish more.
  • Empower Each Other to Solve Problems – We tackle challenges head on, ask tough questions, and collaborate to find the best solutions.
  • Care About Our Work and Our People – We understand that what we do impacts millions, and we have a responsibility to get it right.

Benefits

At Strada, we support your whole self—offering a range of benefits for your health, wellbeing, finances, and future. These include health coverage, wellbeing programs, paid leave (vacation, sick, parental), retirement plans, learning opportunities, and more.

All offers are contingent on successful completion of background checks, where permitted by law and as appropriate for the role. These may include identity, education, employment, and in some cases, criminal history verification, checks against global watchlists, credit reports, and/or drug testing. You’ll be informed of the specific checks applicable to your role and location during the recruitment process.

Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Strada is dedicated to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We believe that embracing differences strengthens our teams and drives innovation and success.

Diversity Policy Statement

Strada is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination based on legally protected characteristics. Applicants may request a reasonable accommodation by contacting their recruiter.

Authorization to work in the Employing Country

To be considered, you must have current and future work authorization in the country where you're applying, without the need for visa sponsorship by Strada.

Please note: This job description does not limit Strada’s right to assign or reassign responsibilities, including to subsidiaries, partners, or future business purchasers.

We offer yow a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide onganization.

DISCLAIMER:

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job to other entities; including but not limited to subsidiaries, partners, or purchasers of Strada business units.

Licensed Mental Health Therapist — Bilingual English/Spanish Strongly Preferred

📍 Remote | Maryland License Required | Part-Time or Full-Time | 💰 Monthly Bonus Potential

💜 Your Language Can Change the Way a Family Experiences Care.

Many of the families we serve want therapy in Spanish. We need clinicians who can meet them there.

At Backpack Healthcare, we're making behavioral healthcare more accessible for children, teens, young adults, and their families. Our care is delivered virtually, covered by most insurance, and grounded in the belief that families deserve care that reflects who they are, how they communicate, and what they value.

As a clinician-led, minority-owned organization, we're growing — and we're looking for therapists who understand that culturally responsive care isn't a bonus feature. It's essential.

If you speak English and Spanish and want your language skills to make a real difference in the lives of families, we want to meet you.

🎒 The Role

Choose the schedule that works best for you — part-time or full-time — while building a meaningful caseload of 15–36 sessions per week.

You'll provide individual, family, and group therapy through telehealth, with the flexibility to create a schedule that works for your life.

Most clinicians work weekday afternoons and evenings, typically 2–9 PM. Weekend availability is a plus.

You'll:

  • 🧠 Conduct clinical intakes and assessments
  • 📝 Develop individualized, trauma-informed treatment plans
  • 💻 Provide individual, family, and group therapy via telehealth
  • 🤝 Collaborate with therapists, PMHNPs, psychiatrists, and other members of our interdisciplinary team
  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Support parents and caregivers through education and care coordination
  • 📋 Maintain timely and accurate documentation in our EHR
  • 🌎 Provide culturally responsive care that considers each family's language, culture, and unique needs

💰 Compensation + Monthly Bonus Potential

We believe great clinicians deserve to be fairly compensated and recognized for the work they do.

  • 💵 $45–$65 per billable hour, based on license level
  • 🎯 Monthly bonus potential for eligible clinicians based on applicable productivity and performance criteria
  • 🏥 Medical, dental, and vision for eligible full-time employees
  • 💵 401(k) with 3% company match
  • 🌴 Paid time off
  • 📚 $300 annual CEU reimbursement
  • 🎓 Free clinical supervision for eligible LMSW/LPC roles
  • ❤️ $25,000 company-paid life insurance
  • 🌱 Employee Assistance Program
  • 🚀 Clinical leadership opportunities, including our Residency & Fellowship Program

⭐ Earn More While Making an Impact

Eligible clinicians have the opportunity to earn an additional monthly performance-based bonus on top of their regular billable compensation.

Bonus eligibility is based on applicable productivity and performance expectations, giving you another opportunity to increase your earnings while being recognized for consistently providing high-quality care.

🔎 What We're Looking For

We're looking for clinicians who bring strong clinical skills, cultural humility, and a genuine commitment to children and families.

Required:

  • Active Maryland license: LGPC, LCPC, LMSW, LMFT, or LCSW-C
  • Experience working with children, adolescents, and families
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Strong clinical judgment, communication, and documentation skills
  • Commitment to trauma-informed and culturally responsive practice

Strongly Preferred:

Bilingual English/Spanish clinicians

This isn't simply a "nice-to-have." We're intentionally growing our ability to provide high-quality care in Spanish and want clinicians who can help families feel understood from the very first conversation.

💜 Why Backpack Healthcare?

Since 2020, we've served 12,000+ children and families through accessible behavioral healthcare.

78% of families report that their child is doing better after three months of care.

We're proud of that number — but we know the numbers only tell part of the story.

Behind every outcome is a clinician who listened. A parent who felt supported. A child who finally felt understood.

That's the work we're building around.

At Backpack, you won't just be another provider on a roster. You'll be part of a growing clinical community with opportunities to learn, collaborate, mentor, and grow into leadership.

🎒 When clinicians thrive, kids thrive.

That's not a tagline. It's how we build.

Ready to Make Care More Accessible?

If you're a Maryland-licensed therapist who wants flexibility, competitive compensation, monthly bonus potential, professional growth, and the opportunity to provide care in both English and Spanish, we'd love to hear from you.

Backpack Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity in age, background, identity, experience, ability, and perspective — and we're committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve.

Workday Integration Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Workday Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Workday Integration Developer to design, develop, and maintain integrations between Workday and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on hands-on integration delivery using EIB, Studio, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and Workday APIs, with strong attention to reliability, security, and data quality. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Workday integrations in production, navigates Workday’s tenant model and security framework with confidence, and writes well-structured Studio integrations that are easy to maintain. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop Workday integrations using EIB, Workday Studio, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and PECI.
  • Build inbound and outbound integrations connecting Workday with payroll, benefits, IT provisioning, finance, and analytics systems.
  • Develop XSLT transformations within Workday Studio integrations, applying disciplined templating practices, reusable helper libraries, and careful test coverage to keep complex mappings maintainable.
  • Implement integrations using Workday REST and SOAP web services where appropriate.
  • Design error handling, retry, and notification strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Develop and maintain integration system users, ISSGs, security configurations, and tenant-level setup for integrations.
  • Build and maintain calculated fields, custom reports, and report-as-a-service integrations.
  • Implement Workday business processes and condition rules that support integration logic, ensuring the upstream and downstream sides of each integration agree on routing, approvals, and state transitions.
  • Participate actively in Workday tenant refresh planning and integration regression testing, ensuring critical integration paths are exercised in lower environments before each tenant move and any drift is caught early.
  • Collaborate with HR, payroll, IT, and finance stakeholders to translate business needs into integration designs.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Support production incidents related to integrations and drive durable fixes.
  • Participate in Workday release planning and regression testing, reviewing upcoming feature changes for impact, scheduling validation cycles, and coordinating with stakeholders so adoption proceeds smoothly.
  • Stay current with Workday product releases and integration platform evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 12 or more years of Workday integration development experience.
  • Deep expertise in EIB, Workday Studio, and Core Connectors.
  • Strong XSLT skills and experience with Workday Studio orchestrations.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Strong understanding of the Workday data model and tenant configuration.
  • Experience with Workday security model including ISU/ISSG patterns.
  • Familiarity with calculated fields and custom report design.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Pro Integrations certification.
  • Experience with PICOF, PECI, or Cloud Connect for Payroll.
  • Familiarity with Workday Extend.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments.
  • Experience integrating Workday with major SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce).

raw.description:
Estamos em busca de pessoas fascinadas por criar um futuro melhor, que sejam inquietas, tenham coragem para desafiar o comum, que valorizem a diversidade de ideias e acreditem no potencial transformador da colaboração verdadeira.

Sabemos que muitas pessoas — especialmente mulheres — só se candidatam a uma vaga se sentem que cumprem 100% dos requisitos. Se esse for o seu caso, queremos te encorajar a se inscrever mesmo assim. Aqui, valorizamos trajetórias diversas e aprendizados ao longo da jornada.

Junte-se a nós na busca por um mundo com novas inteligências.

Este papel tem como objetivo desenhar, liderar e garantir a escalabilidade e governança das rotinas financeiras da empresa. A posição exige perfil altamente analítico, visão sistêmica e capacidade de liderança técnica para estruturar operações complexas, garantir compliance de alto rigor e atuar como parceiro estratégico da gestão e diretoria financeira.

Esse propósito se traduz, na prática, nos seguintes Jobs to Be Done:

  • Liderar e desenvolver o time financeiro: Atuar como referência técnica e mentor para analistas e assistentes, coordenando a distribuição de demandas, orientando as entregas diárias e promovendo o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe para garantir um alto padrão de qualidade na operação.
  • Liderar e otimizar rotinas de Tesouraria e Controladoria: Gerenciar o ciclo de ponta a ponta (contas a pagar, faturamento e fluxo de caixa), desenhando processos escaláveis e garantindo a mitigação de riscos operacionais e o cumprimento impecável das obrigações.
  • Liderar análises financeiras e estratégia orçamentária: Desenvolver relatórios de alta complexidade e influenciar ativamente o planejamento orçamentário, conectando resultados financeiros à estratégia macro do negócio.
  • Desenhar a arquitetura de centros de custo e projetos: Estruturar as políticas e a matriz de alocação de despesas e receitas, garantindo uma governança robusta para viabilizar o acompanhamento preciso da rentabilidade por projetos.
  • Gerir estrategicamente contratos e prestações de contas complexas: Liderar o ciclo financeiro de contratos de grande porte, mitigar riscos em negociações e coordenar auditorias e prestações de contas rigorosas.
  • Garantir a governança sistêmica via OMIE: Atuar como key user do sistema ERP OMIE, liderando parametrizações, integrações sistêmicas e garantindo a integridade e escalabilidade da base de dados financeira.
  • Liderar processos de auditoria e compliance: Ser o ponto focal técnico na estruturação de controles internos e no atendimento a auditorias externas e internas, garantindo total conformidade legal e de processos.
  • Liderar a transformação e automação de processos: Desenhar e encabeçar projetos de melhoria contínua, utilizando tecnologia e reengenharia de processos para escalar a operação com eficiência.
  • Coordenação de contabilidade e DP externos: Supervisionar as rotinas executadas pelos parceiros terceirizados, assegurando a qualidade, conformidade e pontualidade no processamento da folha de pagamento e nas entregas contábeis

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Experiência consolidada (nível sênior/especialista) na área financeira, com forte vivência em estruturação de processos operacionais.
  • Excel avançado e domínio na implantação/parametrização de ERPs.
  • Excelente capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e habilidade para liderar projetos complexos.
  • Sólida experiência com controle financeiro avançado, gestão de contratos e análise de riscos.
  • Ampla experiência com processos rigorosos de prestação de contas (forte diferencial se for com universidades ou editais de fomento).
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (capacidade de conduzir reuniões e negociar).

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Experiência liderando tecnicamente áreas financeiras em empresas de base tecnológica ou contextos de alto crescimento.
  • Capacidade de influenciar stakeholders e promover melhorias contínuas com grande autonomia.
  • Forte interesse por inovação, tecnologia e impacto social.

SOBRE A KUNUMI

Na Kunumi, a curiosidade é nossa força motriz na busca incansável por conhecimento e pela coragem de desafiar o convencional. Acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamentos e perspectivas é fundamental para criar soluções únicas e impactantes.

Nossa cultura é pautada pela valorização das pessoas, do cuidado com o legado que deixamos e pela constante busca por resultados elegantes em meio a desafios complexos. Aqui, cada voz é ouvida, cada ideia é valorizada e cada conquista é celebrada em conjunto.

Somos agentes de mudança que almejam promover uma transformação positiva na sociedade por meio da Inteligência Artificial. Acreditamos no potencial humano e na capacidade de atuar como catalisadores para um futuro mais equilibrado.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Cultura dinâmica, diversa e focada no crescimento conjunto;
  • Trabalho em ambiente remoto com horário flexível;
  • Suporte home-office (ajuda de custo, cadeira, headphones, laptop, entre outros);
  • Plano de saúde premium e dental para você e seus dependentes, sem mensalidade;
  • Alimentação (cartão flexível);
  • Licença parental estendida
  • Assistência a Filhos;
  • Auxílio para Filhos(as) com Deficiência;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programas de promoção à Saúde - mental, física e emocional
  • Parceria Wellhub - Plano Gold gratuito
  • Recesso remunerado de final de ano
  • Kunumi Day mensal - Toda segunda sexta-feira do mês ficamos off

SOBRE O PROCESSO

Depois de enviar sua inscrição, você receberá um email de confirmação.
Acreditamos que a diversidade promove a criatividade e acelera resultados positivos, portanto, consideramos todos os candidatos não somente pela qualificação técnica, mas também como nos complementa como grupo.

raw.description:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

Location: Remote – Latin America Work Arrangement: Fully Remote Employment Type: Full-Time | Independent Contractor Compensation: $1,500–$2,600 USD/month Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:30 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time Industry: Digital Marketing / Performance Marketing / eCommerce English Proficiency: Advanced Professional English Required (C1 or higher)

About the Company

Our client is a profitable, fast-growing U.S.-based digital marketing and eCommerce agency that helps consumer brands scale through performance media, creative strategy, advanced measurement, and AI-powered solutions.

The agency combines human expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver measurable business results, focusing on profitability, efficiency, and sustainable growth rather than vanity metrics.

With strategic partnerships across leading advertising and social commerce platforms, including Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap, and Pinterest, the company operates at the forefront of digital marketing innovation.

The team embraces an AI-first mindset, entrepreneurial thinking, operational excellence, and a culture of ownership, where individuals are encouraged to take initiative, make decisions, and contribute directly to business growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly proactive and business-minded Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff to work directly with the founders and leadership team of a fast-moving digital marketing agency.

This is not a traditional administrative or scheduling position. It is a hands-on role that combines executive support, operational management, vendor oversight, process improvement, and business development.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful professional who takes ownership of responsibilities, exercises independent judgment, anticipates business needs, and makes decisions with minimal supervision.

You will oversee executive priorities, manage vendor relationships, optimize operational systems, and develop processes that improve efficiency across the organization. You will also contribute directly to revenue-generating initiatives by supporting prospect research, outbound outreach, pipeline development, and marketing activities.

We are looking for someone who thinks like an operator, executes like an executive assistant, and brings the commercial mindset needed to help a growing business scale.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Founder Support

  • Manage executive calendars, inboxes, meetings, and communications, independently handling routine scheduling and prioritization decisions.

  • Act as a trusted point of contact between leadership, internal teams, vendors, and clients.

  • Anticipate executive needs, prioritize competing demands, and ensure timely follow-through on commitments.

  • Prepare meeting agendas, executive briefings, status reports, and other materials, synthesizing information to support effective decision-making.

  • Coordinate founders' personal appointments, scheduling, and occasional personal administrative needs with professionalism and discretion.

Vendor Relationship Management

  • Take ownership of day-to-day vendor relationships, including communications, issue resolution, service quality, and performance expectations.

  • Evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate routine pricing and contract terms, and approve purchases within established authority limits.

  • Monitor vendor performance against agreed service standards and recommend improvements or alternative providers when necessary.

  • Maintain accurate vendor documentation, contracts, and compliance records.

  • Identify potential vendor-related risks and escalate significant contractual or financial matters to leadership.

Operational Systems & Technology

  • Own the administration, organization, and continuous improvement of the company's operational tools and technology platforms.

  • Evaluate new software and AI-powered solutions, recommend improvements, and manage implementation and onboarding.

  • Troubleshoot operational system issues and coordinate with vendors when additional technical support is required.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity through technology.

  • Ensure operational systems support business objectives and remain organized, efficient, and scalable.

Process Design & Operational Improvement

  • Analyze existing workflows, identify operational inefficiencies, and independently develop improved processes.

  • Create, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational playbooks, and training documentation.

  • Establish clear workflows, quality control checkpoints, and accountability standards.

  • Identify operational risks and proactively implement corrective actions within the scope of the role.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, reduce manual work, and support business growth.

Financial & Administrative Management

  • Monitor operational budgets, track expenditures, and flag potential variances.

  • Manage routine procurement decisions for software, supplies, and services within approved spending limits.

  • Maintain organized financial and administrative records.

  • Support leadership with operational reporting, expense tracking, and administrative planning.

Business Development & Revenue Support

  • Proactively contribute to revenue-generating activities when operational priorities are under control.

  • Research and qualify prospective clients, develop targeted prospect lists, and identify potential business opportunities.

  • Support outbound prospecting through personalized email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, follow-ups, and lead nurturing.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, track pipeline activity, and coordinate next steps with the business development team.

  • Prepare sales presentations, proposals, pitch decks, case studies, and other business development materials.

  • Coordinate go-to-market initiatives, including sales meetings, webinars, industry events, and strategic partnerships.

  • Support the agency's own marketing initiatives, including newsletters, social media, and content coordination.

  • Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve prospect engagement and accelerate the sales process.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in executive support, business operations, administrative management, or a similar role involving significant independent responsibility.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in sales, business development, or marketing, including prospecting, pipeline development, outbound outreach, or campaign support.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher), with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives or managing operational functions with minimal supervision.

  • Proven ability to independently manage vendor relationships, including negotiations, performance monitoring, and contract coordination.

  • Experience designing, documenting, implementing, and improving operational processes.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Sound business judgment, with the ability to make independent decisions and recognize when leadership involvement is necessary.

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and experience administering business software and operational platforms.

  • Practical experience using AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to improve research, communication, sales, and operational efficiency.

  • A proactive, commercially minded approach, with the ability to identify opportunities to contribute to business growth.

  • Ability to work independently and maintain accountability in a fully remote environment.

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote workspace.

  • Full availability to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

Preferred

  • Previous experience working in a digital marketing agency, performance marketing company, eCommerce business, or B2B services environment.

  • Experience supporting founders, CEOs, or other C-suite executives with delegated decision-making responsibilities.

  • Hands-on experience with CRM and project management platforms such as HubSpot, Asana, Monday.com, or Notion.

  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, Google Ads, or social commerce operations.

  • Experience creating SOPs, operational playbooks, and process documentation from scratch.

  • Experience with sales prospecting tools, marketing automation, or AI-powered workflow automation.

  • Background in business development, lead generation, or outbound sales for agencies or professional services companies.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership can confidently delegate operational responsibilities, knowing that priorities are managed and commitments are consistently fulfilled.

  • Executive calendars, communications, and administrative responsibilities run smoothly with minimal supervision.

  • Vendor relationships are professionally managed, cost-effective, and aligned with business needs.

  • Operational systems and workflows become increasingly efficient through automation, documentation, and continuous improvement.

  • The business development team receives meaningful support through prospect research, outreach, pipeline management, and sales preparation.

  • You consistently identify opportunities to solve problems, improve processes, and contribute to the company's growth without waiting for instructions.

Who We're Looking For

You are an organized, resourceful, and entrepreneurial professional who enjoys operating at the intersection of executive support, business operations, and growth.

You are comfortable working directly with founders, taking responsibility for important business functions, and making thoughtful decisions independently.

You don't simply complete assigned tasks. You anticipate what needs to happen next, identify opportunities for improvement, and take action.

Most importantly, you understand that supporting leadership means creating capacity for the business to grow, whether through operational efficiency, better systems, stronger vendor relationships, or direct contributions to revenue-generating activities.

Work Arrangement & Compensation

  • Location: Remote – Latin America

  • Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

  • Monthly Compensation: $1,500–$2,600 USD, depending on experience and qualifications

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 8:30 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

This is a remote/telecommute position.

About Virtual Peace of Mind (VPM)

Virtual Peace of Mind (VPM) is a fast-growing, fully remote mental health practice dedicated to providing compassionate, evidence-based care to youth and families across multiple states. Our mission is to expand equitable access to mental health services through high-quality virtual care — and to support the clinicians and professionals who make that care possible.

We’re building a culture that is mission-driven, accountable, supportive, and built for sustainable remote work.

Why Join VPM

At VPM, you’ll be part of a team transforming access to youth mental health through virtual care — with a remote model designed to support excellent work and real life.

What you can expect:

  • Mission-Driven Impact: Contribute to meaningful work improving access and outcomes for youth and families.
  • Remote by Design: Fully remote environment with clear expectations and supportive infrastructure.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work with a multidisciplinary team that values integrity, empathy, and shared learning.
  • Growth & Leadership Pathways: Opportunities to expand scope and take on leadership or consulting responsibilities as we scale.
  • Professional Development: Access to training, resources, and continued learning opportunities aligned to role scope.
  • State & School-Based Partnerships: Join initiatives that strengthen school-based mental health delivery and expand access across communities.

At Virtual Peace of Mind LLC, we specialize in providing high-quality virtual support services with a focus on clarity, care, and consistency. While we may not have a current job opening that matches your background, we’re always eager to connect with motivated, service-oriented professionals who align with our mission.

Whether your strengths are in administration, customer service, operations, or you are a licensed therapist, we encourage you to submit a general application.

What We Look For:

  • A proactive, dependable work ethic and a strong sense of professionalism
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • A genuine interest in supporting businesses and bringing peace of mind to our clients
  • Experience or education relevant to your area of expertise

Why Work With Us:

  • Fully remote and flexible work culture
  • Supportive, values-driven team environment
  • Opportunities for growth and long-term collaboration
  • Commitment to work-life balance and mental well-being

Benefits & Time Off (W-2 Eligible Roles)

VPM supports your well-being with benefits designed for health, stability, and real work-life balance.

  • Health, Dental & Vision: Company-sponsored plans available, with an employer contribution for eligible full-time employees.
  • Quick Benefits Start: Benefits eligibility begins after 30 days, with coverage effective the first of the month following Day 30.
  • Paid Time Off: Full-time employees accrue 10 days (80 hours) annually starting on Day 31 to support rest, personal needs, and wellness.
  • Flexible Holidays: No fixed holiday calendar—team members are empowered to plan schedules and observe holidays meaningful to them.

Eligibility: Benefits are available to full-time employees (25+ client-facing hours/week). Part-time employees (15–24 client-facing hours/week) may be able to enroll at their own cost, depending on plan design.

Internal Mobility & Growth

As VPM grows, our team grows. We prioritize internal mobility, skill development, and leadership pathways. Whenever possible, we promote from within and create opportunities for team members to expand responsibilities and advance their careers.

How to Apply:

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter introducing yourself, your skills, and the type of work you're seeking. Tell us why you'd like to be part of the Virtual Peace of Mind team. We review all submissions and will reach out if an opportunity arises that fits your profile.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Virtual Peace of Mind, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive, equitable environment for all employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Reasonable Accommodation & Accessibility

Virtual Peace of Mind is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or perform essential job functions, please contact HR at to request assistance. All accommodation requests are handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law. If qualified for a role, our talent acquisition team will contact you. Please only reach out if accommodation with the application/interviewing process is required.

Employment Eligibility & Compliance: All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, verification of licensure (as applicable), and eligibility to work in the United States without company-sponsorship. VPM complies fully with all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination, confidentiality, and data privacy, including HIPAA, FERPA, and state-specific clinical/employment regulations.

raw.description:
American farmers have made tremendous technology advancements through hardware improvements and investments in precision agriculture. However, when it comes to the back-office, most farms are decades behind, relying on spreadsheets, filing cabinets, and decades-old on-prem software to recruit, manage, and pay their workforce. Seso is addressing this problem by modernizing the back-office for the farm.

Our mission is to build the premier platform for agribusiness to hire and manage their workforce and improve the lives of agricultural workers. We are addressing American farmers’ biggest pain point - access to qualified labor - through a software-enabled labor solution that automates the H-2A visa. Our comprehensive HR platform streamlines and automates the hiring process for farms and seamlessly integrates their efforts across recruitment, onboarding, payroll, and insurance while providing workers access to financial services for the first time.

Seso has raised over $60M from Tier I investors including Index, Founders Fund, and Mary Meeker at Bond, and has been recognized with awards including Forbes Rising Stars and Andreessen Horowitz's American Dynamism 50.

About the Role

Seso’s modern platform provides employers with orders of magnitude increases in efficiency, while helping them stay compliant and communicate with their workforce. We’re looking for a senior Product Manager to own new initiatives for Seso’s HR Platform which serves as employer’s employee system of record and streamlines numerous workflows across collecting employee information, onboarding employees, and managing the employee lifecycle.

The role has both a high level of autonomy and ownership. You will be responsible for facilitating business outcomes related to our HR platform. (Think working at high abstraction levels to solve key company business goals vs. solve a specific problem). Your team will be regularly shipping software which meaningfully improves the lives of our customers and farmworkers, and regularly interacting with customers across the country.

Responsibilities

  • Owning and delivering on company-level business objectives
  • Working closely with design, engineering, and revenue stakeholders to define a cohesive product strategy and roadmap
  • Translating ambiguous or complex ideas into clear, executable projects
  • Spending time to deeply understand and elevate the voices of our users

Gjør livet tilgjengelig

Bli en del av vår suksesshistorie! iLOQ er et internasjonalt teknologiselskap som tilbyr selvforsynte digitale låse- og mobile tilgangsstyringsløsninger som har revolusjonert låsebransjen ved å muliggjøre batterifri og kabelfri digital låsing. Vår teknologi gir høy datasikkerhet, uovertruffen tilgangskontroll og kostnadseffektiv livssyklusadministrasjon, noe som gir betydelige besparelser for kunder innen flerboligsektoren, kritisk infrastruktur, helsevesenet, utdanningssektoren, næringslivet og universitetssektoren.

iLOQ ble grunnlagt i Finland i 2003 og har etablert en sterk tilstedeværelse i mer enn 13 land. Selskapet er anerkjent som markedsleder innen bærekraftige digitale låse- og tilgangsdelingsløsninger.

Er du en dyktig, motivert og flittig teknisk sjef med en lidenskap for banebrytende mobilteknologi og digitalisering, og som alltid er på jakt etter bedre og mer effektive måter å gjøre ting på?

I så fall søker iLOQ nå etter en digitalt orientert teknisk sjef som kan bli en del av teamet vårt.

Hva du skal gjøre

Som teknisk sjef vil du spille en nøkkelrolle i iLOQ Norge. Vår banebrytende teknologi skaper stor etterspørsel, og du vil ha ansvaret for å støtte våre kunder og salgsapparatet på tvers av flere bransjer, samt forvalte hele vårt sortiment av bærekraftige låse- og adgangsstyringssystemer, elektromekaniske låser, sylindere og digitale låseløsninger.

Du vil også fungere som prosjektleder og ha ansvar for integrasjonen av iLOQ-applikasjonen med ulike programvareplattformer for å sikre en markedsklar implementering samtidig som prosjektfrister overholdes.

Dette er en stilling som kan utføres på fjernbasis, med forventede reiser til partner- og kundelokaler: stillingen rapporterer til landssjefen

Hovedansvarsområder:

  • Gjennomføre produkt- og programvareopplæring for ILOQ Norges salgsteam, nye kanalpartnere og sluttbrukere/kunder.
  • Kontinuerlig utvikle og oppdatere opplæringsmateriell (innhold, dokumentasjon, prosesser osv.) og sikre vellykket implementering gjennom regelmessig oppfølging med interne og eksterne interessenter.
  • Administrere og koordinere informasjonsutveksling med iLOQs tekniske ledere i andre regioner.
  • Støtte produktintegrasjon med sluttbrukerdatabaser ved hjelp av API-er.
  • Gjennomføre markedsundersøkelser for å prioritere nødvendige programvareintegrasjoner innen flerfamilieboliger, boligsektoren og næringssektoren for å sikre en smidig markedsintroduksjon.
  • Fungere som hovedkontaktpunkt for IT-relaterte saker, både internt og eksternt.
  • Gi teknisk salgsstøtte, inkludert tilbud, kontrakt- og anbudshåndtering, samt håndtering av komplekse tekniske henvendelser.
  • Samarbeide på tvers av funksjoner med team innen FoU, produktledelse, forsyningskjede, salg, markedsføring og tjenester.
  • Støtte kanalpartnere, fremme kundetilfredshet og bidra til å forbedre Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  • Holde seg oppdatert på bransjetrender, konkurrenters produkter, nye teknologier og produktutvikling.
  • Opprettholde iLOQs kjerneverdier og forpliktelse til innovasjon

Hva du bør ha med deg

  • Minimum 5 års relevant yrkeserfaring, hvorav minst 3 år i en teknisk opplæringsrolle innenfor en lignende produktsektor (EAC, AI, døråpningssystemer, låser, adgangskontroll, smarte låser osv.).
  • Teknisk utdanning er ønskelig, men ikke et krav.
  • Sterke prosjektledelsesferdigheter med erfaring fra tverrfaglig og internasjonalt samarbeid, herunder med eksterne integrasjonsingeniørfirmaer.
  • God forståelse av moderne mobilteknologier, digitaliseringstrender og elektromekaniske digitale løsninger.
  • Omfattende IT-kompetanse, spesielt innen API-er.
  • Erfaring fra produktledelse, FoU eller salg er en fordel.
  • Erfaring med flerkanalsalg til ulike kundetyper og bransjer er en fordel.
  • God kjennskap til MS Office, spesielt PowerPoint.
  • Eksepsjonelle ferdigheter innen kundeservice og kommunikasjon (både muntlig og skriftlig).
  • En strukturert tankegang med stor oppmerksomhet på detaljer.
  • En positiv holdning med evne til å jobbe effektivt på tvers av flere avdelinger og globale kontorer.
  • Analytiske evner med sans for kompleks problemløsning og tidsstyring.
  • Selvstendig, organisert og pragmatisk – du tar initiativ og får ting gjort

Hva du får

Vi tilbyr deg en arbeidsplass i en samarbeidsorientert og fremtidsrettet bedriftskultur. Du vil jobbe i et dynamisk miljø der du får utfordrende oppgaver og ansvar, samt mangfoldige muligheter til å utvikle deg selv og dine faglige ferdigheter.

Du vil få en reell mulighet til å gjøre en virkelig forskjell i et raskt voksende internasjonalt selskap og påvirke arbeidsmiljøet i hele selskapet. Vi vil ta vare på deg ved å tilby en utmerket innkjøring med vennlige, hjelpsomme og engasjerte kolleger, muligheten til å jobbe med toppmoderne teknologi og bærekraftige produkter, samt muligheter for personlig og faglig utvikling i et internasjonalt selskap med dype skandinaviske røtter og verdier.

Vi er opptatt av å fremme en inkluderende arbeidsplass der mangfold verdsettes og alle ansatte blir behandlet med respekt. Vi oppfordrer søkere med alle typer bakgrunn til å søke og bli med oss i arbeidet med å fremme en inkluderende og mangfoldig arbeidsplass.

Vennligst send søknad så snart som mulig, senest 15.10.2026.

raw.description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

  • Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.
  • Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.
  • Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.
  • Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
  • Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
  • Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
  • Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.
  • Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.
  • Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.
  • Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.
  • Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.
  • Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

  • 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.
  • Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.
  • Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.
  • Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).
  • Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.
  • Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).
  • Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.
  • Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

This role focuses on conversion optimization and creative direction — guiding creative generalists, reviewing and approving output, and ensuring all creatives are aligned with CRO goals. The strategist does not handle direct web design, but must have strong CRO experience to boost campaign effectiveness.
Key Responsibilities
  • Creative Audits & Research
    • Conduct in-depth creative audits of client accounts to analyze hooks, angles, CTAs, ad types, and messaging performance.

    • Evaluate market awareness levels (unaware → most aware) and develop full-funnel creative strategies that align with customer journeys.
  • Campaign & Content Strategy
    • Build creative roadmaps for DTC brands—integrating prospecting, retargeting, and re-engagement tactics.
    • Concept new hooks and angles based on emotional drivers and product benefits.
    • Create testing frameworks and prioritize experiments across ad formats (UGC, statics, GIFs, before/after, green screen reactions).
  • UGC Briefing & Production Support
    • Draft clear UGC briefs for creators with scripts, shot lists, hooks, and storyboards.
    • Collaborate with creators to refine tone, pacing, and authenticity; review rough cuts to ensure alignment with strategy.
    • Curate social proof and testimonials for use in ads, emails, and landing pages.
  • Collaboration & Execution
    • Partner with Media Buyers to align creative with funnel stages and performance KPIs.
    • Work with copywriters, designers, and editors to translate briefs into polished, brand-right content.
    • Guide messaging and visuals for email/SMS flows and CRO landing pages.
    • Guide Creative Generalists by providing direction, feedback, and approvals on deliverables to ensure brand consistency and performance alignment.
    • Focus on conversion rate optimization (CRO) through data-driven creative strategy and testing.
    • Oversee creative direction without direct involvement in web design execution.
  • Performance Analysis & Optimization
    • Track performance data across channels, spotting winning creatives and under performers.
    • Document learnings and build "swipe files" of high-performing hooks and formats for internal use.
    • Continuously iterate on campaigns based on testing results and audience feedback

    • Present creative strategies, testing plans, and performance recaps to clients and internal leadership
    • Collaborate with Brand Managers to ensure creative roadmaps support retention and revenue goals

The national offices of the Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.), A Corporation (“A Corp”) “PC(USA)”, based in Louisville Kentucky, serve with mid-councils, congregations, worshipping communities, and partner organizations to carry forth the mission of Jesus Christ. Approximately 400 individuals, diverse in race, age, gender, sexual orientation, faith, skills, and more, come together as colleagues to work for a world where justice reigns, peace prevails, and God’s love extends to all people. This community comprises the staff of national entities: the Presbyterian Life & Witness, the Presbyterian Publishing Corporation, Presbyterian Women, Investment and Loan Program, and the Administrative Services Group.

Basic Commitment: This position calls for a commitment to the mission of the Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.) as noted in its theological confessions, the Book of Order, and the actions of the General Assembly.

Position Summary

The Grant Management Office (GMO) Strategist/Analyst serves as the agency’s lead for grant reporting, impact analysis, and grant Review (selection) design and management within the AkoyaGo Grant Management System (GMS). This role ensures that grant decisions and outcomes are transparent, equitable, data‑informed, and aligned with Presbyterian Life & Witness (PL&W) values and priorities.

By combining reporting and impact analysis with stewardship of the Review process, this position strengthens faithful use of restricted funds, supports consistent grantmaking practices across ministries, and equips leadership with actionable insights to guide mission‑driven decisions.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Grant Review (Selection) Strategy & Management

Using AkoyaGo’s Review framework, the Strategist/Analyst will:

  • Partner with grant sponsors and program staff to:

    • Review forms and interfaces used to record scores, recommendations, and observations
  • Recruit, onboard, and manage review teams, including:

  • Evaluate Review outcomes and methodologies to:
    • Assess equity, consistency, and effectiveness

The Strategist/Analyst will lead enterprise‑level reporting by:

  • Designing and maintaining standardized grant reports that support:
    • Leadership decision‑making
    • Program evaluation and learning

  • Analyzing grant data across programs to:
    • Identify trends, outcomes, gaps, and emerging needs

  • Ensuring reporting standards and definitions are applied consistently across programs
  • Partnering with Communications, Development, and program staff to translate data into meaningful narratives about grant impact

  • Maintaining consistent configuration standards for Review and reporting

  • Partnering with IT, Finance, and Legal as needed to support integrations and compliance

4. Training & Support

The Strategist/Analyst will:

  • Develop and deliver training for:
    • Grant administrators
    • Reviewers
    • Program and mission staff
  • Provide ongoing consultation and troubleshooting support
  • Create user‑friendly documentation and guidance materials

Scope & Impact

This role influences how millions of dollars in mission‑critical grants are selected, evaluated, and reported. By shaping Review processes and impact reporting, the Strategist/Analyst directly supports equity, transparency, and faithful stewardship—core commitments of Presbyterian Life & Witness.

Grant Management Office Strategist/Analyst

Senior Contract Specialist

Federal Transit Administration
Location: Washington, DC / Primarily Remote
Company: US Federal Solutions

Why Join US Federal Solutions

US Federal Solutions (USFS) is a management consulting firm supporting federal agencies with acquisition management, financial management, program management, and data analytics services. We are seeking an experienced Senior Contract Specialist / Administrator III to support the Federal Transit Administration’s Office of Acquisition Management.

This is a senior-level federal acquisition role for an experienced contracting professional who can independently support complex procurement actions, advise Government stakeholders, and provide hands-on assistance throughout the full acquisition lifecycle.

What You Will Do

As a Senior Contract Specialist / Administrator III, you will provide subject matter expertise supporting a wide range of federal service and commercial acquisitions from initial acquisition planning through solicitation, evaluation, award, contract administration, modification, and closeout.

You will work directly with Contracting Officers, Contracting Officer’s Representatives, program officials, and other stakeholders to develop acquisition strategies, process contractual actions, analyze procurement information, and ensure acquisition documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide senior-level cradle-to-grave federal acquisition support, including acquisition planning, solicitation development, evaluation, award, post-award administration, and contract closeout.
  • Collaborate with Contracting Officers, Contracting Officer’s Representatives, and program officials to plan and execute procurement actions and resolve complex acquisition issues.
  • Provide senior-level acquisition expertise and recommend appropriate procurement strategies, acquisition methods, and contract approaches based on Government requirements.
  • Process and support a broad range of acquisitions, including simplified acquisitions and complex small- and large-dollar procurements.
  • Support multiple contract types, including Firm-Fixed Price, Fixed Price with Economic Price Adjustment, Labor Hour, Time and Materials, and cost-type contracts.
  • Support acquisition vehicles and ordering mechanisms including IDIQ contracts, Blanket Purchase Agreements, task orders, delivery orders, call orders, purchase orders, and Inter/Intra-Agency Agreements.
  • Apply federal acquisition regulations and procedures associated with commercial and service acquisitions, competition, negotiated procurements, modifications, and contract administration.
  • Prepare, review, proofread, and edit acquisition and contractual documentation to ensure work products are clear, concise, accurate, complete, and contractually sound.
  • Analyze acquisition data associated with pre-award and post-award actions, identify missing or incomplete information, coordinate with appropriate stakeholders to obtain required documentation, and communicate findings to Government personnel.
  • Prepare and enter contractual actions into the agency's contract writing system, currently Enterprise Service Center PRISM, or successor systems.
  • Perform data validation, quality assurance, and verification activities supporting federal acquisition reporting requirements.
  • Support contract, task order, and call order administration, including performance tracking, invoice tracking as applicable, funding-related actions, and preparation of contract modifications.
  • Maintain accurate and current acquisition workload and status information using Government-accessible tracking tools and spreadsheets.
  • Independently assess contractual requirements and provide meaningful recommendations to Government stakeholders, including recommendations that identify risks, efficiencies, or alternative acquisition approaches.
  • Deliver high-quality work products while managing multiple procurement actions, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced federal acquisition environment stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

  • Successful candidates will bring extensive federal acquisition experience, sound contracting judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage complex procurement assignments. You will be expected to produce accurate, complete, timely, and professionally written acquisition products while serving as a trusted senior acquisition resource to Government stakeholders.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or higher degree, and/or a minimum of 8 years of relevant federal contracting experience.
  • Senior-level federal acquisition knowledge and hands-on experience comparable to FAC-C Level III and/or FAC-C Professional competencies.
  • Extensive knowledge of the federal acquisition lifecycle and applicable acquisition laws, regulations, policies, and procedures.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting federal acquisitions from acquisition planning through contract closeout.
  • Strong working knowledge of federal service and commercial acquisitions.
  • Demonstrated experience with multiple contract types, including Firm-Fixed Price, Fixed Price with Economic Price Adjustment, Labor Hour, and Time and Materials contracts.
  • Experience supporting acquisition vehicles such as IDIQs, BPAs, task orders, delivery orders, call orders, and purchase orders.
  • Experience applying relevant areas of the Federal Acquisition Regulation, including acquisition methods associated with FAR Parts 5, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 37, and 43, as applicable.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively interact with Contracting Officers, CORs, program officials, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently evaluate acquisition requirements, identify issues, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Excellent proofreading, editing, documentation, and quality-control skills.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Experience using collaboration and productivity applications such as Google Calendar, Sheets, Gmail, Docs, Slides, Drive, Meet, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong internet and market research capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using PRISM or another federal contract writing system.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions under the Federal Supply Schedule / Multiple Award Schedule environment.
  • Experience with cost-reimbursement or other cost-type contracts.
  • Prior acquisition experience supporting the Department of Transportation, Federal Transit Administration, or another federal civilian agency.
  • Current or previous FAC-C Professional, FAC-C Level III, DAWIA Contracting, or equivalent federal acquisition training or certification.

Benefits

  • Employer-provided paid Medical / Dental / Vision insurance.
  • Employer matching 401K plan.
  • PTO
  • 11 Federal Holidays
  • Additionally voluntary benefits to include Short / Long Term Disability, Term Life, and AD&D Insurance.

raw.description:
Study Now runs Global Student Pathway (GSP), a production education marketplace and student-recruitment platform used daily by counsellors, admissions officers and agent partners across nine destination markets. We have just brought the platform fully in-house, and you will be the person who makes it boringly reliable: deployed safely, monitored properly, backed up provably, and secure enough to hold student visa and identity documents.

What you’ll do


  • Assess and harden our estate across Linode and DigitalOcean, fronted by Cloudflare — topology, regions, MongoDB, storage — and own the resilience plan from day one, against defined targets: 99.9% uptime, 4-hour recovery from total provider failure (RTO), no more than 1 hour of data loss (RPO).

  • Build the 3-2-1 backup regime: hourly encrypted MongoDB dumps to a second region, automatic off-provider replication, a local encrypted archive — proven by monthly restore drills, not assumed to work.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD for our MEAN-stack application so releases ship with zero downtime — rolling restarts behind a load balancer, then blue-green — with the QA team’s automated suite wired in as a release gate.

  • Run monitoring, alerting and incident response: uptime, error rates and performance visible at all times, with alerts reaching the right person before users notice; write and rehearse the disaster-recovery runbook.

  • Own the security posture: secrets management, access control, Cloudflare WAF and rules, security-audit remediation, and UK GDPR alignment for the student data GSP holds (passports, visa documents, education records).

  • Manage cloud costs across providers, report spend monthly, and evaluate consolidation or AWS-based recovery on evidence — our current position is hardened-in-place with off-provider backup.

  • Document everything as runbooks usable by our two engineers without you on the call — a small team means no tribal knowledge.

What we’re looking for


  • 4+ years running production infrastructure for a live web application, including at least one platform you were personally accountable for.

  • Hands-on with the pieces we run: Linux servers on Linode/DigitalOcean (or similar VPS providers), Cloudflare (DNS, caching, WAF), Docker, and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or similar); infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Ansible) strongly preferred.

  • MongoDB operations in production: replica sets, backups, restores and migrations under load.

  • Deploying and operating Node.js applications — our stack is MEAN (MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node).

  • Evidence of security thinking: hardening, secrets management, access reviews; experience preparing for or remediating a security audit is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable being the only infrastructure person: pragmatic, communicative, biased to documentation and automation over heroics.

Nice to have

Experience in edtech, CRM-style platforms or other systems holding sensitive personal data; UK GDPR / Cyber Essentials familiarity; experience taking over a platform from a departing team.

Working with us

Remote from India, employed through an employer-of-record or as a direct contractor (agreed at offer). Company laptop provided.

Salary: £1,170 – £1,950/Month

Req ID:391072

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst - Remote to join our team in Plano, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).

Senior IT Business Analyst – Healthcare Interoperability & Authorization

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Business Analyst with deep expertise in healthcare interoperability, payer operations, and authorization workflows. This role serves as the critical bridge between business stakeholders, healthcare policy, and technical delivery teams.

The Senior IT Business Analyst will translate complex contractual, regulatory, clinical, and business requirements into clear functional specifications and actionable technical requirements. Working closely with data engineering and Databricks development teams, you will help design, validate, and implement healthcare data exchange and analytics solutions while ensuring data quality, regulatory compliance, and alignment with business objectives.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards, EDI/X12 transactions, SQL, authorization processes, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements & Business Analysis

  • Gather, analyze, and document contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, business rules, policy requirements, and operational needs.
  • Translate complex healthcare and payer requirements into clear, actionable business and functional requirements.
  • Identify dependencies, gaps, risks, and impacts across business processes and technical solutions.
  • Work closely with business, compliance, clinical, and technical stakeholders to ensure requirements are accurately understood and implemented.

Functional Design & Technical Requirements

  • Develop detailed functional specifications, process flows, data mappings, and acceptance criteria.
  • Translate healthcare business rules and interoperability requirements into technical requirements for development teams.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for healthcare data exchange, interoperability, and authorization-related processes.
  • Help ensure solutions comply with applicable CMS interoperability requirements and organizational policies.

Data & Interoperability

  • Analyze healthcare data and complex EDI/X12 transactions to identify data relationships, business rules, and quality issues.
  • Work with data engineers and developers to translate business logic into optimized SQL and PySpark transformation processes.
  • Validate data mappings, transformation logic, payloads, and downstream data products.
  • Support analysis and resolution of data quality, integration, and processing issues across the data pipeline.

Testing & Validation

  • Define comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and expected results based on business and technical requirements.
  • Validate complex healthcare data payloads and transaction processing.
  • Coordinate and support end-to-end testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Partner with development and QA teams to identify defects, clarify requirements, and validate fixes.

Agile Delivery

  • Work within Scrum or Kanban delivery environments.
  • Own and manage Jira epics, features, and user stories through decomposition, refinement, and delivery.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, developers, data engineers, QA teams, and business stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.

Required Qualifications

Business Analysis & Healthcare

  • 10+ years of IT Business Analysis experience, including at least 4 years focused on healthcare interoperability and/or authorization.
  • 10+ years of experience working within a health plan/payer environment.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare payer operations, particularly authorization workflows and processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex healthcare business and regulatory requirements into functional and technical specifications.

Healthcare Interoperability

  • 3+ years of experience with CMS Interoperability requirements and standards.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare data exchange and interoperability concepts.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with EDI/X12 transactions, including:
    • 837 – Claims
    • 834 – Enrollment
    • 835 – Remittance
    • 270/271 – Eligibility
  • Ability to understand and explain complex X12 structures, including loops, segments, elements, and business rules.

Data & Databricks

  • 3+ years of SQL experience, including complex joins, data analysis, reconciliation, and data quality validation across large datasets.
  • 1+ year of experience with Databricks or a comparable modern data platform.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Delta Lake
    • Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
    • Unity Catalog and data governance
    • PySpark-based data transformation
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with data engineers to translate business requirements and rules into data transformation logic.

Professional Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through complex healthcare business and technical requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to business stakeholders and business requirements to technical teams.
  • Ability to bridge the gap between healthcare operations, regulatory requirements, data engineering, and application development.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with healthcare data, regulatory requirements, and complex transaction structures.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, Agile delivery environment.

Pay Transparency

Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $85,085-$118,188. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements.
