raw.description:
Overview

The Software Engineer, Modernization is at the center of our modernization effort: systematically identifying and eliminating technical debt, re-platforming legacy systems onto clean, cloud-native architectures, and building solutions that are built to last. This person leverages AI heavily throughout their workflow — using it to accelerate analysis, generate refactored code, and uncover patterns across large legacy codebases.

Starting base pay for this role is between $97,000 and $122,000. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states).

Responsibilities

Technical Debt Reduction & Legacy Modernization

  • Systematically identifies, prioritizes, and remediates technical debt across existing codebases, partnering with Engineering Leads to build and execute a structured modernization backlog.
  • Refactors and re-platforms legacy .NET and C# applications onto modern, cloud-native architectures - improving maintainability, performance, and scalability without disrupting active product delivery.
  • Decomposes monolithic systems into clean, loosely-coupled microservices and APIs, establishing clear domain boundaries and reducing interdependencies that slow delivery velocity.
  • Replaces brittle, over-engineered, or redundant systems with simpler, more sustainable solutions that are easier to understand, test, and evolve.
  • Uses AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to analyze legacy code at scale - accelerating impact analysis, generating refactoring candidates, and producing documentation for undocumented systems.

Cloud-Native Re-platforming

  • Migrates workloads from legacy infrastructure to cloud-native patterns on AWS, leveraging Lambda, containers (ECS/EKS), Step Functions, Temporal, and managed services to reduce operational overhead and improve scalability.
  • Applies modern software design patterns - including event-driven architecture, CQRS, and domain-driven design - to re-architected systems, positioning them to support future innovation and client scale.
  • Implements database migration and schema modernization using Flyway, ensuring safe, versioned transitions away from legacy data models.
  • Builds containerized services using Docker, establishing consistent deployment and runtime environments across development, staging, and production.
  • Authors infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or AWS CDK to replace manual, brittle environment configurations with repeatable, auditable provisioning.

Standards, Simplicity & Scalability

  • Champions engineering simplicity as a first-class design principle - pushing back on unnecessary complexity and advocating for solutions that are easy for the next Engineer to understand and change.
  • Establishes and documents patterns for modernized systems, creating reusable blueprints that accelerate future re-platforming efforts and provide a consistent architecture baseline across the Engineering organization.
  • Instruments modernized systems with observability best practices - structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics - so that operational visibility improves alongside code quality.
  • Contributes to and enforce Engineering standards around code quality, testing, documentation, and API design, ensuring modernized systems raise the bar rather than just moving problems.
  • Designs modernized systems with client scale in mind - ensuring they can support increased load, faster release cadences, and rapid product iteration as the business grows.

AI-Augmented Development

  • Actively integrates AI development tools into your daily workflow to accelerate refactoring, generate test coverage for legacy code, and produce migration documentation.
  • Uses AI to perform large-scale codebase analysis - identifying duplication, dead code, anti-patterns, and high-risk areas across legacy systems that would take weeks to assess manually.
  • Partners with the AI Platform & Backend Services team to identify modernization opportunities that can be unlocked by new AI-powered capabilities.
  • Contributes to team best practices around responsible and effective use of AI-assisted development, sharing techniques that improve team-wide velocity and code quality.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Works closely with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Product teams to sequence modernization work alongside active feature development, minimizing disruption to product delivery.
  • Participates in architecture reviews and design discussions, bringing a modernization lens to new initiatives to prevent the introduction of new technical debt.
  • Contributes to pull request reviews with a focus on simplicity, maintainability, and alignment with modernization standards.
  • Collaborates with QA, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure modernized systems meet quality, compliance, and performance requirements.
  • Documents architectural decisions, migration patterns, and system changes to build institutional knowledge and reduce dependency on tribal knowledge.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including demonstrated work on legacy modernization, refactoring, or re-platforming initiatives
  • Proficiency in .NET and C#, with experience working in both legacy and modern application codebases
  • Solid understanding of software design principles including SOLID, clean architecture, domain-driven design, and separation of concerns
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices, with strong instincts for clean, consumer-friendly API contracts
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native development on AWS, including one or more of: Lambda, Step Functions, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, SQS/SNS
  • Familiarity with containerization using Docker and deployment in containerized environments
  • Experience with version control and collaborative development workflows using Git and GitHub
  • A demonstrated ability to communicate about technical complexity clearly — to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualification:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, including using AI for codebase analysis and refactoring acceleration
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration using Temporal or AWS Step Functions in a production environment
  • Experience with database migration tooling such as Flyway and safe schema evolution practices
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, AWS CDK, or Pulumi)
  • Familiarity with event-driven architecture patterns and asynchronous messaging (SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or Kafka)
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment
  • A strong personal conviction that simple, well-structured systems are a competitive advantage — and a track record of building them

Benefits

  • Medical and Dental coverage available for employees, dependents, domestic partners, and spouses
  • Paid Time Off – Flexible options plus 10 paid company holidays where available**
  • All full-time positions are hybrid, with many eligible to be completely remote
  • Fully Paid by Origami Risk – Vision insurance, Short & Long-Term Disability Insurance, and Basic Life Insurance
  • Generous family leave options—including adoption and foster care placements
  • Pre-Tax Savings Accounts – Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Commuter Benefits, Dependent Care Savings Account
  • Retirement Savings – 401(k) with company match up to 4%
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential & Free support offered to colleagues facing personal or work-related complications
  • Education Assistance Program – to help colleagues pursue industry/role-specific certifications
  • Wellness Benefits – reimbursement program to invest in healthy habits as well as support better colleague productivity and stress management
  • Additional coverages available – Pet Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Voluntary Life & AD&D coverage
**Flexible PTO not available in California or the UK

Who We Are

Origami Risk delivers single-platform SaaS solutions that help organizations best navigate the complexities of risk, insurance, compliance, and safety management.

Founded by industry veterans who recognized the need for risk management technology that was more configurable, intuitive, and scalable, Origami continues to add to its innovative product offerings for managing both insurable and uninsurable risk; facilitating compliance; improving safety; and helping insurers, MGAs, TPAs, and brokers provide enhanced services that drive results.

A singular focus on client success underlies Origami’s approach to developing, implementing, and supporting our award-winning software solutions.

Origami Risk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We thrive and benefit from diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We do not discriminate against any individual based upon race, religion, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, color, sex, national origin, age, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: earn up to $30/hour depending on your pace and approval rate
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Canada Scaled Customer Success team advises and guides our Scaled customer base, ensuring they implement and adopt Samsara, and continuously gain business value from our products using digital communications and self-serve resources. As the manager of the Scaled Customer Success team, you will improve our Scaled Customer Success motion, provide focused coaching for each team member, and be an inspiring leader who establishes an energizing team culture for the team.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of ICs and CSMs covering the Canada (Mid-Market) segment.
  • Manage individual performance
  • Deliver results across team KPIs and org level OKRs
  • Identify and implement process-improvement opportunities; such as systems efficiency gains and leaning into data resulting in increased automation
  • Lead from the front with a willingness to get hands dirty

Team Leadership & Performance

  • Hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of CSMs covering the Canada (Commercial & Mid-Market) segment.
  • Set clear expectations, goals, and KPIs (e.g., net revenue retention, adoption rates, health scores, business review and implementation completion, risk management).
  • Run structured 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and risk reviews; deliver consistent coaching and developmental feedback.
  • Recognize and grow top talent; address underperformance quickly and fairly.
  • Manage capacity and account assignment across a high-volume book to balance IC and CSM workload and customer coverage.

Digital Scale Program Ownership

  • Own and continuously improve the Digital Scale journey for Canada.
  • Define and execute digital plays (onboarding sequences, adoption campaigns, renewal outreach, health score triggers) in partnership with Marketing and CS Operations.

Customer Outcomes & Execution

  • Ensure the team drives measurable value for Commercial and Mid-Market customers through structured onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal motions.
  • Review and elevate the quality of Customer Success Plans, Business Reviews, and executive-ready materials across the portfolio.
  • Oversee book-of-business risk management, ensure early identification, clear ownership, and documented action plans for at-risk accounts.
  • Support ICs and CSMs in high-stakes customer moments (Implementation kickoffs, QBRs, escalation calls, executive check-ins) as needed.

Strategy, Process & Enablement

  • Translate company and CS strategy into a clear operating model for the Commercial and Mid-Market segment, defining cadence, plays, and standards for both low-touch and digital motions.
  • Standardize and improve core processes across Canada (onboarding-to-steady-state handoff, BR cadence, risk playbooks, escalation paths).
  • Use data and tooling (CS platform, CRM, product analytics, digital engagement tools) to monitor performance, surface insights, and guide team decisions.
  • Partner with Enablement to ensure the team has the skills, playbooks, and resources to succeed across a distributed, high-volume territory.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary CS point of contact for Sales, Renewals, Services, and Support leaders for the segment.
  • Partner with Sales on account planning, expansion strategy, and commercial alignment across Mid-Market accounts.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Operations on recurring customer themes, friction points, and feature gaps specific to the Commercial and Mid-Market segments.
  • Represent the Scale customer voice in internal forums and influence roadmap and policy decisions.

Culture & Leadership

  • Model and reinforce the company's cultural principles: customer focus, growth mindset, inclusion, and teamwork.
  • Foster an environment of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate clearly and regularly with senior leadership on progress, risks, headcount, and territory health.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of experience managing a team
  • Experience implementing a scaled (low touch) onboarding or account management program. SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong work ethic, prioritization, and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience with a customer success CRM such as Gainsight or Totango
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, performance-based, and change-heavy environment
  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$134,172.50—$173,635 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Position: Content Designer / Video Editor (AI Native)
Salary: $1,900 - $2,700 NZD – Depending on experience
Working Hours & Conditions: New Zealand business hours – exact schedule TBC
Holidays: TBC – Client Discretion

Employment: Full-time - Independent Contractor

About the Company:

The Client is a New Zealand-based B2B wholesaler supplying an extensive range of adult lifestyle products, lingerie, personal wellness products and related accessories. The client also supports retail and online partners through a broad product range, recognised brands, reliable stock availability and responsive customer service.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a creative and commercially focused Content Designer / Video Editor who is genuinely AI-native and passionate about the future of content creation.

The successful candidate will use AI tools to generate, edit and enhance engaging video and visual content, primarily for Facebook advertising and organic social media.

This is not a traditional graphic design or basic video-editing position. The role requires someone who actively follows developments in generative AI, experiments with new creative technologies and can turn ideas, products and proven content trends into polished, sales-focused creative assets.

The key objective is to produce a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that captures attention, creates engagement and supports product sales.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Content Creation

  • Generate original video concepts and creative assets using leading AI video, image, voice and editing tools.
  • Use generative AI to create scenes, backgrounds, product environments, animations, voiceovers and visual effects.
  • Transform product information, images and campaign ideas into engaging short-form video content.
  • Combine AI-generated assets with traditional editing techniques to produce polished, brand-appropriate content.
  • Experiment with new workflows and emerging AI capabilities to improve creative quality, production speed and output.
  • Maintain consistency in visual quality, tone and brand presentation across all content.

Video Editing & Production

  • Edit short-form videos for Facebook advertisements and organic social media channels.
  • Produce strong opening hooks, clear product messaging and effective calls to action.
  • Add captions, transitions, music, voiceovers, motion graphics and visual effects where appropriate.
  • Reformat and adapt content for different placements, dimensions and audience segments.
  • Create multiple creative variations for testing, including alternative hooks, visuals, scripts and calls to action.
  • Ensure all final content is technically accurate, polished and ready for publication.

Content Research & Creative Strategy

  • Monitor current AI-content developments, social media formats, advertising trends and creative techniques.
  • Research successful content within relevant retail, ecommerce, personal wellness and lifestyle categories.
  • Identify high-performing creative approaches that can be ethically adapted to the client’ products and audiences.
  • Build and maintain a library of creative references, hooks, concepts and emerging content formats.
  • Contribute fresh campaign and content ideas designed to increase engagement and generate sales.
  • Recommend practical opportunities to use AI to improve creative output and production efficiency.

Advertising & Social Media Content

  • Prioritise creative production for Facebook advertising and social media rather than general website design.
  • Develop content that captures attention quickly and communicates a clear product benefit or campaign message.
  • Work with the business to understand priority products, promotions, customer segments and sales objectives.
  • Review available performance feedback and use it to improve future creative assets.
  • Refresh and iterate advertisements to reduce creative fatigue.
  • Ensure content is suitable for the intended audience, platform and placement.

Brand, Platform & Content Compliance

  • Produce professional content appropriate for an adult lifestyle and personal wellness brand.
  • Develop creative ways to promote products without relying on unnecessarily explicit imagery or language.
  • Apply sound judgement when presenting sensitive or mature products.
  • Understand and follow Meta and other social media platforms’ advertising and community requirements.
  • Adapt concepts and visuals to reduce the risk of advertisement rejection or account restrictions.
  • Check product claims, pricing and promotional information carefully before content is published.
  • Maintain confidentiality when handling campaign plans, customer information and unreleased products.

Tools & Systems

The successful candidate should be confident using a combination of AI and traditional creative tools, which may include:

  • AI video-generation platforms such as Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora or comparable tools
  • AI image-generation and enhancement platforms
  • Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve
  • Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva
  • AI voiceover, audio-generation and captioning tools
  • Meta advertising and social media content platforms
  • Cloud-based file-management and collaboration systems

Candidates are not expected to have used every listed platform. However, they must demonstrate strong capability across relevant tools and the ability to learn emerging platforms quickly.

Requirements

  • At least two years of professional content creation, video editing or digital design experience, supported by strong hands-on capability with current AI creative tools.
  • Demonstrated experience generating video or visual content using AI-powered platforms.
  • A strong portfolio containing relevant video, advertising and AI-generated creative work.
  • Strong understanding of short-form video structure, opening hooks, pacing, storytelling and calls to action.
  • Ability to turn a basic brief or product idea into a complete creative concept.
  • Strong video-editing skills and a high standard of visual presentation.
  • Good written English and the ability to develop concise, engaging on-screen copy.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding that content must support engagement and sales outcomes.
  • Strong research skills and an active interest in new AI tools, creative techniques and social media trends.
  • Ability to manage multiple creative requests, meet deadlines and respond constructively to feedback.
  • Mature and professional attitude toward working with adult lifestyle and personal wellness products.
  • Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office environment.
  • Ability to work with the New Zealand team during agreed business hours.

Highly Desirable

  • Previous experience creating content for ecommerce, consumer product or retail brands.
  • Experience producing and iterating creative assets for Meta advertising campaigns.
  • Knowledge of advertising-platform requirements relating to adult, wellness or other sensitive product categories.
  • Experience with product animation, AI avatars, synthetic voiceovers or advanced motion graphics.
  • Understanding of creative testing, advertising performance and conversion-focused design.
  • Experience developing repeatable AI workflows, prompt libraries or content-production systems.

Benefits

  • What We Offer
    • Competitive, market-rate compensation based in the Philippines.
    • NZ Working Hours (Dayshift)

Who We Are

Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.

Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.

At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!

API is seeking a seasoned professional to join our company in the role of Account Manager. This position may be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States or Canada, or in a hybrid capacity based out of our headquarters in Melville, New York. The Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for our clients and is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with our Airline, Cruise Line, and Hotel partners. This role actively manages existing client relationships while ensuring exceptional service delivery and supporting the best interests of both our clients and API at all times. The ideal candidate is a proactive communicator, relationship-builder, and strategic partner who is committed to delivering outstanding client experiences and driving long-term success.

Essential Functions

Sourcing

  • Oversee the direction of existing API accounts with the goal of maximizing prevailing relationships to expand market/wallet share versus preassigned revenue quota. This will include working closely with Research & Sourcing team to provide all details of a destination to ensure a seamless approach to sourcing the destination.
  • Assist with the sourcing of destinations by initiating the RFP process and being sensitive to supplier relationships.
  • Total responsibility for ensuring the RFP results are documented in the customer destination presentation in an accurate, detailed oriented manner and the presentation meets the needs of the client, demonstrates a level of savings and meets the revenue goals of API.
  • Strategic planning and organizing in order to maximize API revenue, as well as client savings goals; including but not limited to sourcing timelines for expiring contracts and contract renewal.

Site Inspections

  • Conduct hotel site inspections domestically and internationally when required with customers ensuring each property meets client criteria.

Contracting

  • Execute hotel contract negotiations on behalf of the Airline, contract renewals, and addendums. Keen ability to negotiate mutually beneficial contract terms and conditions.
  • Monitor market conditions in each serviced destination to ensure the best rates, amenities and contract terms are maintained throughout the hotel contract.
  • Conduct risk management for each destination the client services to proactively manage any potential risks to the contract based on changes to that hotel or market and negotiate terms that will positively impact our client.
  • Proactively pursue and maintain, at all times, the best hotel relationships where the client has contracted.

Day to Day Account Management

  • Work closely with the other members of the sales team to ensure client needs are met at all times and share leads that are uncovered by your communication with both the hotels and the airlines.

CrewCare

  • Manage crew member feedback via our online portal for all assigned accounts ensuring any complaints are addressed in a timely fashion accordingly with our hotel partners and documented.
  • Add new hotels to the system and ensure all information is accurate. Delete inactive hotels.

Hotel Express

  • Ensure negotiated rates for Crew, Business and Leisure Travel and loaded and maintained properly on Hotel Express for clients.

ACES

  • Verify all hotel contract information is loaded properly into ACES for OPS and for Accounting.
  • Review ACES schedules monthly to ensure hotels are downloading their schedules. Assist OPS department with follow up with the hotels about the schedules.
  • Verify client back up list is accurate and loaded into ACES for OPS.

CRM

  • Ensure all revenue opportunities are in the CRM with accurate business start dates.
  • Ensure all hotel/airline and API commission contracts are loaded, executed and attached to the CRM.
  • Maintain all flight information
  • Fully understand the client’s business and ensure all deliverables are being met for a successful relationship
  • Strive to create increased value for the client by providing new points of view and recommendations that are align with desired business goals
  • Work closely with the Business Development team to ensure a smooth client transition from contract signing to implementation
  • Independently lead and make decisions that properly balance the needs of the client and API
  • Manage all client communications ranging from weekly performance meetings to business reviews
  • Own internal communications to the cross functional team on client performance, strategies and needs
  • Become knowledgeable in all API technology platforms to ensure clients are align with appropriate software solution

Competencies

  • Problem Solving/Analysis
  • Building Relationships
  • Business Acumen
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Results Driven
  • Negotiation
  • Leadership
  • Customer Focus
  • Managing Processes
  • Market Knowledge
  • Developing and Maintaining Budgets
  • Technical Capacity
  • Communication Proficiency

Supervisory Responsibility

None

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work
This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, normal core business hours. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

Travel
This position requires travel up to 25%.

Required Education and Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in the travel industry and working closely with hotels is a must
  • Preferred Bachelor’s degree in business administration, sales and marketing or related field
  • Ability to effectively manage work load in a fast paced atmosphere relying on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
  • Shows attention to detail and the ability to produce high quality work
  • Ability to positively present API in customer facing situations
  • Attention to detail and the ability to produce high quality work is a must.
  • Strong Microsoft Office computer skills, with emphasis on Excel
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Customer service and client relationship skills
  • Ability to work with and understand diverse cultures here and abroad
  • An organized self-starter who can work proactively and independently
  • Able to multi task and work well under strict deadlines and fast paced environment
  • Flexible schedule and limited travel availability needed based on business needs.

Preferred Education and Experience

Bi-lingual is a plus

Compensation Range
For U.S.-based employees: The good faith salary range for this position is $60,000 to $70,000 USD annually, commensurate with experience, plus an annual discretionary bonus.

  • Maintain Compliance: Ensure all designs align with manufacturer guidelines and relevant British Standards.

We are looking for individuals who thrive in a high-growth environment.

Overview:
We're seeking an AI Software Engineer II to help build the next generation of AI-powered capabilities. In this role, you'll develop and deliver production-ready software that integrates large language models (LLMs), machine learning, and cloud-based AI services into customer-facing applications.

You'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to rapidly prototype, build, and deploy intelligent features, applying strong software engineering fundamentals to deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with 2–4 years of experience who enjoys solving real-world business problems with modern AI technologies.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features within our SaaS platform.
  • Integrate LLMs and cloud AI services into production applications.
  • Develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, and application integrations.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines that support AI workflows.
  • Contribute across the application stack, including backend services and frontend enhancements as needed.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver customer-centric solutions.
  • Rapidly prototype new AI capabilities and iterate on customer feedback.

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural decisions.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Experience developing applications with Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or similar object-oriented languages.
  • Experience with consuming or integrating LLMs and AI services via APIs.
  • Experience building RESTful APIs and backend application services.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Within your first year, you'll contribute production-ready AI features, collaborate effectively across engineering teams, help accelerate AI adoption across our platform, and continuously improve the quality, scalability, and reliability of our software solutions.

raw.description:
About Us:
Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.

About the Role:

Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.

You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.

The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

Position Details:

Reports to: President

Direct reports: Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers

Location: Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.

Travel: Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.

Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.

Benefits:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K + employer match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Opportunities for career growth and development
  • Training and certification support

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Engineering Excellence

  • Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
  • Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
  • Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
  • Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
  • Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

Proactive Client Improvement

  • Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
  • Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
  • Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
  • Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
  • Tracks hardware and firmware end-of-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
  • Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

Leadership

  • Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
  • Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1-on-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To-Dos) in Strety.
  • Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
  • Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
  • Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
  • Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

Operations and Compliance

  • Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
  • Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
  • Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
  • Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
  • Performs related duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Education and Work Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
  • 10+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
  • 3+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex networks (required)
  • 2+ years leading engineers as a manager, team lead, or technical lead, with direct responsibility for work assignment and mentoring
  • MSP or multi-client environment experience strongly preferred

Specialized Knowledge and Skills

  • Expert enterprise networking fundamentals, including complex switching and routing, high availability system design, advanced network security design, Internet services and protocols, and advanced network diagnostics.
  • Demonstrated expert proficiency in at least three of the following, with advanced skills in the balance: core routing, core switching, network security, network diagnostics, and application load balancing.
  • Top expert level analysis and design skills: gathering data on systems issues, defining alternative approaches, assessing business impact, and recommending, developing, and implementing cost-effective solutions.
  • A track record of proactively finding and fixing problems in environments you support, with examples you can walk us through.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and hold engineers accountable while staying hands-on.
  • Excellent oral and written communication, including explaining technical risk and recommendations to non-technical customers and executives.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, incidents, and people concurrently.
  • Advanced knowledge of current technologies, tools, applications, and vendors.

Certifications (preferred)

  • CCNP Enterprise or Security, or equivalent experience; CCIE a strong plus
  • Fortinet NSE, Meraki (CMNA/ECMS), or other vendor certifications
  • ITIL Foundation or similar service management certification

Equipment and Applications

  • Cisco Routers (ISR/ASR), Catalyst/Nexus Switches, Firepower and ASA Firewalls
  • Cisco Viptela and Meraki SDWAN; Meraki Firewalls, Switches, and Wireless
  • Fortinet Firewalls, FortiCloud, FortiClient
  • Sophos Firewalls and Wireless
  • SonicWALL Firewalls
  • Unifi LAN Devices
  • Ability to learn additional network platforms as needed
  • VMware virtualization platforms (Platform9 a plus)
  • Windows Servers and Services (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP)
  • Auvik Monitoring
  • Autotask PSA and IT Glue (or similar PSA and documentation platforms)
  • MS Office, Visio, and collaboration tools

Why Join EO?
At EO, our employees are what makes us special. We are a highly collaborative company with a very involved senior leadership team that invests in their staff. We strive to be a company where every employee has a voice, everyone takes pride in their work and gets satisfaction from helping people, and where every employee is constantly learning and driving improvements.  

 

We are aligned through our core values and seek employees that embody these: 

  • Service – we are dedicated to providing EFFORTLESS support and solutions. We ensure client and end user satisfaction in every interaction.  
  • CWC – this stands for Communicate, Work, Communicate, because communication is twice as important as the work we do.  
  • Perspective – we embrace the customer’s viewpoint to inspire confidence and meet expectations. 
  • Efficiency – we maximize output and minimize wasted time, effort, and resources. 
  • Passion – we bring energy and enthusiasm to everything we do and are driven by a commitment to excellence.  
  • Reliability – we consistency delivery on promises, follow through on commitments, and are dependable in all situations.  
  • Merit – we recognize and reward talent, hard work, and the pursuit of excellence.  

Inclusion & Equal Opportunity Employment 
Effortless Office is an equal opportunity employer committed to Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

The Vice President, Enterprise Sales will serve as a key member of the Professional leadership team, responsible for shaping and executing the commercial strategy for the Enterprise segment across North America. Reporting directly to the Executive Vice President and Segment Leader, U.S. Professional Market, Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting North America, this executive will serve as the top commercial leader for the Enterprise business – driving growth for the segment.

The Vice President will lead a team of three high level sellers who serve Tax & Accounting’s largest customers. Operating within a matrixed structure, this leader will collaborate closely with the three North American General Managers, as well as partners across Revenue Operations, Enablement, Marketing, and Product, to align strategy, drive execution, and achieve scalable, predictable growth.

This role represents a pivotal opportunity to lead during a period of accelerated transformation, shifting towards enterprise, value-based customer engagement. The Vice President will partner with the Vice President, Professional Segment Sales to modernize the go-to-market strategy, drive adoption of AI-enabled and data-driven solutions, and elevate sales performance standards. They will own end-to-end commercial outcomes including bookings, ARR growth, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy, ensuring alignment with broader divisional and enterprise objectives.

This is a highly visible, field-oriented role requiring a forward-thinking, results-driven leader who combines strategic vision with operational discipline. The Vice President must be able to translate insight into action, lead through influence in a complex organization, and sustain a culture of accountability and high performance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

▪Develop and execute the commercial strategy for the Enterprise segment, aligning with divisional and enterprise growth objectives across retention and new business acquisition.
▪Lead a team of high level sellers who serve our largest customers, fostering collaboration, accountability, and performance excellence.
▪Drive transformation toward an enterprise, value-based, consultative model focused on long-term client partnerships and holistic solutions.

▪Establish a disciplined operating cadence, implementing robust forecasting, pipeline inspection, and performance management processes to improve predictability and ensure consistent achievement of revenue targets.
▪Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to strengthen go-to-market execution, refine segmentation models, and enhance commercial enablement and alignment.
▪Champion talent development, building a high-performing, engaged sales culture focused on professional growth, skill-building, and succession readiness.
▪Partner with customer unit General Managers and divisional leadership to ensure cohesive execution across business lines and alignment on customer strategy, pricing, and territory design.
▪Serve as a strategic voice of the customer, relaying market insights, emerging needs, and competitive intelligence to influence product roadmaps, innovation priorities, and service enhancements.
▪Act as a field-oriented leader, maintaining regular engagement with clients and teams to reinforce customer intimacy, coach in-market execution, and ensure delivery of value-based outcomes.
▪Collaborate with Revenue Operations and Enablement to enhance sales readiness, operational efficiency, and the integration of data, analytics, and AI-driven insights into the commercial process.
▪Foster a culture of collaboration and accountability, ensuring sales goals, compensation plans, and performance metrics are tightly aligned with strategic objectives.
▪Lead with transparency and integrity, serving as a visible ambassador of Wolters Kluwer’s values, leadership standards, and commitment to innovation, inclusion, and customer success.

 

Wolters Kluwer seeks a commercially minded sales executive who can accelerate growth and lead the transformation of its Enterprise segment into a value-based, enterprise-oriented sales organization. The Vice President, Enterprise Sales will bring a balance of strategic vision, operational discipline, and leadership presence to drive predictable, scalable revenue outcomes.

The ideal candidate will combine deep SaaS sales leadership experience with a proven ability to lead large, hybrid sales organizations through transformation. This executive will be known for building accountability, elevating performance standards, and driving collaboration across a complex, matrixed enterprise.

Experience & Expertise

▪15+ years of progressive sales leadership experience in enterprise software or SaaS environments, managing both field and inside sales teams across multiple segments.
▪Demonstrated success driving revenue growth through value-based, solution selling and SaaS or subscription-based models.
▪Experience leading commercial organizations through sales modernization, including forecasting rigor, pipeline inspection, and metrics-driven process improvement.
▪Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to align go-to-market plans and improve execution.
▪Expertise in Salesforce (SFDC) and data-driven sales management practices to increase forecast accuracy, pipeline quality, and sales velocity.
▪Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, fostering accountability, coaching talent, and developing next-generation leaders.
▪Experience operating within a matrixed, global organization, balancing near-term tactical delivery with long-term strategic growth.
▪Strong commercial acumen and understanding of key financial levers including ARR growth, CAC efficiency, and margin optimization.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$206,300.00 - $309,425.00 USD

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. raw.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Head of Growth

Compensation range: $3,000 AUD – $4,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This is an outcomes-focused role with flexibility in how working hours are structured. Regular overlap with Australian business hours is required to ensure effective collaboration with the Founder and wider team.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an Australian education business creating practical resources and planning solutions for teachers. Its products are designed to help educators save time, stay organised, and deliver engaging learning experiences.

Role Overview: We are looking for a Head of Growth to lead commercial growth as the business rebuilds and expands its digital platform. You'll own growth strategy across customer acquisition, activation, monetisation, retention, reactivation and community, with a key focus on restoring sustainable recurring subscription growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines commercial thinking with strong analytical skills. You’ll be expected to test ideas, use data to identify what works, and build a scalable marketing function and team.

We are looking for someone who is Highly resourceful and execution-focused. The successful candidate may execute work personally or leverage internal and external resources, but remains accountable for delivering work efficiently and to the required standard. They should be able to manage routine marketing execution without relying on the founder to source, manage or drive the work.

This is a build role, not a maintenance role. You won’t be stepping into an established marketing function or proven growth engine, you’ll have the autonomy and responsibility to build, shape and lead it.

While there is no dedicated marketing team to inherit, you won't be working in isolation. You'll have direct access to existing business resources including fractional CTO/development, CFO and operational support, as well as an established educational content team. As growth opportunities are identified and proven, you'll be expected to recommend and build the additional capability required to scale them.

Key Responsibilities:

Growth & Revenue

  • Own the growth strategy with a focus on increasing recurring subscription revenue.
  • Identify opportunities to improve acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue.
  • Develop and test new growth channels, strategies, and initiatives.

Growth Channels & Experimentation

  • Own paid acquisition strategy and performance.
  • Manage and optimise paid marketing campaigns.
  • Test messaging, offers, creative, and campaigns to improve results.

Lifecycle, Retention & Reactivation

  • Own lifecycle marketing across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and reactivation.
  • Develop and optimise segmentation, campaigns and automations to improve conversion, customer value and retention.
  • Identify and test opportunities to reactivate former customers and convert existing free audiences.
  • Continuously analyse lifecycle performance and improve the customer journey.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Establish reporting for key growth and marketing metrics.
  • Analyse acquisition, conversion, subscription revenue, and retention data.
  • Turn data into clear insights and growth recommendations.
  • Work directly with the CTO/development team to improve tracking and measurement while continuing to test and execute growth initiatives.

Team Leadership

  • Build and structure the marketing function from the ground up.
  • Build and lead a growth/marketing team as the function develops.
  • Set priorities, processes, and performance expectations.

Community & Advocacy

  • Develop and test strategies to strengthen customer connection, advocacy, referrals, retention and organic growth.
  • Build community as a commercial growth asset rather than focusing solely on follower counts or surface-level engagement.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of progressive growth/marketing experience, ideally including senior ownership of commercial or revenue growth within a digital subscription or recurring-revenue business.
  • ActiveCampaign experience is highly desirable, along with strong experience using an equivalent lifecycle marketing or CRM platform.
  • Strong working knowledge of analytics, advertising and marketing platforms such as GA4, Meta, Google and Canva, including the ability to manage appropriate access and permissions for team members and specialists.
  • Comfortable creating or adapting basic marketing creative in Canva for rapid testing, while able to brief and manage specialist creative resources when higher-quality production is required.
  • Demonstrated experience with subscriptions, memberships, SaaS, digital products or another recurring-revenue business model.
  • Experience with education, membership or highly engaged consumer/professional communities would be advantageous.
  • Experience developing growth strategies across customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and recurring revenue.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Hands-on experience with paid acquisition and digital marketing.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Demonstrated experience building or growing an engaged customer community that contributed to outcomes such as advocacy, referrals, retention or organic growth would be highly desirable.

What We’re Looking For

  • Someone who has owned commercial growth, not just individual marketing channels.
  • Someone who retains ownership of getting it done and keeps momentum.
  • A leader who can build and develop a team, not just work as an individual contributor.
  • Someone analytical and commercially minded who enjoys testing and learning.
  • Someone who takes ownership and accountability for measurable outcomes while continuously improving measurement, testing new approaches, and executing initiatives.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.title: Associate Creative Director, Digital Design
raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

The Associate Creative Director will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the visual and creative direction of marketing campaigns, branding initiatives, and product communication for a leading global B2B SaaS company. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, hands-on design expertise, and collaboration across multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality creative assets that resonate with both business clients and internal stakeholders.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the development and execution of creative concepts for digital, print, and multimedia marketing materials.
  • Own the digital design system, coordinating with the Brand team to ensure that we are showing up in a consistent, evocative manner.
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to create compelling visual narratives that align with brand strategy and business goals.
  • Manage a team of digital designers, providing guidance, mentorship, and constructive feedback to ensure high standards of creative excellence.
  • Oversee the production process from ideation through to final delivery, ensuring projects meet deadlines, budgets, and quality expectations.
  • Contribute to the creation of brand guidelines and ensure consistency across all creative outputs.
  • Stay current on industry trends and emerging design tools, integrating innovative techniques into the creative process.
  • Work closely with UX to ensure that our user insights are being delivered upon.
  • Analyze and optimize creative assets for performance across various digital channels, ensuring that designs drive engagement, conversions, and customer retention.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in a creative role with 2+ years of experience as a direct people manager within a B2B SaaS or high-tech environment.
  • Expertise in design software such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects).
  • Strong understanding of brand strategy, UX/UI design principles, and digital marketing best practices.
  • Ability to translate user insights into compelling digital experiences.
  • Experience with content creation, including writing copy for digital platforms or collaborating closely with copywriters to ensure cohesive messaging.
  • Deep knowledge of brand positioning, storytelling, and strategy to align creative outputs with broader marketing goals.
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, heatmaps, or A/B testing to understand how creative assets perform and optimize them accordingly.
  • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, which can be helpful for collaborating with developers and understanding web-based project requirements.
  • Experience working alongside senior creative leads or taking on creative direction responsibilities, even in smaller teams.
  • Proven track record of managing cross-functional projects, collaborating with various teams, and delivering high-quality results under tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate creative concepts to non-design stakeholders.
  • A portfolio showcasing a range of creative work, including B2B marketing campaigns, digital experiences, and branding projects.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Proficiency in motion design tools like After Effects or Premiere Pro for creating dynamic content, video assets, and animations that complement creative campaigns.
  • Experience with 3D design software like Cinema 4D or Blender, adding depth and sophistication to projects.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$114,800—$205,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
