raw.description:
Job Title: Director, AI Automation Engineer

Location: Remote US

Reports to: SVP, Product | AI

Exemption Status: Full-time, exempt

Who We Are

Impiricus is the Agentic Commercialization Platform for Healthcare. We help life sciences teams understand physician intent, coordinate the right clinical and commercial resources, and enable real-time action when HCPs need support. Our AI-powered platform acts as a field force multiplier: extending reach between rep visits, prioritizing the highest-impact path for each physician, and connecting HCPs to coverage, evidence, medical information, patient support, MSLs, field teams, samples, and approved content in the moments that matter.

Founded by a practicing physician and a senior pharmaceutical executive, Impiricus was built to accelerate patient access to life-saving treatments through ethical, physician-first engagement. More than one million opted-in HCPs trust Impiricus as a preferred channel, including many who are underserved or hard to reach through traditional outreach. Products such as the Intelligently Optimized Network (ION), Pulse, Spark, and Ascend work together so every interaction can move from information to action. Guided by our Physician Advisory Board, we keep engagement clinically meaningful, compliant, and grounded in better patient care.

Job Summary The Director, AI Automation Engineer is a player-coach role: own the quality and reliability layer for everything the AI Organization ships, and stay hands-on building the harnesses, eval frameworks, and release gates that make that real.

That means automated testing infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and CI/CD guardrails that let us stage, test, and manage AI agents and tools at scale. Coverage spans internal AI platform work (Sage and the tools built on it) and customer-facing AI across Ascend and DocUpdate.

This is the first dedicated hire into a function we expect to grow. The Director sets the bar, does the hardest technical work early, and grows into leading a small automation team as coverage expands. The goal is to keep AI Engineers and builders shipping without loading QA burden onto the core build team.

Partnership is daily with AI Engineers, AI Solutions Architects, and product teams shipping AI features: establish baseline quality metrics, automate validation, and make standards usable for engineers and non-engineers building in Sage.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Harness and Infrastructure

  • Own the infrastructure that continuously verifies whether autonomous agents are taking the actions we intend, before and after they reach production.
  • Stage, test, and lifecycle-manage bots and agent workflows before they reach production.
  • Establish baseline quality metrics and coverage standards for AI initiatives.
  • Build the infrastructure to run automated research chains and agent evals at scale.

Evaluation Frameworks

  • Create automated evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs: accuracy, safety, bias, and regression.
  • Implement RAG evaluation, prompt regression testing, and golden-set benchmarking.
  • Define and enforce quality thresholds that AI Engineers and builders must meet before ship.
  • Partner with AI Researchers and Engineers on eval design for new model and agent patterns.

CI/CD and Release Quality

  • Build the release-gating infrastructure that governs when an agent is trusted to act in production, including staged rollouts and rollback authority.
  • Develop AI automation solutions to ensure that agentic coding delivers highly functioning software while maintaining quality across the product portfolio
  • Integrate testing into GitHub Actions (or equivalent) for AI model and agent releases.
  • Maintain existing test suites and keep them current as models, prompts, and tools change.

Cross-Team Quality Partnership

  • Work with AI Solutions Architects on eval criteria for workflow automations they build in the field.
  • Partner with Principal AI Product on launch-readiness and QA for AI projects across the org.
  • Support product teams (Ascend, DocUpdate, Platform) on AI feature validation without owning their roadmaps.
  • Document standards, runbooks, and patterns so non-engineers building in Sage can self-serve basic testing.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years building, evaluating, or governing production AI/ML systems, with direct experience in agentic AI, LLM-based automation, or autonomous system safety
  • Direct experience evaluating LLM outputs: RAG eval, prompt regression, safety and accuracy benchmarking.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines with integrated test gates (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Comfortable working across AI platform infrastructure and product-facing AI features.
  • Operates independently as a senior IC and communicates quality standards to engineers and non-engineers.
  • Experience with agent testing, bot lifecycle management, or AI agent orchestration platforms is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with LLM observability and eval tooling (LangSmith, Braintrust, custom harnesses, etc.) is a strong plus.
  • Background in healthcare, pharma, or regulated environments where quality gates matter is a strong plus.
  • Prior experience standing up a QA or automation function from scratch, with appetite to grow into leading a team.
  • Proficiency in Python and standard testing frameworks (pytest or equivalent).

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $185,000 - $210,000

Where you land within the range will reflect your skills, experience, and location, while keeping team parity in mind and leaving room for future growth.

Important Notice

To protect candidates, please note that all communication from our team will come directly from an @impiricus.com email address. We do not engage third party recruiters to schedule interviews for this role. If you receive outreach from anyone outside of our domain claiming to represent Impiricus, please disregard and let us know by forwarding the message to

Benefits:

Impiricus focuses on taking care of our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.

Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents + on-demand healthcare concierge
HSA, FSA & DCFSA: Pre-tax savings options for healthcare and dependent care, with monthly employer contributions to HSA (if enrolled in a high-deductible plan)
Coverage & Protection: 100% paid short- and long-term disability, plus life and AD&D insurance
Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need with a flexible vacation policy — recharge your batteries your way
Parental Leave: Paid parental leave to spend time with your newborn, adopted, or foster child (available after 6 months)
Your Work, Your Way: If you’re close to an office, we encourage spending some time in-person to collaborate and connect. If not, remote is always an option.
401(k): Save for your future with tax advantages (and company match!)

Impiricus provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven, technically curious, and customer-obsessed Customer Success & Product Manager to join our fast-growing team.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, and Solutions Engineering. You will work closely with customers to understand how they operate, help them get the most value from our platform, and translate their workflows, requirements, and feedback into actionable solutions for our Product and Engineering teams.

You will not simply answer customer questions. You will roll up your sleeves and use the product yourself, build AI-powered workflows, configure integrations, troubleshoot implementations, create demos, and work cross-functionally to turn customer needs into product improvements.

This is an ideal role for someone who is high-ownership, meticulous, technically curious, and comfortable figuring things out without having every step defined for them.

Responsibilities

    Key Responsibilities

    1. Customer Success & Onboarding

    • Respond to customer inquiries and requests quickly and professionally, removing blockers that may delay onboarding or product adoption.

    • Own customer requests from initial inquiry through resolution, ensuring clear follow-through and communication.

    • Build strong relationships with customers and develop a deep understanding of their businesses, workflows, goals, and pain points.

    • Proactively identify opportunities to improve customer adoption, engagement, and satisfaction.

    • Help customers understand and maximize the capabilities of the platform.

    • Identify opportunities to expand customer usage and recommend higher-tier plans or additional capabilities when appropriate.

      • 2. Product Implementation & Technical Solutions

      • Become an expert user of our Central products, including advanced functionality and integrations.

      • Build and configure workflows on behalf of customers.

      • Work with advanced capabilities such as:

        • AI prompting and prompt optimization

        • Webhooks

        • APIs and API connections

        • Zapier and other third-party integrations

        • Scripting and automation

        • Account and workflow configuration

        • AI-powered workflows and agents

        • Troubleshoot customer implementations and determine whether issues can be resolved through configuration, workflow changes, or product enhancements.

        • Experiment with new product capabilities and determine practical use cases for customers.

        • Create proof-of-concepts, demos, and customized solutions that showcase the platform's capabilities.

          • 3. Customer-to-Product Feedback

          • Conduct calls and conversations with customers to understand their workflows, requirements, and desired outcomes.C

          • Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, user stories, specifications, and implementation details.

          • Work closely with Product and Engineering to communicate customer requirements and ensure solutions are accurately understood and implemented.

          • Help identify recurring customer pain points and opportunities for product improvements.

          • Participate in product discussions and provide customer-informed input into feature development and prioritization.

          • Follow up with customers and internal teams throughout the development and implementation process.

            • 4. AI & Product Enablement

            • Use AI tools to research, prototype, improve prompts, build workflows, and accelerate customer solutions.

            • Develop compelling product demos and examples tailored to specific customer use cases.

            • Continuously experiment with new AI tools, techniques, integrations, and product capabilities.

            • Stay current with developments in AI automation and identify opportunities to apply them to customer workflows.

            • Help create customer-facing guides, documentation, specifications, and other enablement materials.

              • 5. Account & Documentation Management

              • Modify and configure customer accounts within the platform as needed.

              • Manage the operational back-and-forth associated with customer documentation, including contracts, specifications, guides, requirements, and implementation materials.

              • Maintain accurate records of customer requirements, configurations, workflows, and outstanding items.

              • Ensure customer requests and commitments are properly documented and communicated to relevant internal teams.

                • 6. Growth & Expansion

                • Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business and identify opportunities where additional product capabilities can create value.

                • Identify potential upsell and expansion opportunities and work with the appropriate teams to convert those opportunities.

                • Participate in customer expansion conversations and product demonstrations.

                • Commission opportunities may be available for qualified upsell and expansion activity.

Requirements

    What We're Looking For

    Must-Have Qualities

    • High ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

    • Customer obsessed: You genuinely care about solving customer problems and making customers successful.

    • Highly detail-oriented: You catch small issues before they become larger problems.

    • Technically curious: You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable learning technical concepts and experimenting with APIs, integrations, automation, and AI tools.

    • Fast learner: You can quickly learn a new product, understand how it works, and figure out how to apply it to different customer scenarios.

    • Resourceful: You are comfortable operating with limited guidance and finding answers independently.

    • Strong communicator: You can translate complex customer needs into clear requirements for Product and Engineering teams.

    • Strong problem solver: You can break ambiguous customer problems into practical solutions.

    • Organized and structured: You can manage multiple customers, requests, projects, and follow-ups without losing track of details.

    • Commercially minded: You understand that successful customers can lead to retention, expansion, and revenue growth.

      • Technical Curiosity

      Experience or familiarity with any of the following is a strong advantage:

      • SaaS products

      • AI tools and LLMs

      • Prompt engineering

      • APIs

      • Webhooks

      • Zapier or workflow automation platforms

      • Scripting

      • CRM or customer success platforms

      • No-code/low-code tools

      • Technical product implementation

      • Product management or requirements gathering

        • Qualifications

        Required Qualifications

        • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

        • 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, Product Management, SaaS Implementation, Technical Support, or a similar customer-facing role.

        • Experience working with SaaS or technology products, preferably in a fast-growing or startup environment.

        • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both customers and technical teams.

        • Demonstrated ability to own customer issues from start to finish, including identifying the problem, finding a solution, coordinating internally, and following through to resolution.

        • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-up and project management skills.

        • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; able to break down ambiguous problems and determine practical solutions.

        • Comfortable learning new software, technologies, and systems independently.

        • Strong technical aptitude and willingness to work with APIs, webhooks, integrations, automation tools, scripting, and AI platforms.

        • Familiarity with AI tools and LLMs, including the ability to write, test, and improve prompts.

        • Ability to translate customer workflows and business requirements into clear product requirements, specifications, and actionable tasks for Product and Engineering teams.

        • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited guidance and changing priorities.

        • Demonstrated resourcefulness and initiative; able to research, experiment, and find solutions independently.

        • Customer-oriented mindset with the ability to understand customer goals and identify opportunities to increase product adoption and value.

        • Commercial awareness and willingness to participate in upselling and account expansion opportunities.

        • Ability to manage multiple customer requests, projects, and priorities simultaneously without losing attention to detail.

Ideal Candidate

You might be a great fit for this role if you are someone who sees a customer problem and thinks:

"Let me figure out how we can solve this."

You enjoy talking to customers, but you also enjoy getting your hands dirty inside the product. You can jump from a customer call to configuring an integration, then work with an engineer on a product requirement, build an AI-powered demo, and follow up with the customer—all while keeping track of the details.

You are comfortable with ambiguity, energized by fast-moving environments, and excited by the opportunity to help shape both the customer experience and the product itself.

raw.description:
Overview

POSITION SUMMARY:

Under the general supervision of the Operations Manager, the Lead Disability Assistant is responsible for the coordination of administrative processing of disability determinations for all in and out of state contracts. This position is responsible for making strategic decisions on case assignment and for keeping cases on timeline. The Lead Disability Assistant is responsible for work flow management and training of Disability Assistants as well as performing those front line functions when necessary to maintain unit production standards. This position is the primary hub for all incoming/outgoing correspondence, disability supplements, and is the primary interface with clients, agencies, and DES staff regarding incoming and outgoing medical information, mail, transportation and records. Decisions made in this area directly impact the timeline for the disability review process, the workload of review staff, and the determination of benefits for all in and out of state agency applicants. The Lead Disability Assistant is a primary customer service interface for DES' SPMP with clients and external agencies.

Responsibilities

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Manage unit work flow, assuring the proper numbers of Disability Assistants are assigned to each task on a daily basis.
  • Train new and existing Disability Assistants in work functions and job duties.
  • Monitor customer service phone queues for adequate coverage and provide call escalation response for front line staff.
  • Monitor unit key performance indicators.
  • Act as unit Disability Liaison for agency partner inquiries and issues.
  • Track priority case requests and ensure prompt completion of work on such cases.
  • Initial review of all disability supplements for accuracy, completeness, and alerting SPMP of priority cases and of important clinical information contained in cases.
  • Make complex decisions regarding privacy matters associated with the client’s case, including determination of who DES may exchange information with regarding the client’s case, what information may be mailed, and what is required, by HIPAA, to allow conversations to take place. These decisions are conveyed to SPMP through detailed case notes and individual consultation.
  • Determine if requests for information are legally complete, communicate with agencies about cases that do not meet HIPAA requirements for protected healthcare information and consult with SPMP about decisions regarding whether to return to cases to the agencies or clients for further development.
  • Telephone contact with clinical treating sources to assure timely receipt of clinical information at the request and direction of SPMP.
  • Review information in external databases such as the Massachusetts Medicaid Information System and MassHealth MA21databases in order to identify cases that SPMP could complete quickly.
  • Coordinate transportation of clients to consultative examinations and provide feedback to SPMP on unusual circumstances that would impact the review process.
  • Make decisions for rescheduling of clients’ clinical evaluations, based upon agency guidelines and provides input and feedback to SPMP. Explain complex state and federal regulations to clients, agencies and medical providers, answer disability process questions as they arise.
  • Perform other duties as required.

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2-Year College Degree in business or a related field
  • 5-7 years of relevant office experience
  • Demonstrated knowledge of medical terminology or willingness to take a course in Medical Terminology
  • Knowledge of HIPAA laws and regulations especially as it refers to the confidentiality of PHI
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office products, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Demonstrated ability to monitor and generate reports
  • Requires organizational and excellent interpersonal skills, oral and written communication skills necessary to interact with all levels of personnel.

Additional Information

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in a medical setting
  • Knowledge of DEScovery database
  • Experience working as a member of an inbound/outbound call center
  • Experience training staff on complex tasks
  • Ability to create power point demonstrations for the purpose of training staff
  • Thorough understanding of DES’s processes and procedures pertaining to all in and out of state contracts
  • Ability to create processes and procedures for new programs as need arises.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Ecosystem Services Team, you’ll build and own back-end systems and the integrations that keep our services running, help maintain and evolve the cloud infrastructure the application runs on, and play an active role in keeping the service reliable and healthy in production. You'll do this while collaborating closely with frontend engineers, product managers, CloudEng, and UX and design partners to deliver reliable features.

We are looking for engineers who treat the systems they build as their own: people who are comfortable owning a service end to end, from writing the code to verifying it works as intended in production and monitoring its health.

We are hiring for multiple Ecosystem Services Team back-end teams - each solving their own unique challenges to make the web better for everyone. More details about all hiring teams will be shared in the interviews.

About Ecosystem Services:

Ecosystem Services builds and operates the back-end platforms that power Mozilla products and services, with a focus on privacy, security, and delivering critical functionality to Firefox and millions of users worldwide.

Our portfolio spans a diverse set of platforms and services. Representative examples include Privacy Services, which provides the APIs and infrastructure behind Mozilla VPN, Relay (email and phone aliasing), and Monitor (data breach detection and remediation); AutoPush, Mozilla's Web Push platform for securely delivering notifications and real-time updates to Firefox clients; and Remote Settings, Mozilla's platform for delivering configuration updates to Firefox outside the regular release cycle. Together with many other backend platforms across the organization, these services help deliver secure, reliable experiences to Mozilla users every day.

Our teams own services end-to-end from designing and building distributed systems, to operating them in production, improving reliability, and evolving the cloud infrastructure they run on. We work closely with product, frontend engineering, Cloud Engineering, UX, and design partners to build resilient systems that make the web better for everyone.

We're hiring backend engineers across multiple Ecosystem Services teams, each tackling different technical challenges while sharing a culture of ownership, collaboration, and operational excellence. More details about the specific teams and domains will be shared during the interview process.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead backend development, building and maintaining server-side logic
  • Take real ownership of the services you work on: deploy them, operate them, and keep them healthy in production rather than handing them off
  • Work closely with our CloudEng Team to maintain and improve production environments, including monitoring and alerting with tools such as OpenTelemetry, Sentry, Prometheus, and Grafana

raw.description:
About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

- Incident, Problem & Change Management, Reporting & Insights -

About the role

We're looking for a Reliability Operations Specialist to help drive operational excellence across incident management, service reliability, observability, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role serves as a central coordinator and subject matter expert for reliability practices, helping teams improve service stability, reduce operational risk, and strengthen operational readiness across the organization.

The Reliability Operations Specialist partners closely with engineering, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to facilitate incident response, oversee post-incident reviews, track corrective actions, and provide visibility into the health and reliability of our platforms. This role does not have direct people management responsibilities but plays a critical role in influencing reliability outcomes through collaboration, process ownership, and data-driven decision making.

Location: Remote

Employment type: Permanent, Full-time

Pay Range: $85,000 - $100,000 Annually, The final compensation offered will be determined based on factors including location, experience, skills, qualifications, and market conditions.

What you'll do

Incident Management & Operational Excellence

  • Participate in major incident response activities and serve as an Incident Commander when assigned.
  • Facilitate incident coordination, escalation, stakeholder communications, and status reporting during service-impacting events.
  • Support ongoing improvement of incident management processes, procedures, and operational readiness.
  • Drive initiatives focused on reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).
  • Maintain and apply the Criticality Matrix to tier services, infrastructure, and customer MRR impact.

Mortem Management & Corrective Actions

  • Coordinate and facilitate post-mortem reviews following significant incidents.
  • Ensure post-mortems are completed accurately, consistently, and within established timelines.
  • Synthesize findings across incidents to identify trends, recurring issues, and systemic risks.
  • Maintain accountability for corrective action tracking and closure.
  • Promote a blameless culture of learning and continuous improvement and proactive/reactive problem management.

Reliability Strategy & Observability

  • Partner with engineering teams to define and maintain Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) across our product lines and services.
  • Support development and evolution of platform observability strategies, including monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and telemetry standards.
  • Analyze reliability metrics and operational trends to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Recommend and track initiatives that improve platform stability, resiliency, and service performance
  • Partner with DevOps to design JSM workflows for Incident, Problem, and Change processes while eliminating manual meetings through automation.

Change Management & Governance

  • Establish change policy, lifecycle rules, risk assessments, CAB oversight, and approvals across standard, normal, and emergency changes.
  • Track and govern Change Failure Rates and change-related incidents to protect environment stability.

Service Transition & ITAM / Configuration Governance

  • Embed across Product Line pods to manage service acceptance, operational readiness, support models, and lifecycle status (supported/unsupported/EOL).
  • Maintain asset governance, CMDB accuracy, Configuration Items (CIs), and service relationship mapping in JSM

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

  • Develop reliability reporting for engineering leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Maintain incident communication standards and stakeholder notification protocols.
  • Provide regular reporting on reliability trends, corrective actions, incident performance, and service health.
  • Translate technical reliability metrics into actionable business insights.

What you bring

  • 3+ years of experience in Product Operations, Platform Operations, Technical Customer Support, Incident Coordination, Site Operations, IT Service Management (ITSM), or a related operational role.
  • Experience participating in or coordinating major incident response activities.
  • Knowledge of incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, and post-mortem methodologies.
  • Experience working with monitoring, alerting, observability, or operational reporting tools.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm and organized during high-pressure situations
  • Hands-on proficiency with Jira Service Management (JSM) workflows, automation, and data quality governance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and reliability metrics.
  • Familiarity with Linux systems, cloud infrastructure, networking concepts, hosting platforms, or distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of ITIL, operational excellence frameworks, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles.
  • Experience supporting high-availability SaaS, hosting, cloud, or infrastructure environments.
  • Experience creating executive-level operational reports, dashboards, and presentations.
  • Experience using observability and incident management platforms.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Traditional and Roth 401(k) with company matching
  • A collaborative, team-oriented culture
  • Consistent and predictable work hours
  • Engaging, varied work that keeps each day different
  • Opportunities to contribute ideas and influence how work gets done

About Eve
Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

About the Role

You already know search has changed. Our audience is researching their options in AI first, and seeing Google AI Overviews before they see a single blue link.

We're hiring someone to own how Eve shows up across AI answer engines and turn that visibility into a real growth channel.

This is a scrappy, hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who can get creative with content and distribution — using AI and technical skill to make things worth citing, not just things that exist.

Content quality is non-negotiable here. We have a hard line against AI slop, and we're looking for someone whose instincts are audience-first to keep content valuable.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Drive Eve’s strategy and execution for showing up across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
  • Create content built to get cited, not just published. Deliver pieces most likely to earn AI citations at scale, held to the same accuracy bar as everything else we publish to attorneys.
  • Build and maintain AEO measurement reporting. Track Eve's citation rate, share of voice, and visibility across AI answer engines against competitors in our category, and report progress against our AI-visibility goals.
  • Shore up owned properties for AEO/GEO. Audit and improve eve.legal content so it's structured for AI retrieval: clear answers, FAQ and comparison content, schema and structured data, citation-ready formatting
  • Get Eve into the conversations where citations originate in collaboration across marketing and PR. A few examples: review sites and legal-tech directories, plaintiff-firm and legal-ops communities, legal-tech press and analysts.
  • Run growth experiments across channels. Test what actually moves citation rate and share of voice, like new content formats, distribution channels, community placements.
  • Manage contract and agency support. Brief and manage contractors across content creation, AEO, and technical SEO.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • A track record of moving AI visibility and content growth metrics: AI citations, organic traffic, qualified sign-ups. You can point to specific work and explain what you did, how you did it and why.
  • A scrappy, ship-it mindset. You'd rather try something, measure it, and move on than spend a week on a strategy deck. You’re excited about building the AEO playbook for Eve, and you’ve got a point of view on where SEO, AEO, and AI-native workflows are headed next.
  • Working SEO knowledge. Enough hands-on understanding of search, schema, and AI retrieval to know what's broken and what's worth fixing first.
  • Strong writer. You can produce content good enough to publish for an audience of lawyers. You can identify strong angles and hooks, and you have opinions on how to hit a high-quality bar.
  • Comfortable in the tools of the job for AI visibility(e.g., Profound, Peec AI), content creation (e.g., Airops), SEO and organic traffic (e.g., Search Console, Ahrefs/Semrush/GA4).
  • Experience briefing and managing contractors/agencies. You know how to delegate without losing the quality bar

Bonus Points

  • Experience in legal tech, B2B SaaS, or another skeptical/non-technical buyer audience.
  • Existing relationships with legal-industry communities, publications, directories, or analysts.
  • Coding or vibe-coding experience

raw.description:
Technical Consultant: Where Your Impact Actually Matters

About Practifi

Practifi is the only intelligent CRM company that meets wealth management firms wherever they are in their AI adoption journey. Our enterprise-grade, compliance-first foundation brings client data, workflows, and relationship intelligence together in one system, so firms can understand what matters, take the right action, and scale without ever needing a new CRM.

That same directness runs through how we work. We're remote-first across the US and Australia, honest about what the first few months look like, and we don't sell a version of the role that doesn't exist.

The Opportunity (What This Role Really Means)

Clients trust us with the systems that run their business, and that trust is earned one project at a time by people who know the platform. As a Technical Consultant, you're that person. You take a client's requirements, figure out what Practifi can genuinely do (versus what would just create a maintenance headache down the line), and build it. You're the technical half of our paired model, working alongside a Business Analyst who owns the relationship while you own the build. When something breaks or a client needs an escalation handled with confidence, you're often the one they're counting on.

Your Day-to-Day (The Honest Version)

The Core Work

  • Manage client projects assigned through SOWs, partnering with a Business Analyst and the client to scope requirements and design a solution that holds up.
  • Lead or participate in client calls to gather and clarify project requirements, then build it in Practifi following a defined development lifecycle.
  • Run training sessions and demos so clients understand what you built and why.
  • Serve as an escalation point for the Support team on configuration questions involving custom orgs, and as a direct escalation point for MSP clients on complex or urgent issues.

The Reality Check

  • You'll learn the specifics of Practifi's platform (JSON Components, Process Types, Task Templates, Lookup Rollup Summaries) even if you already know Salesforce cold. You'll have a Practibuddy mentor from day one and Senior Technical Consultants to lean on for the harder builds.
  • Some weeks are heads-down building. Others are back-to-back client calls and training sessions. Both are part of the job.

The Growth Part

  • Learnbucks, our annual education stipend, is yours to use on certifications or courses that sharpen your skills.
  • This role has a clear next step to Senior Technical Consultant, and the escalation and client-facing work you'll do here builds the track record to get there.

What We're Really Looking For

The Must-Haves

•Salesforce Admin I Certification.

  • Experience configuring Salesforce and Practifi objects, fields, page layouts, and Lightning Pages, plus building screen flows and record-triggered flows of moderate complexity.
  • Comfort with Data Loader, Salesforce Inspector, and Dev Console, including querying and updating records directly in the data model.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce's security model (Profiles, Roles, Permission Sets, Custom Permissions, Divisions) and the ability to configure it to a client's requirements.

The Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior experience in wealth management, financial advisory, or fintech SaaS.
  • Experience running client-facing training sessions or demos.
  • Exposure to platform upgrade or migration projects.

The More Important Stuff

  • You're genuinely curious about how systems fit together, and you ask questions instead of guessing.
  • You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical client without talking down to them.
  • You take ownership of your projects and communicate proactively when something's off track, rather than waiting to be asked.

What Taking This Leap Gets You

The Practical Stuff

  • Base salary: $85,000 to $110,000, depending on experience. No mystery math, just a real range.
  • 20 days of Paid Leave, 10 sick days, 3 personal days, and 3 volunteering days, all available from day one.

The Cultural Stuff

  • A Practibuddy mentor from day one, so you're never figuring things out alone.
  • Bi-annual summits in Chicago to connect with the team in person.
  • Remote-first that actually means remote-first, not remote-first-until-someone-questions-it.

Living Our Values Daily

  • Growth: You'll ramp up on our platform and grow toward Senior Technical Consultant, backed by Learnbucks and a Practibuddy mentor.
  • Collaboration: You'll work in a true paired model with your Business Analyst partner and lean on Senior Technical Consultants for complex builds.
  • Transparency: You'll tell clients what's realistic and what isn't, even when the easier answer would be to just say yes.
  • Curiosity: You'll ask why a client's process works the way it does before you build around it.
  • Integrity: You'll own your work, including telling a client the truth about a deadline or a technical limitation.

Ready to Join Our Community?

This role sits within our Technical Enablement team and reports into Enablement leadership. You'll partner closely with Business Analysts, Client Success, and fellow Technical Consultants. This is a remote position open to candidates across the US, with a preference for Central and Eastern time zones given our client and team meeting patterns. Start date is flexible based on your notice period.

One Last Thing:

We're not just hiring a Technical Consultant. We're adding someone to our community who cares about doing the work right, treating clients honestly, and helping the person next to them succeed. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk.

Practifi is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We value transparency in our hiring process. Please note that portions of our recruitment process may involve the use of AI-assisted tools to help review applications and match candidates to job requirements. All final hiring decisions are made by our human recruitment team, ensuring fair and thoughtful consideration for every applicant.

Head of Sales

Remote (United States)

Great communities start in preconstruction. The buildings that shape them, hospitals, schools, arenas, workplaces, housing are defined before construction begins. ConCntric is the platform that helps builders win new opportunities to build the spaces where people thrive. We unify the data, workflows, and people behind preconstruction so the teams shaping our skylines make better decisions, win more work, and build the communities of tomorrow. At ConCntric, we build the platform that gives community builders the confidence to take on the projects that shape the future.

Following our Series A funding, ConCntric is seeking a Head of Sales to build and lead our revenue organization at a critical inflection point. This is not an optimization role. With a proven AI-powered platform, the work ahead is construction; building the team, the process, and the motion from the ground up.

You will design and implement our complete revenue strategy in direct collaboration with the CEO and cross-functional leaders across product, marketing, and customer success. You will build and lead the sales team, run the pipeline, coach the reps, and report to the board. You will carry both the strategy and the execution, equally, simultaneously, without delegating either.

To thrive in this role, you must have done this before, specifically at the sub-$10M ARR stage, in a resource-constrained environment, as a genuine player-coach. You have built repeatable sales processes from scratch. You have personally sourced and closed deals while developing the team alongside you. You are present, structured, and proactive by default, not only when prompted.

ConCntric’s AI-powered platform unites data, workflows, and people to ensure unparalleled certainty of outcome for the world’s most ambitious building projects. Backed by 53 Stations and other strategic investors, we’re transforming preconstruction through our Amplify AI technology, enabling teams to plan more thoroughly and make faster, smarter decisions with confidence.

The Head of Sales reports directly to the CEO and is accountable for revenue growth, team performance, and the integrity of the pipeline. This role requires a leader whose presence is felt daily by the team, whose communication with the CEO is proactive and structured, and whose cross-functional peers know exactly what they’re working on.

Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a high-performing Sales team across the North American Theater; hiring, developing, and holding the team accountable
  • Design and implement a comprehensive go-to-market strategy across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments
  • Establish metrics, analytics, and processes that drive accurate forecasting and predictable revenue growth
  • Run structured team cadences: pipeline reviews, 1:1s, call coaching, and sales QBRs consistently and without prompting
  • Coach reps through live deals via joint calls and real-time feedback, not classroom instruction
  • Maximize ConCntric’s land and expand strategy and optimize the customer journey from acquisition through expansion
  • Build and manage strategic relationships with key customers and partners
  • Collaborate with product and engineering on roadmap priorities informed by field intelligence
  • Lead and develop the BDR team, establishing outbound prospecting structure, activity metrics, and pipeline contribution targets
  • Own top-of-funnel strategy and execution — outbound motion, sequencing, ICP targeting, and BDR-to-AE handoff process
  • Provide regular, proactive reporting and insights to the CEO and board

Required Skills and Experience

  • Proven success in a senior sales leadership role at a SaaS company with sub-$10M ARR, not inherited momentum, you built it
  • Track record of personally sourcing and closing new business while managing a team simultaneously
  • Experience building a repeatable sales process from scratch in a resource-constrained environment
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and retain high-performing reps
  • Strong commitment to pipeline integrity and forecast accuracy
  • Experience building or leading a BDR/SDR function — hiring, ramping, and holding an outbound team accountable to pipeline generation targets
  • Track record of designing and executing outbound motions that produce measurable, repeatable top-of-funnel contribution
  • Comfortable operating in partnership with RevOps and maturing GTM infrastructure
  • Excellence in strategic planning and hands-on execution, not one or the other
  • Deep understanding of SaaS metrics and go-to-market fundamentals
  • Experience building and leading a fully remote or distributed sales team

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Background in construction technology or an adjacent industry, real estate, infrastructure, AEC, or capital projects
  • Track record of scaling a company specifically through Series A/B stages
  • Experience selling AI/ML or platform SaaS to operational, non-technical buyers
  • Familiarity with the preconstruction workflow and the stakeholders who drive buying decisions
  • History of developing sales talent into leadership

Qualification is the baseline. What separates the right candidate is how they show up — for the business, for the team, and for the process of getting here.

  • You are genuinely motivated by this stage and this category — not by the title or the compensation structure. Your interest in ConCntric is specific and verifiable.
  • Your team knows where they stand. You run a structured cadence, coach proactively, and address performance directly and early.
  • You are visible and present. The CEO always knows what you’re working on. Your peers seek you out. Your team feels supported.
  • You do your work from a dedicated, professional environment. You show up on time, prepared, with a point of view.
  • You have a clear, specific perspective on your first 30/60/90 days before you accept an offer, not a framework, a plan.
  • You are equity-oriented. You are here to build something, and you understand the upside that comes with doing it well.

Compensation

ConCntric is prepared to invest in this role with market-competitive base, incentive, and equity compensation.

Ready to transform the future of construction while building something remarkable with a passionate team? Apply now!

The compensation range posted for this position is estimated based on the needs and location of the role. An individual's unique offered compensation may be higher or lower depending on their experience and fit for the role.

At ConCntric, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. We actively seek candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to build an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Your privacy matters. All candidate data will be handled in accordance with GDPR, CCPA and global data privacy best practices.

Mid-Level SQL Database Administrator
ROLE
We need an experienced Mid-Level SQL Database Administrator (DBA) at the U.S. Government Publishing Office (GPO). GPO is the federal agency that produces and distributes the official publications of the U.S. Government, and this contract supports the databases behind business systems across the agency. In this role, you will perform day-to-day SQL Server administration, troubleshooting, and configuration under the guidance of the Senior SQL DBA. You will also support capacity planning and system health monitoring for SQL Server and SQL Cluster environments, manage and resolve assigned RFCs and ServiceNow tickets in accordance with operational SLAs, and assist internal customers with building, configuring, and troubleshooting SQL databases. This is a full-time opportunity. We can offer a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Apply today!

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Serve as the mid-level technical resource for all SQL Server administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning activities
  • Lead proactive capacity planning and system health monitoring for SQL Server and SQL Cluster environments
  • Manage and resolve assigned RFCs and ServiceNow tickets in accordance with operational SLAs
  • Assist internal customers/users with building, configuring, and troubleshooting SQL databases
  • Troubleshoot application-level integration issues tied to SQL Server (e.g., SharePoint connectivity)
  • Produce weekly support activity reports documenting work performed and outcomes
  • Collaborate with the Senior Oracle DBA and mid-level team members to ensure consistent operational coverage across the full database environment
  • Maintain documentation of system configurations, changes, and troubleshooting procedures

BACKGROUND/REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
  • Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience as a SQL Database Administrator in enterprise production environments
  • Demonstrated expertise across: SQL, SQL Server, SQL Clustering, SQL Scripting, and PL/SQL
  • Working familiarity with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, and MS Access (multi-platform environment; team-wide technology coverage is a proposal evaluation factor)
  • DBA II-level competency, demonstrated across the following areas:
    • Provisioning & Config: Runs standard templates/runbooks
    • Backup/Restore: Performs and validates backup restores
    • Patching: Applies minor patches with guidance
    • Performance Tuning: Basic query/index hygiene tuning
    • HA/DR: Implements and tests failover scenarios
    • Monitoring & Alerting: Acknowledges and escalates alerts appropriately
    • Security & Compliance: Follows established security baselines
    • Scripting & Automation: Writes robust automation/IaC scripts
    • Incident Management: Executes established runbooks during incidents
  • Experience with ITSM/ticketing platforms (e.g., ServiceNow) for request lifecycle management
  • Familiarity with database monitoring/capacity planning tools (e.g., Idera, SolarWinds)
  • Experience troubleshooting application-level integrations with SQL Server (e.g., SharePoint)

DESIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE
  • Professional Oracle or SQL certifications
  • Prior federal government or GSA Schedule task order experience
  • Cloud-hosted SQL environment experience (Azure SQL, AWS RDS, or similar)
  • Exposure to Oracle database environments (a plus, given the mixed-platform team)

LOCATION
  • Remote

CLEARANCE
  • Must be a US Citizen

CLIENT
  • Government Publishing Office (GPO)

HOURS
  • 40 hours per week. 8 hours per day between core hours of 7:30am-6:00pm EST.
  • Periodic after-hours availability for scheduled patching, reboots, and maintenance

EMPLOYMENT CLASSIFICATION
  • Employment Classification Eligibility – W2

RELOCATION
  • Not eligible for relocation benefits

COMPENSATION
  • Salary range: $100,000 – $110,000
Benefits: Benefits package includes options for health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401k contribution options. Full benefits brochure available for

Other Considerations: This position is W-2 only; no Corp-to-Corp or 1099 candidates. Relocation will not be offered. This position requires access to Department of Justice facilities and systems. As a condition of employment, selected candidates must complete and receive favorable adjudication from a federal government background investigation as required by the U.S. Department of Justice. Architectural Services Consultant – Project Manager - Remote North Carolina, Remote South Caroline or Remote Virginia

The Architectural Services Consultant will promote professional door hardware specification services including Division 8 and 28 to prospective architectural accounts as a “pull through” sales strategy to penetrate the market. This individual will manage and oversee projects lifecycles from initial Schematic Design (SD) phase through the Construction Administration (CA) phase, which could include those under an Architectural Consulting Agreement. Candidate may work remote majority of the time but must live within the territory – North Carolina, South Carolina or Virginia.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. The company does not intend to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, TN, etc.) for this employment position.


At Allegion, we recognize that great talent and breakthrough ideas can come from anywhere. That’s why this position offers a flexible remote work arrangement, with occasional on-site visits as needed based on the role. Whether you’re working remotely or collaborating in person, we’re committed to providing the tools, support, and dynamic environment you need to succeed. At Allegion, your career thrives where innovation meets flexibility, empowering you to achieve your goals while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

While this is the current structure and we currently have no plans to change, we reserve the right to make changes to the remote schedule as needed at the Company’s discretion.


What You Will Do:

  • Proactively manage the project lifecycle, ensuring that all projects are delivered on-time, and within scope and budget while managing risk and ensuring quality control.
  • Assist in developing project scope of services and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility in the development of door hardware solutions.
  • Promote Allegion brands and architectural services.

  • Utilize relationships and industry expertise to initiate architectural consulting agreements with firms.

  • Demonstrated experience influencing others with a bias for action
  • Strong customer service focus
  • Considering candidates in Charlotte, NC; Raleigh, NC; Charleston, SC; Norfolk, VA or Remote North Carolina, Remote South Carolina or Remote Virginia.

Allegion is a Great Place to Grow your Career if:

  • You're seeking a rewarding opportunity that allows you to truly help others. With thousands of employees and customers around the world, there’s plenty of room to make an impact. As our values state, “this is your business, run with it”.
  • You’re looking for a company that will invest in your professional development. As we grow, we want you to grow with us.
  • You want a culture that promotes work-life balance. Our employees enjoy generous paid time off, because at Allegion we recognize that you have a full life outside of work!
  • You want to work for an award-winning company that invests in its people. Allegion is proud to be a recipient of the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award for the second year in a row, recognizing our commitment to employee engagement, strengths-based development, and unlocking human potential.

What You’ll Get from Us:

  • A commitment to your future with a 401K plan, which currently offers a 6% company match and no vesting period
  • Health Savings Accounts – Tax-advantaged savings account used for healthcare expenses

  • Disability Insurance –Short-Term and Long-Term coverage, paid for by Allegion, provides income replacement for illness or injury

- The total expected annual salary for this role includes a base compensation of $75,000-$115,000 plus a bonus of up to 30% of the base compensation, for a total expected compensation range of $97,500-$149,500.


Apply Today!

Join our team of experts today and help us make tomorrow’s world a safer place! Not sure if your experience perfectly aligns with the role? SUMMARY/JOB PURPOSE

The Associate RA Quality, Standards & Training Director provides compliance oversight for the Global Patient Safety (GPS) and Regulatory Affairs function, with primary focus on Regulatory Affairs activities. The role applies strong regulatory strategy knowledge to monitor, assess, and communicate performance against key compliance indicators. metrics and inspection-readiness standards. The Associate Director drives process standardization and consistency by leading compliance monitoring activities, proactively identifying compliance and operational risks, and advancing continuous improvement initiatives. Working cross-functionally with Clinical Operations, Clinical Development and Quality Assurance, the role supports alignment to regulatory standards, mitigates compliance risk, and strengthens organizational inspection readiness.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Accountable for monitoring SmPC updates for commercially sourced products in Exelixis-sponsored studies.
  • Ensure accuracy of Reference Safety Information (RSI) trackers to include timely updates of health authority submission dates and approvals.
  • Track receipt of partner IBs and ensure timely health authority submissions across programs.
  • Track RFis to completion within the timelines as required per SOP.
  • Monitor aggregate report compliance to health authorities and CROs.
  • Work with Regulatory Affairs Strategist, CRO and Clinical Operations to ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) and Veeva RIM is kept current and complete for Regulatory Affairs related documents.
  • Monitor Regulatory Affairs training compliance via LMS.
  • Oversee the timely and accurate update of Regulatory Affairs SOPs by working with SOP owners.
  • Accountable for Regulatory Affairs points of contact for each study kept current with the health authorities.
  • Assist Regulatory Affairs Strategy Team on development programs as needed.
  • Monitor and analyze key compliance metrics to assess adherence to applicable procedures, regulations and internal standards.
  • Contribute to the development of leadership dashboards and slide decks, summarizing compliance performance and trends.
  • Support the investigation, tracking and timely closure of Quality Events, including root cause analysis and development of corrective and preventative actions (CAPAs), as required.
  • Collaborate closely with SMEs to support deviation assessment and authorship, ensuring timely and high quality documentation.
  • Coordinate with GPS and Regulatory Affairs SMEs to conduct impact assessments for new and evolving regulations and support development of implementation plans.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Applies knowledge of organizational goals and objectives and demonstrates advanced skill and insight in gathering, analyzing and applying key information to solve problems. Provides regulatory expertise to cross-functional teams. Understands longer term consequences of decisions and actions.

raw.title: Senior Director, People Operations
raw.excerpt: Who We ArePindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

The Opportunity

This is a builder role at a company that is running at full speed. Pindrop has the people, the product, and the market momentum. What we need now is the operational backbone that matches that ambition- an HR Operations function that is not just keeping the lights on, but actively enabling the business to scale with precision, compliance, and speed.

The Senior Director, People Operations will own the full scope of people operations infrastructure: our HRIS, payroll, domestic and international benefits, immigration, compliance, audits, and the standard operating procedures that make all of it repeatable and scalable. This person will be the operational engine of the People team; the person who makes sure that accuracy and urgency are not in conflict, and that the People function shows up as a genuine business partner to Finance, Legal, IT, and the broader organization.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a build role. The infrastructure you design today will support a growth organization tomorrow. The standard for this seat is high, and the impact of getting it right is significant.

What You’ll Do

Standard Operating Procedures & Process Infrastructure

  • Lead the team that will design, document, and maintain comprehensive SOPs for every HR Operations process from onboarding and offboarding to payroll changes, benefits enrollment, and immigration filings
  • Build a process infrastructure that can survive personnel changes, scale with headcount growth, and be audited by external parties at any time
  • Identify workflow inefficiencies and lead continuous improvement initiatives, the goal is always to reduce manual work, eliminate error risk, and create repeatable operational excellence
  • Automate where possible, and own the intersection between HR technology and HR process

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Be a genuine business partner to Finance, ensuring payroll data, headcount reporting, and benefits costs are accurate, timely, and presented in a format that supports financial planning and decision-making
  • Partner with Legal on employment matters, immigration filings, compliance questions, and any HR-related risk exposure
  • Collaborate with IT and Security on system access, data governance, and any HR systems that intersect with the company's security posture
  • Work closely with the HRBP team to ensure that operational processes support, not slow down, the employee experience and people programs
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert when customer or investor due diligence requires HR and people operations documentation

HRIS Ownership — UKG Ready Implementation and Optimization

UKG Ready is our system of record for headcount, compensation, onboarding, and reporting. It is currently under-optimized, causing downstream data quality issues that affect data accuracy, finance reporting, and compliance. You will own changing that.

  • Lead the ongoing optimization of UKG Ready- including module configuration, workflow builds, system integrations, and self-service functionality
  • Serve as the internal SME and escalation point for all UKG-related questions, issues, and enhancements
  • Build and maintain system integrations between UKG and downstream tools including payroll, benefits carriers, and finance systems
  • Own data integrity- audits, error correction, quality controls, and reporting accuracy
  • Design and deliver manager and employee training on HRIS self-service functionality so the system works for the whole organization, not just HR
  • Partner with AI Leaders to build AI-enabled self-service agents and automations where they reduce friction and improve the employee experience
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive dashboard and system reporting suite that gives Finance, ELT, and functional leaders real-time visibility into people data

Payroll

  • Oversee the Payroll and Benefits Manager and end-to-end payroll process — domestic and international — with zero tolerance for errors and an obsessive attention to accuracy
  • Ensure payroll is fully integrated with HRIS, benefits, and Finance reporting so there is a single source of truth for compensation data
  • Build and maintain payroll SOPs that can survive personnel changes and scale with headcount growth
  • Merit & Incentive Cycles: Managing the operational execution of annual merit cycles, bonus calculations, and market benchmarking data

Domestic & International Benefits

  • Own the full benefits program- medical, dental, vision, 401k, life, disability, and ancillary benefits- from vendor selection and renewal through employee communication and ongoing administration
  • Manage international benefits programs across all Pindrop employee populations globally, ensuring compliance with local requirements and competitive positioning in each market
  • Lead the annual benefits renewal process including benchmarking, carrier negotiations, and cost modeling in partnership with Finance
  • Own 401k plan administration and the annual 401k audit, ensuring the plan is compliant, well-documented, and employees have visibility into their options
  • Build a total rewards communication strategy so employees understand the full value of their compensation and benefits, not just their base salary

Compliance, Audits & Immigration

  • Own all state and federal HR compliance oversight, including multi-state employment law, annual filings, EEO-1, VETS-4212, ACA reporting, and any jurisdiction-specific requirements as Pindrop grows
  • Oversee immigration- H-1B, L-1, green card sponsorships, and all related filings- in partnership with immigration counsel, ensuring employees and their families are supported through every step of the process
  • Own customer compliance audits, preparing all required people and HR documentation in response to enterprise customer security and compliance audit requests
  • Manage benefit audits including the annual 401k audit end-to-end- coordination with auditors, documentation preparation, and remediation of any findings
  • Oversee the design and deploy company-wide compliance training, including harassment prevention, data privacy, security awareness, and any regulatory requirements, and maintain completion records
  • Build and maintain an HR compliance calendar so nothing falls through the cracks as the organization scales
  • Pre-Employment Operations & Onboarding Governance: Direct the strategy, compliance, and SLA performance of pre-employment operations (background checks, pre-hire screening, and onboarding workflows), guiding the People Systems Specialist who executes day-to-day delivery.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and grow the HR Operations team, currently including a Operations Specialist, Sr. Manager, Payroll and Benefits Manager, and any office facilities personnel as the function scales with the business
  • Build a team culture where accuracy and urgency are not in conflict, where the standard is high, the pace is fast, and the team is proud of the work they put out
  • Develop team members' skills and career trajectories with the same intentionality you bring to your own work

Your skill-set

You are:

  • 7+ years of progressive HR Operations experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role at a scaling technology company
  • Deep, hands-on HRIS expertise, UKG Ready experience is strongly preferred. You have implemented, configured, and optimized an HRIS before, not just used one
  • Proven ownership of payroll, multi-state compliance, and benefits administration, including international benefits programs and 401k plan administration
  • Direct experience managing immigration programs including H-1B and green card sponsorships in partnership with outside counsel
  • Experience managing external audits, including 401k audits, customer compliance audits (SOC 2, ISO, or equivalent), and state/federal regulatory filings
  • A track record of building compliance training programs that actually change behavior, not just check a box
  • Exceptional cross-functional partnership skills- you have worked closely with Finance, Legal, and IT and have earned their trust as a subject matter expert, not just a service provider
  • Strong SOPs discipline- you build documentation that outlasts the person who built it
  • The operational mindset that accuracy and urgency belong together, you do not sacrifice one for the other

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience at a company scaling for growth- you know what breaks at this stage and how to get ahead of it
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled HR tools and a genuine curiosity about automation. You are looking for ways to use technology to reduce manual work, not reasons to avoid it
  • Experience designing total rewards communication strategies and building employee-facing compensation and benefits transparency
  • PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP certification preferred but not required

Who you are

  • Runs toward complexity, not away from it. Sees a messy HRIS and a compliance gap and thinks about how to fix it, not how to explain why it is hard.
  • Holds an incredibly high bar for accuracy, and does not see that as being in conflict with moving fast. Has figured out how to do both simultaneously.
  • Shows up as a business partner, not a process administrator. Understands what Finance needs from payroll data and gives it to them in the format they need, not the format that is easiest to produce.
  • Is a builder. Has done this before in an environment where the infrastructure did not yet exist, and is energized by the opportunity to build it right this time.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence at all levels of the organization, equally comfortable presenting to the CEO, running a benefits enrollment meeting, or working through the technical details of a UKG integration with IT.

What’s in it for you

This role will be evaluated against outcomes, not activity:

  • UKG Ready fully optimized and integrated within 6 months, with measurable improvement in data quality, payroll accuracy, and finance reporting reliability
  • Zero compliance findings in state, federal, or customer audits attributable to HR Operations gaps
  • Payroll error rate at or below industry benchmark (measured monthly)
  • All SOPs documented and accessible within 120 days; updated on a defined cadence thereafter
  • Immigration cases managed on-time with no lapses in employee work authorization
  • Company-wide compliance training completion at 95%+ within 60 days of program launch
  • Finance, Legal, and HRBP partners rate HR Operations as a strong cross-functional partner in quarterly stakeholder surveys

Why Pindrop, Why Now

  • HR Operations is taken seriously here you will have the organizational support, and the CPO backing to build it right
  • The scope is real. You will own immigration, international benefits, customer audits, and HRIS implementation simultaneously- this is not a narrow administrative role
  • You will be building something that lasts. The infrastructure you design will support a $300M organization
  • The culture values accuracy and urgency in equal measure; you will fit in here if you hold both standards simultaneously
  • AI-native environment. Pindrop's product is built on AI, and we expect the same innovation mindset in how we run our internal operations

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer. This position is eligible for additional compensation in the form of an annual discretionary bonus.

US Base Pay Range
$200,000—$230,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.
